+function Extract([string]$source, [string]$declaration) {
+    $start = $source.IndexOf($declaration, [StringComparison]::Ordinal)
+    if ($start -lt 0) { throw "Missing production member: $declaration" }
+    $open = $source.IndexOf('{', $start); $depth = 0
+    for ($i=$open; $i -lt $source.Length; $i++) {
+        if ($source[$i] -eq '{') { $depth++ }
+        if ($source[$i] -eq '}') { $depth--; if ($depth -eq 0) { return $source.Substring($start,$i-$start+1) } }
+    }
+    throw 'Unbalanced member'
+}

+    public boolean normalDeviceActionAllowed() { return bleManager.maintenance().normalAllowed(); }
+    private void maintenanceChanged() {
+        aiRuntimeDisplayService.maintenanceChanged();
+        long epoch = bleManager.maintenance().epoch();
+        stopStatusPolling();
+        kimiAhaKeyBridge.connectionChanged();
+        Platform.runLater(() -> {
+            if (epoch != bleManager.maintenance().epoch()) return;
+            displayConfigService.maintenanceChanged();
+            firmwareCatalogKeyRequested = false; handledFirmwareIdentity = null;
+            enterEditingAfterConnect = false;
+            modeSwitchInProgress.set(false); studioState.modeSwitchingProperty().set(false); clearModeSwitchStatusGuard();
+            studioState.setCp4cInputConfigEnabled(false);
+            deviceStatus.clearFirmwareIdentity();
+            if (!bleManager.maintenance().normalAllowed()) { deviceStatus.setConnected(false); return; }
+            try (var transaction = bleManager.maintenance().normalTransaction()) {
+                if (epoch != bleManager.maintenance().epoch()) return;
+                // A reconnect performed inside maintenance does not emit the ordinary connected callback.
+                bleManager.clearCachedFirmwareIdentity();
+                reconcileCurrentConnection();
+            } catch (Exception busy) { logger.info("Maintenance handoff changed: {}", busy.getMessage()); }
+        });
+    }
+    private void reconcileCurrentConnection() {
+        if (!normalDeviceActionAllowed()) return;
+        boolean connected = bleManager.isConnected() && bleManager.getCachedStatus().isConnected();
+        if (connected) {
+            applyBleStatus(bleManager.getCachedStatus());
+            startStatusPolling(); kimiAhaKeyBridge.connectionChanged();
+        } else {
+            stopStatusPolling(); kimiAhaKeyBridge.connectionChanged();
+            firmwareCatalogKeyRequested = false; handledFirmwareIdentity = null;
+            deviceStatus.setConnected(false); deviceStatus.clearFirmwareIdentity();
+            studioState.setCp4cInputConfigEnabled(false); displayConfigService.connectionChanged();
+        }
+    }
+
+    private int lastSyncedRevision = -1;
+    
+    // 定时轮询设备状态（由于BLE通知不可靠，需要主动查询）
+    private ScheduledExecutorService statusPoller;
+    private ScheduledFuture<?> pollFuture;
+    private volatile boolean firmwareCatalogKeyRequested = false;
+    private volatile long firmwareCatalogRequestGeneration = -1;
+    private BleManager.FirmwareIdentity handledFirmwareIdentity;
+    private volatile boolean enterEditingAfterConnect = false;
+    private final AtomicBoolean cp4cInputReadbackInProgress = new AtomicBoolean(false);
+    private volatile ModeSlot pendingModeSwitchTarget = null;
+    private volatile long suppressModeStatusUntilMillis = 0;
+    private final AtomicBoolean modeSwitchInProgress = new AtomicBoolean(false);
+
+    private static void closeTransaction(AutoCloseable lease) {
+        try { lease.close(); } catch (Exception e) { logger.warn("Transaction close failed", e); }
+    }
+    private void deviceFx(Runnable action) { deviceFx(bleManager.connectionGeneration(), action); }
+    private void deviceFx(long generation, Runnable action) {
+        long epoch = bleManager.maintenance().epoch();
+        Platform.runLater(() -> {
+            if (epoch == bleManager.maintenance().epoch() && generation == bleManager.connectionGeneration()
+                    && bleManager.maintenance().normalAllowed()) action.run();
+        });
+    }
+    public StudioController() {
+        this(BleManager::fromEnvironment, com.example.ahakey.service.KimiAhaKeyBridge::new, true);
+    }
+    /** Same controller callbacks with isolated transports; native services are started only by the application. */
+    public StudioController(java.util.function.Function<BleManager.BleCallback, BleManager> transportFactory,
+                            java.util.function.Function<BleManager, com.example.ahakey.service.KimiAhaKeyBridge> bridgeFactory,
+                            boolean startPlatformServices) {
+        platformServicesEnabled = startPlatformServices;
+        String sim = System.getenv("AHAKEY_STUDIO_SIMULATE_BLE");
+        simulateBle = sim != null && (sim.equals("1") || sim.equalsIgnoreCase("true"));
+        studioState.loadFromPersisted(StudioStore.loadOrDefault());
+        lastSyncedRevision = studioState.getRevision();
+
+        bleManager = transportFactory.apply(new BleManager.BleCallback() {
+            @Override
+            public void onConnected() {
+                logger.info("收到设备连接通知");
+                long generation = bleManager.connectionGeneration();
+                deviceFx(() -> {
+                    if (generation != bleManager.connectionGeneration() || !bleManager.isConnected()) return;
+                    reconcileCurrentConnection();
+                    if (enterEditingAfterConnect) {
+                        enterEditingAfterConnect = false;
+                        activateConfigurationEditing();
+                    }
+                });
+                // USB/BLE use the same saved-action approval adapter; raw BLE transport is separate.
+            }
+
+            @Override
+            public void onDisconnected() {
+                long generation = bleManager.connectionGeneration();
+                firmwareCatalogKeyRequested = false;
+                enterEditingAfterConnect = false;
+                deviceFx(() -> {
+                    if (generation != bleManager.connectionGeneration()) return;
+                    reconcileCurrentConnection();
+                    if (modeSwitchInProgress.getAndSet(false)) {
+                        studioState.modeSwitchingProperty().set(false);
+                        studioState.syncStatusProperty().set("连接中断，键盘模式未确认");
+                    }
+                    clearModeSwitchStatusGuard();
+                });
+                // 停止定时轮询
+                if (!normalDeviceActionAllowed() && !bleManager.isConnected()) { stopStatusPolling(); kimiAhaKeyBridge.connectionChanged(); }
+            }
+
+            @Override
+            public void onStatusReceived(DeviceStatus status) {
+                var identity = bleManager.firmwareIdentity();
+                deviceFx(() -> {
+                    if (!normalDeviceActionAllowed() || !bleManager.isCurrentIdentity(identity)) return;
+                    applyBleStatus(status);
+                    // 不再强制同步设备工作模式到UI选择，让用户自由选择要编辑的模式
+                });
+            }
+
+            @Override
+            public void onError(String message) {
+                enterEditingAfterConnect = false;
+                deviceFx(() -> studioState.syncStatusProperty().set(message));
+            }
+        });
+
+        displayConfigService = new com.example.ahakey.service.DisplayConfigService(studioState, bleManager);
+        k1RouteService = new com.example.ahakey.service.K1RouteService(studioState, bleManager);
+        displayConfigService.setErrorHandler(message -> showOledWarning("显示配置", message));
+        if (platformServicesEnabled) {
+            voiceRelay.configure(() -> studioState, deviceStatus::getWorkMode);
+            refreshVoiceRoutes();
+            voiceRelay.start();
+        }
+
+        Runnable onDraftChange = () -> {
+            persistDraft();
+            refreshVoiceRoutes();
+        };
+        studioState.revisionProperty().addListener((o, a, b) -> onDraftChange.run());
+        studioState.selectedModeProperty().addListener((o, a, b) -> onDraftChange.run());
+
+        // 启动 Hook 分发服务器（接收 Codex/Claude/Cursor/Kimi hook 事件 → BLE 状态码）
+        aiRuntimeDisplayService = new AiRuntimeDisplayService(bleManager);
+        hookDispatchServer = new HookDispatchServer(bleManager, aiRuntimeDisplayService);
+        aiRuntimeHookInstaller = new HookInstaller(hookDispatchServer::getActualPort, msg -> logger.info("{}", msg));
+        if (platformServicesEnabled) aiRuntimeDisplayService.startCursorMonitoring();
+        if (platformServicesEnabled) hookDispatchServer.start();
+
+        // Hold 9000 throughout application lifetime; disconnected/unknown means native defer.
+        kimiAhaKeyBridge = bridgeFactory.apply(bleManager);
+        kimiAhaKeyBridge.setProblemHandler(message -> {
+            if (Platform.isFxApplicationThread()) kimiApprovalProblem.set(message);
+            else Platform.runLater(() -> kimiApprovalProblem.set(message));
+        });
+        if (platformServicesEnabled) kimiAhaKeyBridge.start();
+        Path updates = Path.of(System.getProperty("user.home"), ".ahakey", "updates");
+        var firmware = com.example.ahakey.firmware.FirmwareUpdateService.production(bleManager, updates.resolve("firmware"), this::maintenanceChanged);
+        updateCenter = new com.example.ahakey.update.UpdateCenterService(bleManager, firmware, updates);
+    }

+    public void setAiRuntimeDisplayMode(AiRuntimeDisplayMode mode) {
+        if (studioState.displayConfig().busy.get() || studioState.displayConfig().loading.get()) {
+            studioState.syncStatusProperty().set("正在处理显示配置，展示模式未切换。"); return;
+        }
+        aiRuntimeDisplayService.setDisplayMode(mode, error -> studioState.syncStatusProperty().set(
+                error == null ? "AI 运行展示已切换为：" + mode.getTitle() : error));

+    private boolean isAiRuntimeHookLatest(String platform) {
+        return aiRuntimeHookInstaller.getHookStatus(platform) == HookInstaller.HookStatus.LATEST;
+    }
+
+    private boolean isAnyAiRuntimeHookLatest(boolean codexHookLatest, boolean cursorHookLatest) {
+        return codexHookLatest || cursorHookLatest;
+    }

+    public HookInstaller.HookStatus getAiRuntimeHookStatus(String platform) {
+        return aiRuntimeHookInstaller.getHookStatus(platform);

+            hookManagerOpener.run();
+        }

+    public void applyAiRuntimeToKeyboard(javafx.stage.Window owner) {
+        if (aiRuntimeDisplayService.getDisplayMode() != AiRuntimeDisplayMode.MULTI
+                || studioState.displayConfig().busy.get() || studioState.displayConfig().loading.get()
+                || aiRuntimeDisplayService.modeChangePendingProperty().get() || bleManager.isDisplayWriteUncertain()) return;
+        boolean applyingMulti = aiRuntimeDisplayService.getDisplayMode() == AiRuntimeDisplayMode.MULTI;
+        HookInstaller.HookStatus codexStatus = applyingMulti ? aiRuntimeHookInstaller.getHookStatus("Codex") : HookInstaller.HookStatus.LATEST;
+        HookInstaller.HookStatus cursorStatus = applyingMulti ? aiRuntimeHookInstaller.getHookStatus("Cursor") : HookInstaller.HookStatus.LATEST;
+        boolean codexHookLatest = codexStatus == HookInstaller.HookStatus.LATEST;
+        boolean cursorHookLatest = cursorStatus == HookInstaller.HookStatus.LATEST;
+        if (applyingMulti && !isAnyAiRuntimeHookLatest(codexHookLatest, cursorHookLatest)) {
+            javafx.scene.control.Alert alert = new javafx.scene.control.Alert(javafx.scene.control.Alert.AlertType.CONFIRMATION);
+            alert.initOwner(owner);
+            alert.setTitle("AhaKey Hook 管理");
+            alert.setHeaderText(null);
+            alert.setContentText("多任务灯光需要先在 Hook 管理中安装或更新 Codex / Cursor Hook。");
+            javafx.scene.control.ButtonType update = new javafx.scene.control.ButtonType("去 Hook 管理");
+            javafx.scene.control.ButtonType cancel = new javafx.scene.control.ButtonType("取消", javafx.scene.control.ButtonBar.ButtonData.CANCEL_CLOSE);
+            alert.getButtonTypes().setAll(update, cancel);
+            java.util.Optional<javafx.scene.control.ButtonType> result = alert.showAndWait();
+            if (result.isPresent() && result.get() == update) {
+                if (hookManagerOpener != null) {
+                    hookManagerOpener.run();
+                }
+            }
+            return;
+        }
+        if (applyingMulti) {
+            AiRuntimeDisplayService.ApplyPlan plan = aiRuntimeDisplayService.prepareApply(
+                codexHookLatest,
+                cursorHookLatest
+            );
+            if (plan.usableCount() == 0) {
+                javafx.scene.control.Alert alert = new javafx.scene.control.Alert(javafx.scene.control.Alert.AlertType.WARNING);
+                alert.initOwner(owner);
+                alert.setTitle("任务槽不可用");
+                alert.setHeaderText(null);
+                alert.setContentText("当前没有可应用到键盘的任务槽。请检查 Hook 状态或重新选择会话。");
+                alert.showAndWait();
+                return;
+            }
+            if (!plan.unavailableSlots().isEmpty()) {
+                StringBuilder message = new StringBuilder("以下任务槽当前不可用，将不会显示到键盘：");
+                for (AiRuntimeDisplayService.UnavailableSlot slot : plan.unavailableSlots()) {
+                    message.append("\n槽位 ").append(slot.slotIndex() + 1).append("：").append(slot.reason());
+                }
+                javafx.scene.control.Alert alert = new javafx.scene.control.Alert(javafx.scene.control.Alert.AlertType.INFORMATION);
+                alert.initOwner(owner);
+                alert.setTitle("任务槽不可用");
+                alert.setHeaderText(null);
+                alert.setContentText(message.toString());
+                alert.getButtonTypes().setAll(new javafx.scene.control.ButtonType("知道了"));
+                alert.showAndWait();
+            }
+        }
+        if (!simulateBle && !deviceStatus.isConnected()) {
+            studioState.syncStatusProperty().set("已保存本地槽位；连接键盘后可应用。");
+            return;
+        }
+        if (!simulateBle && !aiRuntimeDisplayService.isDeviceSupported()) {
+            String catalogKey = deviceStatus.getFirmwareCatalogKey();
+            if (catalogKey == null || catalogKey.isBlank()) {
+                studioState.syncStatusProperty().set("尚未读取到固件能力信息，已保留本地绑定。");
+            } else {
+                studioState.syncStatusProperty().set("当前固件未声明支持 WS3 CP1 多任务运行展示，已保留本地绑定。");
+            }
+            return;
+        }
+        if (simulateBle) {
+            aiRuntimeDisplayService.markDraftApplied(
+                codexHookLatest,
+                cursorHookLatest
+            );
+            studioState.syncStatusProperty().set("模拟模式：已标记为应用到键盘。");
+            return;
+        }
+        new Thread(() -> {
+            try {
+                aiRuntimeDisplayService.applyToKeyboard(
+                    codexHookLatest,
+                    cursorHookLatest
+                );
+                deviceFx(() -> {
+                    if (owner != null) {
+                        javafx.scene.control.Alert alert = new javafx.scene.control.Alert(javafx.scene.control.Alert.AlertType.INFORMATION);
+                        alert.initOwner(owner);
+                        alert.setTitle("已应用到键盘");
+                        alert.setHeaderText(null);
+                        alert.setContentText("键盘已确认接收当前任务槽配置。");
+                        alert.show();
+                    }
+                });
+                deviceFx(() -> studioState.syncStatusProperty().set("已应用到键盘。"));
+            } catch (Exception e) {
+                deviceFx(() -> {
+                    if (owner != null) {
+                        javafx.scene.control.Alert alert = new javafx.scene.control.Alert(javafx.scene.control.Alert.AlertType.ERROR);
+                        alert.initOwner(owner);
+                        alert.setTitle("应用到键盘失败");
+                        alert.setHeaderText(null);
+                        alert.setContentText("应用到键盘失败：" + e.getMessage());
+                        alert.showAndWait();
+                    }
+                });
+                deviceFx(() -> studioState.syncStatusProperty().set("应用到键盘失败：" + e.getMessage()));
+            }
+        }, "ai-runtime-apply").start();
+    }

+    public boolean isEffectivelyConnected() {
+        return deviceStatus.isConnected();
+    }
+
+    public boolean canWriteToDevice() {
+        return normalDeviceActionAllowed() && (simulateBle || deviceStatus.isConnected());
+    }

+    public boolean hasUnsyncedChanges() {
+        return studioState.getRevision() != lastSyncedRevision || studioState.getDirtyCount() > 0;
+    }

+    public void shutdown() {
+        try { simulationShutdown.run(); } catch (RuntimeException failure) { logger.warn("Key simulation cleanup failed", failure); }
+        aiRuntimeDisplayService.close();
+        updateCenter.close();
+        displayConfigService.close();
+        k1RouteService.close();
+        if (platformServicesEnabled) voiceRelay.stop();
+        stopStatusPolling();
+        hookDispatchServer.stop();
+        kimiAhaKeyBridge.close();
+        if (!simulateBle) {
+            bleManager.shutdownTransport();
+        }
+    }
+    
+    private synchronized void startStatusPolling() {
+        stopStatusPolling(); // 先停止之前的轮询
+        statusPoller = Executors.newSingleThreadScheduledExecutor(r -> {
+            Thread t = new Thread(r, "status-poller");
+            t.setDaemon(true);
+            return t;
+        });
+        // 从配置文件读取轮询周期，默认3秒
+        int pollPeriod = ModelConfig.getInstance().getStatusPollPeriodSeconds();
+        logger.info("设备状态轮询周期: {}秒", pollPeriod);
+        pollFuture = statusPoller.scheduleAtFixedRate(() -> {
+            if (normalDeviceActionAllowed() && !simulateBle && deviceStatus.isConnected()) {
+                try {
+                    bleManager.queryStatus();
+                    // 检查心跳超时：超过15秒没有收到状态更新，认为设备已断开
+                    long lastUpdate = bleManager.getLastStatusUpdateTime();
+                    if (lastUpdate > 0 && System.currentTimeMillis() - lastUpdate > 15000) {
+                        logger.warn("设备心跳超时，断开连接");
+                        bleManager.disconnect();
+                    }
+                } catch (Exception e) {
+                    logger.warn("轮询设备状态失败: {}", e.getMessage());
+                }
+            }
+        }, 2, pollPeriod, TimeUnit.SECONDS); // 延迟2秒后开始，按配置周期执行
+    }
+    
+    private synchronized void stopStatusPolling() {
+        if (pollFuture != null) {
+            pollFuture.cancel(true);
+            pollFuture = null;
+        }
+        if (statusPoller != null) {
+            statusPoller.shutdown();
+            statusPoller = null;
+        }
+    }
+
+    public void userConnect() {
+        if (!normalDeviceActionAllowed()) return;
+        logger.info("用户请求连接 - simulateBle: {}", simulateBle);
+        firmwareCatalogKeyRequested = false;
+        deviceStatus.clearFirmwareIdentity();
+        bleManager.clearCachedFirmwareIdentity();
+        if (simulateBle) {
+            logger.info("使用模拟模式，直接设置为已连接");
+            deviceStatus.setConnected(true);
+            deviceStatus.setScanning(false);
+            deviceStatus.setBatteryLevel(84);
+            deviceStatus.setDeviceName("AhaKey Keyboard (模拟)");
+            return;
+        }
+        logger.info("使用真实BLE连接");
+        deviceStatus.setScanning(true);
+        kimiAhaKeyBridge.prepareForConnection();
+        bleManager.connect();
+    }
+
+    public void userDisconnect() {
+        if (!normalDeviceActionAllowed()) return;
+        enterEditingAfterConnect = false;
+        bleManager.disconnect();
+    }
+
+    public void refreshDeviceInfoDetails() {
+        clearDeviceInfoDetailsForRefresh();
+        readFirmwareCatalogKeyForDeviceInfo();
+        refreshDeviceStatusSnapshot();
+    }
+
+    public void clearDeviceInfoDetailsForRefresh() {
+        if (!normalDeviceActionAllowed()) return;
+        firmwareCatalogKeyRequested = false;
+        deviceStatus.clearFirmwareIdentity();
+        bleManager.clearCachedFirmwareIdentity();
+    }
+
+    public void readFirmwareCatalogKeyForDeviceInfo() {
+        if (!normalDeviceActionAllowed()) return;
+        if (normalDeviceActionAllowed() && !simulateBle && deviceStatus.isConnected()) {
+            firmwareCatalogKeyRequested = true;
+            long generation = bleManager.connectionGeneration();
+            firmwareCatalogRequestGeneration = generation;
+            try {
+                bleManager.readFirmwareCatalogKey(generation);
+                handleFirmwareCatalogKey(bleManager.firmwareIdentity(), generation);
+            } catch (Exception e) {
+                logger.info("Firmware catalog key read skipped/fallback: {}", e.getMessage());
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    public void refreshDeviceStatusSnapshot() {
+        if (normalDeviceActionAllowed() && !simulateBle && deviceStatus.isConnected()) {
+            bleManager.queryStatusAndWait(1000);
+        }
+    }
+
+    public void selectKeyboardMode(ModeSlot mode) {
+        if (!normalDeviceActionAllowed()) return;
+        if (studioState.displayConfig().busy.get()) return;
+        if (mode == null) {
+            return;
+        }
+        if (studioState.modeSwitchingProperty().get()) {
+            studioState.syncStatusProperty().set("正在确认键盘模式，请稍候。");
+            return;
+        }
+        if (simulateBle) {
+            studioState.setSelectedMode(mode);
+            studioState.syncStatusProperty().set("模拟模式：已切换到 " + mode.getTitle() + "。");
+            return;
+        }
+        if (!deviceStatus.isConnected()) {
+            studioState.setSelectedMode(mode);
+            studioState.syncStatusProperty().set("离线浏览 " + mode.getTitle() + "，本地草稿已保留；连接键盘后可切换/保存。");
+            return;
+        }
+        ModeSlot previousMode = studioState.getSelectedMode();
+        if (previousMode == mode) {
+            studioState.syncStatusProperty().set("键盘已在 " + mode.getTitle() + "。");
+            return;
+        }
+        if (!modeSwitchInProgress.compareAndSet(false, true)) {
+            studioState.syncStatusProperty().set("正在确认键盘模式，请稍候。");
+            return;
+        }
+        studioState.modeSwitchingProperty().set(true);
+        pendingModeSwitchTarget = mode;
+        suppressModeStatusUntilMillis = 0;
+        studioState.setSelectedMode(mode);
+        studioState.syncStatusProperty().set("正在切换到 " + mode.getTitle() + "...");
+        Thread thread = new Thread(() -> {
+            try {
+                int confirmedIndex = bleManager.setWorkModeAndVerify(mode.getIndex());
+                if (bleManager.isFirmwareCapabilityAdmitted("side")) {
+                    try { bleManager.readSideSwitchConfig(); }
+                    catch (Exception unknown) { bleManager.invalidateSavedBindings(bleManager.connectionGeneration()); }
+                }
+                ModeSlot confirmedMode = ModeSlot.fromIndex(confirmedIndex);
+                deviceFx(() -> {
+                    deviceStatus.setWorkMode(confirmedIndex);
+                    studioState.setSelectedMode(confirmedMode);
+                    studioState.syncStatusProperty().set("已切换到 " + confirmedMode.getTitle() + "。");
+                    pendingModeSwitchTarget = confirmedMode;
+                    suppressModeStatusUntilMillis = System.currentTimeMillis() + MODE_SWITCH_STATUS_SETTLE_MS;
+                    studioState.modeSwitchingProperty().set(false);
+                    modeSwitchInProgress.set(false);
+                });
+            } catch (Exception e) {
+                logger.warn("Mode switch failed: target={}, previous={}, reason={}", mode, previousMode, e.getMessage());
+                deviceFx(() -> {
+                    ModeSlot authoritative = ModeSlot.fromIndex(deviceStatus.getWorkMode());
+                    DeviceStatus cached = bleManager.getCachedStatus();
+                    if (cached != null && cached.isConnected()) {
+                        authoritative = ModeSlot.fromIndex(cached.getWorkMode());
+                        deviceStatus.setWorkMode(cached.getWorkMode());
+                    }
+                    studioState.setSelectedMode(authoritative);
+                    if (!deviceStatus.isConnected() || !bleManager.isConnected()) {
+                        studioState.syncStatusProperty().set("连接中断，键盘模式未确认");
+                    } else {
+                        studioState.syncStatusProperty().set("未切换到 " + mode.getTitle() + "，键盘仍在 " + authoritative.getTitle() + "，请重试");
+                    }
+                    clearModeSwitchStatusGuard();
+                    studioState.modeSwitchingProperty().set(false);
+                    modeSwitchInProgress.set(false);
+                });
+            }
+        }, "mode-switch-confirm");
+        thread.setDaemon(true);
+        thread.start();
+    }
+
+    public void enterEditingConfiguration() {
+        if (!deviceStatus.isConnected() && !simulateBle) {
+            enterEditingAfterConnect = true;
+            studioState.syncStatusProperty().set("正在连接键盘以进入编辑配置...");
+            userConnect();
+            return;
+        }
+        activateConfigurationEditing();
+    }
+
+    private void activateConfigurationEditing() {
+        agentManager.setBluetoothOwner(AgentManager.BluetoothOwner.AHAKEY_STUDIO);
+        studioState.syncStatusProperty().set("已进入编辑配置模式。");
+        refreshVoiceRoutes();
+    }
+
+    public void finishEditingConfiguration() {
+        if (!hasUnsyncedChanges()) {
+            returnToKeyboardControl();
+            return;
+        }
+        if (deviceStatus.isConnected() || simulateBle) {
+            syncAllModes(true);
+        } else {
+            studioState.syncStatusProperty().set("连接键盘后可保存/应用");
+        }
+    }
+
+    public void returnToKeyboardControl() {
+        agentManager.setBluetoothOwner(AgentManager.BluetoothOwner.KEYBOARD_DEVICE);
+        studioState.syncStatusProperty().set("已交还控制权给键盘设备，连接保持。");
+        // 保持 BLE 连接不断开，避免用户需要重新连接
+    }

+    public void syncAllModes(boolean returnToAgentWhenDone) {
+        if (!normalDeviceActionAllowed()) return;
+        if (simulateBle) { syncAllModesAfterK1(returnToAgentWhenDone); return; }
+        k1RouteService.saveDirty(() -> syncAllModesAfterK1(returnToAgentWhenDone),
+                message -> studioState.syncStatusProperty().set(message));

+    private void syncAllModesAfterK1(boolean returnToAgentWhenDone) {
+        if (!normalDeviceActionAllowed()) return;
+        if (studioState.displayConfig().busy.get() || bleManager.isDisplayWriteUncertain()) {
+            studioState.syncStatusProperty().set("显示配置事务尚未结束，暂不能保存其他配置。");
+            return;
+        }
+        if (!deviceStatus.isConnected() && !simulateBle) {
+            studioState.syncStatusProperty().set("连接键盘后可保存/应用");
+            return;
+        }
+        if (simulateBle) {
+            studioState.clearDirtyAfterSync();
+            lastSyncedRevision = studioState.getRevision();
+            studioState.syncStatusProperty().set("模拟模式：已标记为保存。");
+            if (returnToAgentWhenDone) {
+                returnToKeyboardControl();
+            }
+            return;
+        }
+
+        final AutoCloseable saveTransaction;
+        try { saveTransaction = bleManager.maintenance().normalTransaction(); }
+        catch (Exception busy) { studioState.syncStatusProperty().set(busy.getMessage()); return; }
+        String transport;
+        try {
+            transport = bleManager.selectPreferredTransport();
+        } catch (Exception e) {
+            closeTransaction(saveTransaction);
+            studioState.syncStatusProperty().set("连接不可用，请重新连接键盘后再保存。");
+            return;
+        }
+
+        var legacyK1 = k1RouteService.legacySnapshot();
+        long saveGeneration = bleManager.connectionGeneration();
+        var savedSideDraft = DeviceStatus.copyBindings(studioState.getSideSwitchConfig());
+        boolean saveSideDirty = studioState.isDirty(StudioPart.TOGGLE_SWITCH);
+        var commands = DeviceSyncService.commandsForModes(studioState,
+                studioState.k1Routes().capability.get() != com.example.ahakey.model.K1RouteState.Capability.LEGACY, ModeSlot.values());
+        commands.removeIf(command -> command.data()[2] == AhaKeyProtocol.CMD_SET_AI_LIGHT_CONFIG
+                || command.data()[2] == AhaKeyProtocol.CMD_SET_LIGHT_BRIGHTNESS);
+        if(studioState.k1Routes().capability.get()==com.example.ahakey.model.K1RouteState.Capability.LEGACY)
+            commands.removeIf(command -> command.data()[2]==0x73 && command.data()[5]==0
+                    && legacyK1.stream().noneMatch(edit -> edit.mode()==(command.data()[4]&255)));
+        studioState.syncingProperty().set(true);
+        studioState.syncStatusProperty().set("正在通过 " + transport + " 写入设备配置...");
+        studioState.syncStatusProperty().set("正在写入设备配置...");
+        studioState.syncStatusProperty().set("Saving via " + transport + "...");
+        int syncRevision = studioState.getRevision();
+        new Thread(() -> {
+            try {
+                Thread.sleep(45000);
+            } catch (InterruptedException ignored) {
+                Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
+            }
+            if (studioState.syncingProperty().get() && studioState.getRevision() == syncRevision) {
+                deviceFx(() -> {
+                    studioState.syncingProperty().set(false);
+                    studioState.syncStatusProperty().set("保存超时，请重新连接键盘后再保存。");
+                });
+            }
+        }, "device-sync-watchdog").start();
+        DeviceSyncService.writeSequentially(
+            bleManager,
+            commands,
+            () -> new Thread(() -> {
+                try { k1RouteService.verifyLegacy(legacyK1, saveGeneration); }
+                catch (Exception failure) {
+                    Platform.runLater(() -> { studioState.syncingProperty().set(false); studioState.syncStatusProperty().set("K1保存未确认：" + failure.getMessage()); closeTransaction(saveTransaction); });
+                    return;
+                }
+                Platform.runLater(() -> {
+                if (studioState.isCp4cInputConfigEnabled()) {
+                    verifyCp4cInputSave(returnToAgentWhenDone, saveTransaction, legacyK1, saveGeneration, savedSideDraft, saveSideDirty, syncRevision);
+                } else {
+                    k1RouteService.confirmLegacy(legacyK1, saveGeneration);
+                    studioState.clearDirtyAfterSync();
+                    lastSyncedRevision = studioState.getRevision();
+                    studioState.syncingProperty().set(false);
+                    studioState.syncStatusProperty().set("已保存其他配置。" + k1SaveSummary());
+                    closeTransaction(saveTransaction);
+                    bleManager.queryStatus();
+                    if (returnToAgentWhenDone) {
+                        returnToKeyboardControl();
+                    }
+                }
+                });
+            }, "legacy-k1-save-verify").start(),
+            () -> Platform.runLater(() -> { studioState.syncingProperty().set(false); closeTransaction(saveTransaction); }),
+            msg -> deviceFx(() -> studioState.syncStatusProperty().set(msg))
+        );
+    }

+    public void refreshDisplayCapabilities() {
+        long generation = bleManager.connectionGeneration();
+        long taskEpoch = bleManager.maintenance().epoch();
+        new Thread(() -> {
+            try (var readTransaction = bleManager.maintenance().normalTransaction()) {
+                if (taskEpoch != bleManager.maintenance().epoch()) return;
+                if (!bleManager.isDisplayAdmitted()) {
+                    bleManager.readFirmwareCatalogKey(generation);
+                    handleFirmwareCatalogKey(bleManager.firmwareIdentity(), generation);
+                }
+                var identity = bleManager.firmwareIdentity();
+                deviceFx(() -> {
+                    if (generation == bleManager.connectionGeneration() && bleManager.isCurrentIdentity(identity))
+                        displayConfigService.capabilityChanged();
+                });
+            } catch (Exception e) { logger.info("Firmware refresh: {}", e.getMessage()); }
+        }, "display-capability-refresh").start();
+    }

+    private void applyBleStatus(DeviceStatus status) {
+        logger.info("应用BLE状态 - 电量: {}, 工作模式: {}, 拨杆状态: {}", 
+            status.getBatteryLevel(), 
+            status.getWorkMode(), 
+            status.getSwitchState());
+        deviceStatus.setConnected(status.isConnected());
+        deviceStatus.setScanning(false);
+        deviceStatus.setBatteryLevel(status.getBatteryLevel());
+        deviceStatus.setDeviceName(status.getDeviceName());
+        deviceStatus.setFirmwareMain(status.getFirmwareMain());
+        deviceStatus.setFirmwareSub(status.getFirmwareSub());
+        deviceStatus.setFirmwareCatalogKey(status.getFirmwareCatalogKey());
+        deviceStatus.setIdentityState(bleManager.firmwareIdentity().state());
+        deviceStatus.setSwitchState(status.getSwitchState());
+        deviceStatus.setSavedBindings(status.getSavedBindings());
+        requestFirmwareCatalogKeyAfterConnect();
+        displayConfigService.connectionChanged();
+        k1RouteService.connectionChanged();
+        ModeSlot deviceMode = ModeSlot.fromIndex(status.getWorkMode());
+        ModeSlot previousMode = studioState.getSelectedMode();
+        boolean suppressModeStatus = status.isConnected() && shouldSuppressModeStatus(deviceMode);
+        if (!suppressModeStatus) {
+            deviceStatus.setWorkMode(status.getWorkMode());
+            deviceStatus.setSavedBindings(status.getSavedBindings());
+        }
+        if (status.isConnected() && deviceMode != previousMode && !suppressModeStatus && !studioState.displayConfig().busy.get()) {
+            studioState.setSelectedMode(deviceMode);
+            clearModeSwitchStatusGuard();
+            if (studioState.hasUnsavedDraft(previousMode)) {
+                studioState.syncStatusProperty().set("键盘已切到 " + deviceMode.getTitle() + "，" + previousMode.getTitle() + " 的未保存草稿已保留");
+            } else {
+                studioState.syncStatusProperty().set("键盘已切到 " + deviceMode.getTitle() + "。");
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    private boolean shouldSuppressModeStatus(ModeSlot deviceMode) {
+        ModeSlot target = pendingModeSwitchTarget;
+        if (target == null) {
+            return false;
+        }
+        if (deviceMode == target) {
+            if (!modeSwitchInProgress.get() && System.currentTimeMillis() >= suppressModeStatusUntilMillis) {
+                clearModeSwitchStatusGuard();
+            }
+            return false;
+        }
+        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
+        return modeSwitchInProgress.get() || now < suppressModeStatusUntilMillis;
+    }
+
+    private void clearModeSwitchStatusGuard() {
+        pendingModeSwitchTarget = null;
+        suppressModeStatusUntilMillis = 0;
+    }
+
+    private void requestFirmwareCatalogKeyAfterConnect() {
+        if (!normalDeviceActionAllowed()) return;
+        long generation = bleManager.connectionGeneration();
+        if (!deviceStatus.isConnected() || (firmwareCatalogKeyRequested && firmwareCatalogRequestGeneration == generation)
+                || !deviceStatus.getFirmwareCatalogKey().isBlank()) {
+            return;
+        }
+        firmwareCatalogKeyRequested = true;
+        firmwareCatalogRequestGeneration = generation;
+        long taskEpoch = bleManager.maintenance().epoch();
+        new Thread(() -> {
+            try (var readTransaction = bleManager.maintenance().normalTransaction()) {
+                if (taskEpoch != bleManager.maintenance().epoch()) return;
+                bleManager.readFirmwareCatalogKey(generation);
+                handleFirmwareCatalogKey(bleManager.firmwareIdentity(), generation);
+            } catch (Exception e) {
+                logger.info("Firmware catalog key read skipped/fallback: {}", e.getMessage());
+                var identity = bleManager.firmwareIdentity();
+                deviceFx(() -> {
+                    if (generation == bleManager.connectionGeneration() && bleManager.isCurrentIdentity(identity)
+                            && !bleManager.isDisplayAdmitted()) studioState.setCp4cInputConfigEnabled(false);
+                });
+            }
+        }, "firmware-catalog-key-connect-read").start();
+    }
+
+    private void handleFirmwareCatalogKey(BleManager.FirmwareIdentity identity, long generation) {
+        deviceFx(() -> {
+            if (identity.generation() != generation || !bleManager.isCurrentIdentity(identity) || identity == handledFirmwareIdentity) return;
+            handledFirmwareIdentity = identity;
+            displayConfigService.capabilityChanged();
+            k1RouteService.refresh();
+            if (!bleManager.isFirmwareCapabilityAdmitted("keys") || !bleManager.isFirmwareCapabilityAdmitted("side")) {
+                studioState.setCp4cInputConfigEnabled(false);
+                return;
+            }
+            studioState.setCp4cInputConfigEnabled(true);
+            studioState.setInputReadbackStatus("已识别 CP4C 固件，正在读取输入配置...");
+            aiRuntimeDisplayService.onDeviceReady();
+            startCp4cInputReadback(identity.catalogKey());
+        });
+    }
+
+    private void startCp4cInputReadback(String catalogKey) {
+        if (!normalDeviceActionAllowed()) return;
+        if (!cp4cInputReadbackInProgress.compareAndSet(false, true)) {
+            return;
+        }
+        long taskGeneration = bleManager.connectionGeneration();
+        long taskEpoch = bleManager.maintenance().epoch();
+        new Thread(() -> {
+            try (var readTransaction = bleManager.maintenance().normalTransaction()) {
+                if (taskEpoch != bleManager.maintenance().epoch()) return;
+                deviceFx(taskGeneration, () -> studioState.setInputReadbackInProgress(true));
+                AhaKeyResponseParser.SideSwitchConfig sideSwitch = bleManager.readSideSwitchConfig(taskGeneration);
+                deviceFx(taskGeneration, () -> {
+                    studioState.applySideSwitchReadback(sideSwitch);
+                    studioState.setInputFailureStatus("");
+                    studioState.setInputReadbackStatus("已读取侧拨配置，正在读取当前模式普通键...");
+                });
+
+                ModeSlot currentMode = ModeSlot.fromIndex(deviceStatus.getWorkMode());
+                boolean ordinaryReadbackComplete = readCp4cModeKeys(catalogKey, currentMode);
+                for (ModeSlot mode : ModeSlot.values()) {
+                    if (mode != currentMode) {
+                        ordinaryReadbackComplete &= readCp4cModeKeys(catalogKey, mode);
+                    }
+                }
+                boolean finalOrdinaryReadbackComplete = ordinaryReadbackComplete;
+                deviceFx(taskGeneration, () -> {
+                    studioState.setInputReadbackInProgress(false);
+                    if (!finalOrdinaryReadbackComplete) {
+                        studioState.setInputReadbackStatus("已读取侧拨配置，部分普通键未完整读回。");
+                        studioState.setInputFailureStatus("部分普通键配置读取失败；相关键位保持未确认状态。");
+                        return;
+                    }
+                    studioState.setInputFailureStatus("");
+                    studioState.setInputReadbackStatus("已读取 CP4C 输入配置。");
+                });
+            } catch (Exception e) {
+                logCp4cInputIssue(catalogKey, "0x97/0x87", -1, -1, "connect-readback", e.getMessage());
+                deviceFx(taskGeneration, () -> {
+                    studioState.setInputReadbackInProgress(false);
+                    studioState.setInputFailureStatus("输入配置读取失败：" + e.getMessage());
+                    studioState.syncStatusProperty().set("输入配置读取失败，旧草稿已保留。");
+                });
+            } finally {
+                cp4cInputReadbackInProgress.set(false);
+            }
+        }, "cp4c-input-readback").start();
+    }
+
+    private boolean readCp4cModeKeys(String catalogKey, ModeSlot mode) {
+        boolean complete = true;
+        for (StudioPart part : new StudioPart[]{StudioPart.KEY1, StudioPart.KEY2, StudioPart.KEY3, StudioPart.KEY4}) {
+            int keyIndex = StudioState.keyIndexFor(part);
+            try {
+                AhaKeyResponseParser.OrdinaryKeyReadback readback = bleManager.readOrdinaryKeyConfig(mode.getIndex(), keyIndex);
+                deviceFx(() -> studioState.applyOrdinaryKeyReadback(readback));
+            } catch (Exception e) {
+                logCp4cInputIssue(catalogKey, "0x87", mode.getIndex(), keyIndex, "connect-readback", e.getMessage());
+                complete = false;
+            }
+        }
+        if (complete) {
+            deviceFx(() -> studioState.markInputModeRead(mode));
+        }
+        return complete;
+    }
+
+    private void verifyCp4cInputSave(boolean returnToAgentWhenDone, AutoCloseable saveTransaction,
+                                   java.util.List<com.example.ahakey.service.K1RouteService.LegacyEdit> legacyK1, long saveGeneration,
+                                   AhaKeyResponseParser.SideSwitchConfig savedSideDraft, boolean saveSideDirty, int syncRevision) {
+        new Thread(() -> {
+            String catalogKey = deviceStatus.getFirmwareCatalogKey();
+            try {
+                deviceFx(() -> studioState.syncStatusProperty().set("正在回读确认 CP4C 输入配置..."));
+                if (saveSideDirty) {
+                    bleManager.writeSideSwitchConfig(savedSideDraft, saveGeneration);
+                }
+                verifyCp4cSideSwitch(catalogKey, savedSideDraft, saveGeneration);
+                verifyCp4cOrdinaryKeys(catalogKey);
+                Platform.runLater(() -> {
+                    if (saveGeneration != bleManager.connectionGeneration()) { closeTransaction(saveTransaction); return; }
+                    k1RouteService.confirmLegacy(legacyK1, saveGeneration);
+                    boolean newerDraft = studioState.getRevision() != syncRevision;
+                    if (!newerDraft) studioState.clearDirtyAfterSync();
+                    lastSyncedRevision = studioState.getRevision();
+                    studioState.syncingProperty().set(false);
+                    studioState.setInputFailureStatus("");
+                    studioState.syncStatusProperty().set(!newerDraft
+                        ? "已保存配置，并完成输入回读确认。" + k1SaveSummary()
+                        : "已保存开始时的配置，新编辑的草稿仍未保存。");
+                    closeTransaction(saveTransaction);
+                    bleManager.queryStatus();
+                    if (returnToAgentWhenDone) {
+                        returnToKeyboardControl();
+                    }
+                });
+            } catch (Exception e) {
+                bleManager.invalidateSavedBindings(saveGeneration);
+                Platform.runLater(() -> {
+                    if (saveGeneration != bleManager.connectionGeneration()) { closeTransaction(saveTransaction); return; }
+                    studioState.syncingProperty().set(false);
+                    closeTransaction(saveTransaction);
+                    studioState.setInputFailureStatus("保存后回读确认失败：" + e.getMessage());
+                    studioState.syncStatusProperty().set("保存未确认：" + e.getMessage() + "。未确认草稿已保留。");
+                });
+            }
+        }, "cp4c-input-save-verify").start();
+    }
+
+    private void verifyCp4cSideSwitch(String catalogKey, AhaKeyResponseParser.SideSwitchConfig expected, long generation) throws Exception {
+        AhaKeyResponseParser.SideSwitchConfig actual;
+        try {
+            actual = bleManager.readSideSwitchConfig(generation);
+        } catch (Exception e) {
+            logCp4cInputIssue(catalogKey, "0x97", -1, -1, "save-readback", e.getMessage());
+            throw e;
+        }
+        if (!sideSwitchConfigMatches(expected, actual)) {
+            logCp4cInputIssue(catalogKey, "0x97", -1, -1, "save-compare", "side switch mismatch");
+            bleManager.invalidateSavedBindings(generation);
+            throw new IllegalStateException("侧拨配置回读不匹配");
+        }
+        deviceFx(generation, () -> studioState.applySideSwitchReadback(actual));
+    }
+
+    private void verifyCp4cOrdinaryKeys(String catalogKey) throws Exception {
+        for (ModeSlot mode : ModeSlot.values()) {
+            for (StudioPart part : new StudioPart[]{StudioPart.KEY1, StudioPart.KEY2, StudioPart.KEY3, StudioPart.KEY4}) {
+                if (part == StudioPart.KEY1) continue; // Verified against the captured K1 revision, never a newer draft.
+                int keyIndex = StudioState.keyIndexFor(part);
+                AhaKeyResponseParser.OrdinaryKeyReadback readback;
+                try {
+                    readback = bleManager.readOrdinaryKeyConfig(mode.getIndex(), keyIndex);
+                } catch (Exception e) {
+                    logCp4cInputIssue(catalogKey, "0x87", mode.getIndex(), keyIndex, "save-readback", e.getMessage());
+                    throw e;
+                }
+                if (!DeviceSyncService.matchesReadback(studioState.getKeyConfig(mode, part), readback)) {
+                    logCp4cInputIssue(catalogKey, "0x87", mode.getIndex(), keyIndex, "save-compare", "ordinary key mismatch");
+                    throw new IllegalStateException(mode.getTitle() + " " + part.getTitle() + " 回读不匹配");
+                }
+                deviceFx(() -> studioState.applyOrdinaryKeyReadback(readback));
+            }
+            deviceFx(() -> studioState.markInputModeRead(mode));
+        }
+    }
+    private String k1SaveSummary() {
+        var routes = studioState.k1Routes();
+        if (routes.capability.get() == com.example.ahakey.model.K1RouteState.Capability.LEGACY) return "";
+        return routes.confirmed(studioState.getSelectedMode().getIndex()) ? "未编辑的K1路由保持。" : "K1尚未确认，未写入K1。";
+    }
+
+    private boolean sideSwitchConfigMatches(AhaKeyResponseParser.SideSwitchConfig expected, AhaKeyResponseParser.SideSwitchConfig actual) {
+        return sideSwitchPositionMatches(expected.up(), actual.up())
+            && sideSwitchPositionMatches(expected.down(), actual.down());
+    }
+
+    private boolean sideSwitchPositionMatches(
+        AhaKeyResponseParser.SideSwitchPositionConfig expected,
+        AhaKeyResponseParser.SideSwitchPositionConfig actual
+    ) {
+        return expected.binding() == actual.binding()
+            && java.util.Arrays.equals(expected.actionPayload(), actual.actionPayload());
+    }
+
+    private void logCp4cInputIssue(String catalogKey, String cmd, int mode, int keyIndex, String phase, String reason) {
+        logger.warn("CP4C_INPUT_FAILURE catalogKey={} cmd={} mode={} keyIndex={} phase={} reason={}",
+            catalogKey, cmd, mode, keyIndex, phase, reason);
+    }
+
+    private void persistDraft() {
+        StudioStore.save(studioState.toPersisted());
+    }
+}

+public class DeviceStatus {
+    public enum IdentityState { DISCONNECTED, UNKNOWN, READING, SUPPORTED, UNSUPPORTED, FAILED }
+    private final ObjectProperty<IdentityState> identityState = new SimpleObjectProperty<>(IdentityState.DISCONNECTED);
+    public IdentityState getIdentityState() { return identityState.get(); }

+    private static final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(DeviceStatus.class);
+    private final BooleanProperty isConnected = new SimpleBooleanProperty(false);
+    private final BooleanProperty isScanning = new SimpleBooleanProperty(false);
+    private final IntegerProperty batteryLevel = new SimpleIntegerProperty(-1);
+    private final IntegerProperty signal = new SimpleIntegerProperty(-1);
+    private final IntegerProperty firmwareMain = new SimpleIntegerProperty(-1);
+    private final IntegerProperty firmwareSub = new SimpleIntegerProperty(-1);
+    private final IntegerProperty workMode = new SimpleIntegerProperty(0);
+    private final IntegerProperty lightMode = new SimpleIntegerProperty(0);
+    private final IntegerProperty lightBrightness = new SimpleIntegerProperty(35);
+    private final IntegerProperty switchState = new SimpleIntegerProperty(-1);
+    private final StringProperty deviceName = new SimpleStringProperty("");
+    private final StringProperty firmwareCatalogKey = new SimpleStringProperty("");

+    public boolean isConnected() { return isConnected.get(); }
+    public boolean isScanning() { return isScanning.get(); }
+    public int getBatteryLevel() { return batteryLevel.get(); }
+    public int getSignal() { return signal.get(); }
+    public int getFirmwareMain() { return firmwareMain.get(); }
+    public int getFirmwareSub() { return firmwareSub.get(); }
+    public int getWorkMode() { return workMode.get(); }
+    public int getLightMode() { return lightMode.get(); }
+    public int getLightBrightness() { return lightBrightness.get(); }
+    public int getSwitchState() { return switchState.get(); }
+    public String getDeviceName() { return deviceName.get(); }
+    public String getFirmwareCatalogKey() { return firmwareCatalogKey.get(); }
+    
+    // Property getters
+    public BooleanProperty isConnectedProperty() { return isConnected; }
+    public BooleanProperty isScanningProperty() { return isScanning; }
+    public IntegerProperty batteryLevelProperty() { return batteryLevel; }
+    public IntegerProperty signalProperty() { return signal; }
+    public IntegerProperty firmwareMainProperty() { return firmwareMain; }
+    public IntegerProperty firmwareSubProperty() { return firmwareSub; }
+    public IntegerProperty workModeProperty() { return workMode; }
+    public IntegerProperty lightModeProperty() { return lightMode; }
+    public IntegerProperty lightBrightnessProperty() { return lightBrightness; }
+    public IntegerProperty switchStateProperty() { return switchState; }
+    public StringProperty deviceNameProperty() { return deviceName; }
+    public StringProperty firmwareCatalogKeyProperty() { return firmwareCatalogKey; }
+    
+    // Setters
+    public void setConnected(boolean value) { if (!value) clearSavedBindings(); isConnected.set(value); }
+    public void setScanning(boolean value) { isScanning.set(value); }
+    public void setBatteryLevel(int value) { batteryLevel.set(value); }
+    public void setSignal(int value) { signal.set(value); }
+    public void setFirmwareMain(int value) { firmwareMain.set(value); }
+    public void setFirmwareSub(int value) { firmwareSub.set(value); }
+    public void setWorkMode(int value) { if (workMode.get() != value) clearSavedBindings(); workMode.set(value); }
+    public void setLightMode(int value) { lightMode.set(value); }
+    public void setLightBrightness(int value) { lightBrightness.set(value); }
+    public void setSwitchState(int value) { 
+        logger.debug("[DeviceStatus] setSwitchState - 旧值: {}, 新值: {}", switchState.get(), value);
+        switchState.set(value); 
+    }
+    public void setDeviceName(String value) { deviceName.set(value); }
+    public void setFirmwareCatalogKey(String value) { firmwareCatalogKey.set(value == null ? "" : value); }
+    public void clearFirmwareIdentity() {
+        clearSavedBindings();
+        firmwareMain.set(-1);
+        firmwareSub.set(-1);
+        firmwareCatalogKey.set("");
+        identityState.set(isConnected() ? IdentityState.UNKNOWN : IdentityState.DISCONNECTED);
+    }
+    
+    // Convenience methods
+    private final ObjectProperty<com.example.ahakey.protocol.AhaKeyResponseParser.SideSwitchConfig> savedBindings = new SimpleObjectProperty<>();
+    public ObjectProperty<com.example.ahakey.protocol.AhaKeyResponseParser.SideSwitchConfig> savedBindingsProperty() { return savedBindings; }
+    public com.example.ahakey.protocol.AhaKeyResponseParser.SideSwitchConfig getSavedBindings() { return copyBindings(savedBindings.get()); }
+    public static com.example.ahakey.protocol.AhaKeyResponseParser.SideSwitchConfig copyBindings(com.example.ahakey.protocol.AhaKeyResponseParser.SideSwitchConfig config) {
+        if (config == null) return null;
+        return new com.example.ahakey.protocol.AhaKeyResponseParser.SideSwitchConfig(config.physicalPosition(),
+            new com.example.ahakey.protocol.AhaKeyResponseParser.SideSwitchPositionConfig(config.up().binding(), config.up().actionPayload().clone()),
+            new com.example.ahakey.protocol.AhaKeyResponseParser.SideSwitchPositionConfig(config.down().binding(), config.down().actionPayload().clone()));
+    }
+    public void setSavedBindings(com.example.ahakey.protocol.AhaKeyResponseParser.SideSwitchConfig config) { savedBindings.set(copyBindings(config)); }
+    public void clearSavedBindings() { savedBindings.set(null); }
+    public boolean isAutoApproval() {
+        var config = savedBindings.get();
+        int position = getSwitchState();
+        return isConnected() && config != null && getWorkMode() >= 0 && getWorkMode() <= 3 && (position == 0 || position == 1)
+            && (position == 0 ? config.up() : config.down()).binding() == com.example.ahakey.protocol.AhaKeyProtocol.SIDE_SWITCH_BINDING_AUTO;
+    }
+    public String getSwitchTitle() {
+        if (!isConnected()) return "未连接 · 动作未知";
+        int position = getSwitchState();
+        if (position != 0 && position != 1) return "位置未知 · 动作未知";
+        String prefix = position == 0 ? "上拨 · " : "下拨 · ";
+        var config = savedBindings.get();
+        if (config == null) return prefix + "动作未知";
+        var action = position == 0 ? config.up() : config.down();
+        return prefix + switch (action.binding()) {
+            case com.example.ahakey.protocol.AhaKeyProtocol.SIDE_SWITCH_BINDING_AUTO -> "自动批准";
+            case com.example.ahakey.protocol.AhaKeyProtocol.SIDE_SWITCH_BINDING_MANUAL -> "手动批准";
+            case com.example.ahakey.protocol.AhaKeyProtocol.SIDE_SWITCH_BINDING_DISABLED -> "无动作";
+            case com.example.ahakey.protocol.AhaKeyProtocol.SIDE_SWITCH_BINDING_CUSTOM ->
+                com.example.ahakey.service.DeviceSyncService.sideSwitchActionSummary(action.actionPayload());
+            default -> "动作未知";
+        };
+    }
+
+    public String getDisplayDeviceName() {
+        String name = deviceName.get();
+        if (name == null || name.isBlank()) {
+            return LanguageManager.getInstance().getString("status.waiting-device");
+        }
+        return name;
+    }
+
+    public String getDisplayFirmwareVersion() {
+        if (!isConnected()) return "未知（未连接）";
+        String catalogKey = firmwareCatalogKey.get();
+        if (catalogKey != null && !catalogKey.isBlank()) {
+            return catalogKey;
+        }
+        int main = firmwareMain.get();
+        int sub = firmwareSub.get();
+        if (main >= 0 && sub >= 0) {
+            return "V" + main + "." + sub + "（完整标识未读到）";
+        }
+        return "未知（未读到）";
+    }
+}

+package com.example.ahakey.model;

+import javafx.beans.property.BooleanProperty;
+import javafx.beans.property.IntegerProperty;
+import javafx.beans.property.ObjectProperty;
+import javafx.beans.property.SimpleBooleanProperty;
+import javafx.beans.property.SimpleIntegerProperty;
+import javafx.beans.property.SimpleObjectProperty;
+import javafx.beans.property.SimpleStringProperty;
+import javafx.beans.property.StringProperty;
+import com.example.ahakey.protocol.AhaKeyProtocol;
+import com.example.ahakey.protocol.AhaKeyResponseParser;
+import com.example.ahakey.service.DeviceSyncService;
+
+import java.time.LocalDateTime;
+import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter;
+import java.util.EnumMap;
+import java.util.EnumSet;
+import java.util.List;
+import java.util.Map;
+
+public class StudioState {
+    private final K1RouteState k1Routes = new K1RouteState();
+    public K1RouteState k1Routes() { return k1Routes; }
+    public void applyK1Route(int mode, K1Route route) {
+        applyK1Route(mode,route,getKeyConfig(ModeSlot.fromIndex(mode),StudioPart.KEY1).getDescription());
+    }
+    public void applyK1Route(int mode, K1Route route, String description) {
+        k1Routes.observed(mode, route);
+        k1Routes.observedDescription(mode,description);
+        if (!k1Routes.dirty(mode)) {
+            ModeSlot slot = ModeSlot.fromIndex(mode);
+            KeyConfig previous = getKeyConfig(slot, StudioPart.KEY1);
+            KeyConfig key = route.consumer() ? previous : DeviceSyncService.keyConfigFromActionPayload(route.action(), route.actionType() == 0x74);
+            key.setDescription(description==null?previous.getDescription():description);
+            keyConfigs.get(slot).put(StudioPart.KEY1, key);
+        }
+        markInputBaselineChanged();
+    }
+    private final DisplayConfigState displayConfig = new DisplayConfigState();
+    public DisplayConfigState displayConfig() { return displayConfig; }
+    private static final DateTimeFormatter SYNC_TIME_FORMAT = DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("HH:mm");
+
+    private final ObjectProperty<ModeSlot> selectedMode = new SimpleObjectProperty<>(ModeSlot.MODE0);
+    private final ObjectProperty<StudioPart> selectedPart = new SimpleObjectProperty<>(StudioPart.KEY1);
+    private final IntegerProperty dirtyCount = new SimpleIntegerProperty(0);
+    private final IntegerProperty revision = new SimpleIntegerProperty(0);
+    private final StringProperty syncStatus = new SimpleStringProperty("修改会先保存在本地，保存配置后写入键盘。");
+    private final StringProperty lastSyncSummary = new SimpleStringProperty("尚未保存");
+    private final BooleanProperty syncing = new SimpleBooleanProperty(false);
+    private final BooleanProperty modeSwitching = new SimpleBooleanProperty(false);
+    private final BooleanProperty ahaTypeEnabled = new SimpleBooleanProperty(true);
+    private final StringProperty ahaTypeStatus = new SimpleStringProperty("云端整理已启用");
+    private final ObjectProperty<LightBarPreviewState> lightBarPreview =
+        new SimpleObjectProperty<>(LightBarPreviewState.AI_RUNNING);
+    private final IntegerProperty lightBrightness = new SimpleIntegerProperty(35);
+
+    private final Map<ModeSlot, EnumMap<StudioPart, KeyConfig>> keyConfigs = new EnumMap<>(ModeSlot.class);
+    private final Map<ModeSlot, StringProperty> oledSummaries = new EnumMap<>(ModeSlot.class);
+    private final Map<ModeSlot, StringProperty> oledCaptions = new EnumMap<>(ModeSlot.class);
+    private final Map<ModeSlot, OledModeDraft> oledDrafts = new EnumMap<>(ModeSlot.class);
+    private final BooleanProperty uploadingOled = new SimpleBooleanProperty(false);
+    private final StringProperty oledUploadDetail = new SimpleStringProperty("");
+    private final Map<ModeSlot, StringProperty> lightBarSummaries = new EnumMap<>(ModeSlot.class);
+    private final Map<ModeSlot, EnumMap<IDEState, LightEffectStyle>> aiLightConfigs = new EnumMap<>(ModeSlot.class);
+    private final EnumSet<StudioPart> dirtyParts = EnumSet.noneOf(StudioPart.class);
+    private final EnumSet<ModeSlot> dirtyModes = EnumSet.noneOf(ModeSlot.class);
+    private final BooleanProperty cp4cInputConfigEnabled = new SimpleBooleanProperty(false);
+    private final BooleanProperty inputReadbackInProgress = new SimpleBooleanProperty(false);
+    private final IntegerProperty inputBaselineRevision = new SimpleIntegerProperty(0);
+    private final StringProperty inputReadbackStatus = new SimpleStringProperty("");
+    private final StringProperty inputFailureStatus = new SimpleStringProperty("");
+    private final EnumSet<ModeSlot> inputReadModes = EnumSet.noneOf(ModeSlot.class);
+    private AhaKeyResponseParser.SideSwitchConfig sideSwitchConfig = defaultSideSwitchConfig();
+
+    public StudioState() {
+        seedDefaults();
+    }
+
+    private void seedDefaults() {
+        for (ModeSlot mode : ModeSlot.values()) {
+            keyConfigs.put(mode, new EnumMap<>(StudioPart.class));
+            aiLightConfigs.put(mode, new EnumMap<>(IDEState.class));
+            resetModeDefaults(mode);
+        }
+    }
+
+    private KeyConfig createKey(int hidCode, String description) {
+        return new KeyConfig(hidCode, description);
+    }
+
+    private KeyConfig createVoiceKey(int hidCode, String description, VoicePreset preset) {
+        KeyConfig key = new KeyConfig(hidCode, description);
+        key.setVoicePreset(preset);
+        return key;
+    }
+
+    private KeyConfig createMacroKey(String description, int[][] macroSteps) {
+        KeyConfig key = new KeyConfig(0, description);
+        key.setVoicePreset(VoicePreset.CUSTOM);
+        for (int[] step : macroSteps) {
+            String actionType = switch (step[0]) {
+                case 1 -> "DOWN_KEY";
+                case 2 -> "UP_KEY";
+                default -> "DELAY";
+            };
+            key.addMacroStep(actionType, step[1]);
+        }
+        return key;
+    }
+
+    private void resetModeDefaults(ModeSlot mode) {
+        EnumMap<StudioPart, KeyConfig> map = keyConfigs.get(mode);
+        oledDrafts.putIfAbsent(mode, new OledModeDraft());
+        if (mode == ModeSlot.MODE0) {
+            map.put(StudioPart.KEY1, createVoiceKey(HIDUsage.F18, "Record", VoicePreset.WINDOWS_NATIVE));
+            map.put(StudioPart.KEY2, createKey(HIDUsage.ENTER, "Yes"));
+            map.put(StudioPart.KEY3, createMacroKey("No", new int[][]{
+                {1, HIDUsage.DOWN_ARROW}, {2, HIDUsage.DOWN_ARROW}, {3, 10},
+                {1, HIDUsage.DOWN_ARROW}, {2, HIDUsage.DOWN_ARROW}, {3, 10},
+                {1, HIDUsage.DOWN_ARROW}, {2, HIDUsage.DOWN_ARROW}, {3, 10},
+                {1, HIDUsage.ENTER}, {2, HIDUsage.ENTER}
+            }));
+            map.put(StudioPart.KEY4, createKey(HIDUsage.BACKSPACE, "Backspace"));
+            oledSummaries.put(mode, new SimpleStringProperty("Claude"));
+            oledCaptions.put(mode, new SimpleStringProperty("Mode 1"));
+            lightBarSummaries.put(mode, new SimpleStringProperty("AI 状态灯效"));
+        } else if (mode == ModeSlot.MODE1) {
+            map.put(StudioPart.KEY1, createVoiceKey(HIDUsage.F18, "Record", VoicePreset.WINDOWS_NATIVE));
+            map.put(StudioPart.KEY2, createKey(HIDUsage.ENTER, "Accept"));
+            map.put(StudioPart.KEY3, createKey(HIDUsage.BACKSPACE, "Reject"));
+            map.put(StudioPart.KEY4, createKey(HIDUsage.BACKSPACE, "Backspace"));
+            oledSummaries.put(mode, new SimpleStringProperty("Cursor"));
+            oledCaptions.put(mode, new SimpleStringProperty("Mode 2"));
+            lightBarSummaries.put(mode, new SimpleStringProperty("AI 状态灯效"));
+        } else if (mode == ModeSlot.MODE2) {
+            map.put(StudioPart.KEY1, createVoiceKey(HIDUsage.F18, "Record", VoicePreset.WINDOWS_NATIVE));
+            map.put(StudioPart.KEY2, createKey(HIDUsage.ENTER, "Accept"));
+            map.put(StudioPart.KEY3, createKey(HIDUsage.ESCAPE, "Reject"));
+            map.put(StudioPart.KEY4, createKey(HIDUsage.BACKSPACE, "Backspace"));
+            oledSummaries.put(mode, new SimpleStringProperty("Codex"));
+            oledCaptions.put(mode, new SimpleStringProperty("Mode 3"));
+            lightBarSummaries.put(mode, new SimpleStringProperty("AI 状态灯效"));
+        } else {
+            map.put(StudioPart.KEY1, createKey(0, "N/A"));
+            map.put(StudioPart.KEY2, createKey(0, "N/A"));
+            map.put(StudioPart.KEY3, createKey(0, "N/A"));
+            map.put(StudioPart.KEY4, createKey(HIDUsage.BACKSPACE, "Backspace"));
+            oledSummaries.put(mode, new SimpleStringProperty("N/A"));
+            oledCaptions.put(mode, new SimpleStringProperty("Mode 4"));
+            lightBarSummaries.put(mode, new SimpleStringProperty("AI 状态灯效"));
+        }
+        resetAiLightDefaults(mode);
+    }

+        EnumMap<IDEState, LightEffectStyle> map = aiLightConfigs.get(mode);
+        map.clear();
+        for (IDEState state : IDEState.values()) {
+            map.put(state, LightEffectStyle.defaultFor(state));
+        }
+    }

+    public void applyOrdinaryKeyReadback(AhaKeyResponseParser.OrdinaryKeyReadback readback) {
+        if (readback.keyIndex() == 0 && k1Routes.capability.get() != K1RouteState.Capability.LEGACY) return;
+        ModeSlot mode = ModeSlot.fromIndex(readback.mode());
+        StudioPart part = partForKeyIndex(readback.keyIndex());
+        if (part == null) {
+            return;
+        }
+        if (part == StudioPart.KEY1 ? !k1Routes.dirty(mode.getIndex()) : !hasUnsavedDraft(mode)) {
+            keyConfigs.get(mode).put(part, DeviceSyncService.keyConfigFromReadback(readback));
+        }
+        markInputBaselineChanged();
+    }

+    public KeyConfig getSideSwitchCustomAction(int position, boolean macro) {
+        AhaKeyResponseParser.SideSwitchPositionConfig config =
+            position == AhaKeyProtocol.SIDE_SWITCH_POSITION_UP ? sideSwitchConfig.up() : sideSwitchConfig.down();
+        return DeviceSyncService.keyConfigFromSideSwitchActionPayload(config.actionPayload(), macro);
+    }
+
+    public boolean isSideSwitchCustomMacro(int position) {
+        AhaKeyResponseParser.SideSwitchPositionConfig config =
+            position == AhaKeyProtocol.SIDE_SWITCH_POSITION_UP ? sideSwitchConfig.up() : sideSwitchConfig.down();
+        return DeviceSyncService.isSideSwitchMacroActionPayload(config.actionPayload());
+    }
+
+    private void updateSideSwitchPosition(int position, AhaKeyResponseParser.SideSwitchPositionConfig updated) {
+        AhaKeyResponseParser.SideSwitchPositionConfig up = sideSwitchConfig.up();
+        AhaKeyResponseParser.SideSwitchPositionConfig down = sideSwitchConfig.down();
+        if (position == AhaKeyProtocol.SIDE_SWITCH_POSITION_UP) {
+            up = updated;
+            down = complementIfFactory(updated.binding(), down);
+        } else {
+            down = updated;
+            up = complementIfFactory(updated.binding(), up);
+        }
+        sideSwitchConfig = new AhaKeyResponseParser.SideSwitchConfig(sideSwitchConfig.physicalPosition(), up, down);
+        markDirty(StudioPart.TOGGLE_SWITCH);
+    }

+    public static int keyIndexFor(StudioPart part) {
+        return switch (part) {
+            case KEY1 -> 0;
+            case KEY2 -> 1;
+            case KEY3 -> 2;
+            case KEY4 -> 3;
+            default -> 0;
+        };
+    }
+
+    public static StudioPart partForKeyIndex(int keyIndex) {
+        return switch (keyIndex) {
+            case 0 -> StudioPart.KEY1;
+            case 1 -> StudioPart.KEY2;
+            case 2 -> StudioPart.KEY3;
+            case 3 -> StudioPart.KEY4;
+            default -> null;
+        };
+    }

+    public void markDirty(StudioPart part) {
+        if (part == StudioPart.KEY1) k1Routes.markEdited(getSelectedMode().getIndex());
+        dirtyParts.add(part);
+        dirtyModes.add(getSelectedMode());
+        dirtyCount.set(dirtyParts.size());
+        revision.set(revision.get() + 1);
+        syncStatus.set("有 " + dirtyParts.size() + " 处改动待保存。");
+    }

+    public void restoreCurrentModeDefaults() {
+        resetModeDefaults(getSelectedMode());
+        k1Routes.markEdited(getSelectedMode().getIndex());
+        dirtyParts.add(StudioPart.KEY1);
+        dirtyParts.add(StudioPart.KEY2);
+        dirtyParts.add(StudioPart.KEY3);
+        dirtyParts.add(StudioPart.KEY4);
+        dirtyParts.add(StudioPart.OLED);
+        dirtyParts.add(StudioPart.LIGHT_BAR);
+        dirtyModes.add(getSelectedMode());
+        dirtyCount.set(dirtyParts.size());
+        revision.set(revision.get() + 1);
+        syncStatus.set("已恢复 " + getSelectedMode().getTitle() + " 默认值，等待保存。");
+    }

+    public void clearDirtyAfterSync() {
+        dirtyParts.clear();
+        dirtyModes.clear();
+        dirtyCount.set(0);
+        for (ModeSlot mode : ModeSlot.values()) if (k1Routes.dirty(mode.getIndex())) {
+            dirtyParts.add(StudioPart.KEY1); dirtyModes.add(mode);
+        }
+        dirtyCount.set(dirtyParts.size());
+        revision.set(revision.get() + 1);
+        lastSyncSummary.set("最近保存 " + LocalDateTime.now().format(SYNC_TIME_FORMAT));
+    }

+    private static AhaKeyResponseParser.SideSwitchConfig defaultSideSwitchConfig() {
+        return new AhaKeyResponseParser.SideSwitchConfig(
+            AhaKeyProtocol.SIDE_SWITCH_POSITION_DOWN,
+            new AhaKeyResponseParser.SideSwitchPositionConfig(AhaKeyProtocol.SIDE_SWITCH_BINDING_AUTO, new byte[0]),
+            new AhaKeyResponseParser.SideSwitchPositionConfig(AhaKeyProtocol.SIDE_SWITCH_BINDING_MANUAL, new byte[0])
+        );
+    }
+
+    private void markInputBaselineChanged() {
+        inputBaselineRevision.set(inputBaselineRevision.get() + 1);
+    }
+
+    private static AhaKeyResponseParser.SideSwitchPositionConfig complementIfFactory(
+        int changedBinding,
+        AhaKeyResponseParser.SideSwitchPositionConfig currentOther
+    ) {
+        if (changedBinding == AhaKeyProtocol.SIDE_SWITCH_BINDING_AUTO) {
+            return new AhaKeyResponseParser.SideSwitchPositionConfig(AhaKeyProtocol.SIDE_SWITCH_BINDING_MANUAL, new byte[0]);
+        }
+        if (changedBinding == AhaKeyProtocol.SIDE_SWITCH_BINDING_MANUAL) {
+            return new AhaKeyResponseParser.SideSwitchPositionConfig(AhaKeyProtocol.SIDE_SWITCH_BINDING_AUTO, new byte[0]);
+        }
+        if (changedBinding == AhaKeyProtocol.SIDE_SWITCH_BINDING_CUSTOM) {
+            if (currentOther.binding() == AhaKeyProtocol.SIDE_SWITCH_BINDING_CUSTOM
+                || currentOther.binding() == AhaKeyProtocol.SIDE_SWITCH_BINDING_DISABLED) {
+                return currentOther;
+            }
+            return new AhaKeyResponseParser.SideSwitchPositionConfig(AhaKeyProtocol.SIDE_SWITCH_BINDING_DISABLED, new byte[0]);
+        }
+        return currentOther;
+    }

+        return revision.get();
+    }

+    public void loadFromPersisted(PersistedDraft draft) {
+        for (int i = 0; i < ModeSlot.values().length; i++) {
+            ModeSlot mode = ModeSlot.values()[i];
+            PersistedDraft.ModeDraft md = draft.modes[i];
+            EnumMap<StudioPart, KeyConfig> map = keyConfigs.get(mode);
+            KeyConfig k1 = new KeyConfig(md.key1Hid, md.key1Desc);
+            KeyConfig k2 = new KeyConfig(md.key2Hid, md.key2Desc);
+            KeyConfig k3 = new KeyConfig(md.key3Hid, md.key3Desc);
+            KeyConfig k4 = new KeyConfig(md.key4Hid, md.key4Desc);
+            if (md.key1Macro != null) k1.setMacro(md.key1Macro);
+            if (md.key2Macro != null) k2.setMacro(md.key2Macro);
+            if (md.key3Macro != null) k3.setMacro(md.key3Macro);
+            if (md.key4Macro != null) k4.setMacro(md.key4Macro);
+            map.put(StudioPart.KEY1, k1);
+            map.put(StudioPart.KEY2, k2);
+            map.put(StudioPart.KEY3, k3);
+            map.put(StudioPart.KEY4, k4);
+            oledSummaries.get(mode).set(md.oledSummary);
+            oledCaptions.get(mode).set(md.oledCaption);
+            OledModeDraft od = getOledDraft(mode);
+            od.setLocalAssetPath(md.oledGifPath);
+            od.setFramesPerSecond(md.oledFps);
+            od.setFrameCount(md.oledFrameCount);
+            od.setStatusLine(md.oledSummary);
+            od.setCaptionLine(md.oledCaption);
+            if (md.voicePresetId != null) {
+                try {
+                    k1.setVoicePreset(VoicePreset.valueOf(md.voicePresetId));
+                } catch (IllegalArgumentException ignored) {
+                    k1.setVoicePreset(VoicePreset.WINDOWS_NATIVE);
+                }
+            }
+        }
+        lightBarPreview.set(LightBarPreviewState.fromId(draft.lightBarPreviewId));
+        if (draft.lightBrightness > 0) {
+            lightBrightness.set(Math.max(1, Math.min(100, draft.lightBrightness)));
+        }
+        for (ModeSlot mode : ModeSlot.values()) {
+            PersistedDraft.ModeDraft md = draft.modes[mode.getIndex()];
+            if (md.aiLightEffectIds != null) {
+                for (IDEState state : IDEState.values()) {
+                    if (state.getCode() < md.aiLightEffectIds.length) {
+                        aiLightConfigs.get(mode).put(state, LightEffectStyle.fromId(md.aiLightEffectIds[state.getCode()]));
+                    }
+                }
+            }
+        }
+        revision.set(draft.revision);
+        dirtyParts.clear();
+        dirtyModes.clear();
+        dirtyCount.set(0);
+    }
+
+    public PersistedDraft toPersisted() {
+        PersistedDraft d = new PersistedDraft();
+        d.revision = revision.get();
+        d.lightBarPreviewId = lightBarPreview.get().getId();
+        d.lightBrightness = lightBrightness.get();
+        d.modes = new PersistedDraft.ModeDraft[ModeSlot.values().length];
+        for (ModeSlot mode : ModeSlot.values()) {
+            PersistedDraft.ModeDraft md = new PersistedDraft.ModeDraft();
+            KeyConfig k1 = getKeyConfig(mode, StudioPart.KEY1);
+            KeyConfig k2 = getKeyConfig(mode, StudioPart.KEY2);
+            KeyConfig k3 = getKeyConfig(mode, StudioPart.KEY3);
+            KeyConfig k4 = getKeyConfig(mode, StudioPart.KEY4);
+            md.key1Hid = k1.getHidCode();
+            md.key1Desc = k1.getDescription();
+            md.key1Macro = k1.getMacro();
+            md.key2Hid = k2.getHidCode();
+            md.key2Desc = k2.getDescription();
+            md.key2Macro = k2.getMacro();
+            md.key3Hid = k3.getHidCode();
+            md.key3Desc = k3.getDescription();
+            md.key3Macro = k3.getMacro();
+            md.key4Hid = k4.getHidCode();
+            md.key4Desc = k4.getDescription();
+            md.key4Macro = k4.getMacro();
+            md.oledSummary = oledSummaries.get(mode).get();
+            md.oledCaption = oledCaptions.get(mode).get();
+            OledModeDraft od = getOledDraft(mode);
+            md.oledGifPath = od.getLocalAssetPath();
+            md.oledFps = od.getFramesPerSecond();
+            md.oledFrameCount = od.getFrameCount();
+            md.voicePresetId = getKeyConfig(mode, StudioPart.KEY1).getVoicePreset().name();
+            md.aiLightEffectIds = new String[IDEState.values().length];
+            for (IDEState state : IDEState.values()) {
+                md.aiLightEffectIds[state.getCode()] = getAiLightEffect(mode, state).getId();
+            }
+            d.modes[mode.getIndex()] = md;
+        }
+        return d;
+    }
+
+    /** JSON 持久化 DTO，字段名稳定供 Jackson 使用。 */
+    public static class PersistedDraft {
+        public int revision;
+        public String lightBarPreviewId = LightBarPreviewState.AI_RUNNING.getId();
+        public int lightBrightness = 35;
+        public ModeDraft[] modes = new ModeDraft[ModeSlot.values().length];
+
+        public static PersistedDraft defaults() {
+            StudioState s = new StudioState();
+            return s.toPersisted();
+        }
+
+        public static class ModeDraft {
+            public int key1Hid;
+            public String key1Desc;
+            public List<MacroStep> key1Macro;
+            public int key2Hid;
+            public String key2Desc;
+            public List<MacroStep> key2Macro;
+            public int key3Hid;
+            public String key3Desc;
+            public List<MacroStep> key3Macro;
+            public int key4Hid;
+            public String key4Desc;
+            public List<MacroStep> key4Macro;
+            public String oledSummary;
+            public String oledCaption;
+            public String oledGifPath;
+            public int oledFps = 10;
+            public int oledFrameCount;
+            public String voicePresetId = VoicePreset.CUSTOM.name();
+            public String[] aiLightEffectIds;
+        }
+    }
+}

+    public void startCursorMonitoring() {
+        synchronized (cursorLifecycleLock) {
+            if (cursorClosed || cursorMonitor != null) return;
+            cursorMonitor = java.util.concurrent.Executors.newSingleThreadScheduledExecutor(r -> {
+                Thread thread = new Thread(r, "cursor-waiting-observer"); thread.setDaemon(true); return thread;
+            });
+            cursorMonitor.scheduleWithFixedDelay(() -> {
+                try { pollCursorWaiting(); }
+                catch (Exception e) { logger.debug("Cursor waiting observation unavailable"); }
+            }, 0, 500, java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS);
+        }
+    }
+
+    public void close() {
+        synchronized (cursorLifecycleLock) {
+            cursorClosed = true;
+            cursorOverlay = new CursorOverlay(-1, Map.of());
+            if (cursorMonitor != null) { cursorMonitor.shutdownNow(); cursorMonitor = null; }
+            if (snapshotRetry != null) { snapshotRetry.shutdownNow(); snapshotRetry = null; }
+        }
+    }

+    private void invalidateCursorContext() {
+        cursorEpoch++; cursorTracking.clear(); cursorProcess = ""; cursorObservedProcess = ""; cursorConnection = -1; cursorMaintenance = -1;
+        cursorOverlay = new CursorOverlay(-1, Map.of());
+    }

+    private Map<String, Long> cursorTargets() {
+        Map<String, Long> result = new HashMap<>();
+        java.util.Set<String> duplicates = new java.util.HashSet<>();
+        for (AiRuntimeSlotBinding slot : appliedSlots) {
+            if (slot != null && slot.isBound() && "Cursor".equals(slot.getProvider())) {
+                String id = slot.getStableId();
+                if (result.put(id, cursorTracking.computeIfAbsent(id, key -> new CursorTracking()).hookRevision) != null)
+                    duplicates.add(id);
+            }
+        }
+        duplicates.forEach(result::remove);
+        cursorTracking.keySet().retainAll(result.keySet());
+        return result;
+    }
