+    private void queryBridgeDeviceInfo() {
+        try {
+            if (usbTransport.isOpen()) {
+                sendCommand(AhaKeyProtocol.queryDeviceStatus());
+                return;
+            }
+            writePacket(BleTcpPacket.QUERY_BLE_STATUS, null);
+        } catch (IOException ignored) {
+        }
+    }
+
+    protected boolean isUsbDevicePresent() {
+        return UsbHidTransport.isPresent();
+    }
+
+    private boolean tryConnectUsb() {
+        if (!maintenance.normalAllowed()) return false;
+        try {
+            if (!isUsbDevicePresent()) {
+                return false;
+            }
+            closeTcpOnly();
+            resetDisplaySession();
+            long generation = connectionGeneration;
+            usbTransport.open(data -> onSessionNotify(generation, data));
+            isConnected = true;
+            isScanning = false;
+            cachedStatus.clearFirmwareIdentity();
+            cachedStatus.setConnected(true);
+            cachedStatus.setDeviceName("AhaKey USB");
+            cachedStatus.setBatteryLevel(100);
+            callback.onConnected();
+            queryBridgeDeviceInfo();
+            return true;
+        } catch (Exception e) {
+            logger.warn("USB HID connect failed: {}", e.getMessage());
+            usbTransport.close();
+            return false;
+        }
+    }
+
+    private boolean ensureUsbConnected() {
+        if (!maintenance.normalAllowed()) return usbTransport.isOpen();
+        if (displayLease != null || displayWriteUncertain || displayReadUncertain) return usbTransport.isOpen();
+        if (usbTransport.isOpen()) {
+            return true;
+        }
+        if (!isUsbDevicePresent()) {
+            return false;
+        }
+        try {
+            closeTcpOnly();
+            resetDisplaySession();
+            long generation = connectionGeneration;
+            usbTransport.open(data -> onSessionNotify(generation, data));
+            isConnected = true;
+            isScanning = false;
+            cachedStatus.setConnected(true);
+            cachedStatus.setDeviceName("AhaKey USB");
+            cachedStatus.setBatteryLevel(100);
+            callback.onConnected();
+            return true;
+        } catch (Exception e) {
+            logger.warn("USB HID reconnect failed: {}", e.getMessage());
+            usbTransport.close();
+            return false;
+        }
+    }
+    private void writePacket(byte type, byte[] data) throws IOException {
+        commandLock.lock();
+        try {
+        if (type == BleTcpPacket.WRITE_COMMAND) maintenance.admitFrame(data, connectionGeneration);
+        else maintenance.admit(-1, connectionGeneration);
+        if (!isConnected || outputStream == null) {
+            throw new IOException("BLE 桥未连接");
+        }
+        int dataLen = data == null ? 0 : data.length;
+        logger.debug("发送 TCP 包: type=0x{}, len={}", Integer.toHexString(type & 0xFF), dataLen);
+        synchronized (outputStream) {
+            outputStream.write(BleTcpPacket.encode(type, data));
+            outputStream.flush();
+        }
+        } finally { commandLock.unlock(); }
+    }
+
+    private static final long RECONNECT_WAIT_MS = 30000;  // 重连等待时间30秒
+
+    private byte[] waitForResponse(byte expectedCmd) throws Exception {
+        return waitForResponseFrame(expectedCmd, true);
+    }
+
+    private byte[] waitForResponseFrame(byte expectedCmd, boolean throwOnDeviceError) throws Exception {
+        return waitForResponseFrame(expectedCmd, throwOnDeviceError, true);
+    }
+
+    private byte[] waitForResponseFrame(byte expectedCmd, boolean throwOnDeviceError, boolean waitForReconnect) throws Exception {
+        return waitForResponseFrame(expectedCmd, throwOnDeviceError, waitForReconnect, RESPONSE_TIMEOUT_MS);
+    }
+
+    private byte[] waitForResponseFrame(byte expectedCmd, boolean throwOnDeviceError, boolean waitForReconnect, long timeoutMs) throws Exception {
+        legacyWaiters++;
+        try {
+        logger.debug("开始等待响应 0x{}", Integer.toHexString(expectedCmd & 0xFF));
+        long deadline = System.nanoTime() + TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS.toNanos(timeoutMs);
+        
+        while (true) {
+            // 检查连接状态，如果断开则等待重连
+            if (!isConnected) {
+                if (!waitForReconnect) {
+                    throw new IOException("设备连接中断");
+                }
+                logger.info("BLE连接断开，等待重连...");
+                long reconnectDeadline = System.nanoTime() + TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS.toNanos(RECONNECT_WAIT_MS);
+                
+                while (!isConnected) {
+                    long remaining = reconnectDeadline - System.nanoTime();
+                    if (remaining <= 0) {
+                        throw new IOException("BLE连接断开，等待重连超时");
+                    }
+                    responseReady.awaitNanos(Math.min(remaining, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS.toNanos(100)));
+                }
+                
+                logger.info("BLE重连成功，继续等待响应");
+                // 重连后重置响应超时时间
+                deadline = System.nanoTime() + TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS.toNanos(timeoutMs);
+            }
+            
+            long remaining = deadline - System.nanoTime();
+            if (remaining <= 0) {
+                throw new IOException("等待设备响应 0x" + Integer.toHexString(expectedCmd & 0xFF) + " 超时");
+            }
+            Deque<byte[]> frames = pendingNotifyFramesByCommand.get(expectedCmd);
+            if (frames != null && !frames.isEmpty()) {
+                byte[] frame = frames.removeFirst();
+                if (expectedCmd == AhaKeyProtocol.CMD_QUERY_STATUS) {
+                    if (AhaKeyProtocol.parseDeviceStatus(frame) == null) {
+                        throw new IOException("无法解析设备状态响应帧");
+                    }
+                    logger.debug("收到期望的状态响应 0x{}", Integer.toHexString(expectedCmd & 0xFF));
+                    return frame;
+                }
+                AhaKeyResponseParser.CommandResponse parsed = AhaKeyResponseParser.parseCommandResponse(frame);
+                if (parsed == null) {
+                    throw new IOException("无法解析设备响应帧");
+                }
+                logger.debug("收到期望的响应 0x{}", Integer.toHexString(expectedCmd & 0xFF));
+                if (throwOnDeviceError && parsed.status() != 0) {
+                    throw new IOException("设备返回错误码 " + parsed.status());
+                }
+                return frame;
+            }
+            responseReady.awaitNanos(remaining);
+        }
+        } finally { legacyWaiters--; responseReady.signalAll(); }
+    }
+
+    public DeviceStatus queryDeviceStatusSnapshot(long timeoutMs, boolean failOnDisconnect) throws Exception {
+        synchronized (commandTransactionLock) {
+            commandLock.lock();
+            try {
+                pendingNotifyFramesByCommand.clear();
+                if (ensureUsbConnected()) {
+                    sendUsbCommand(AhaKeyProtocol.queryDeviceStatus());
+                } else {
+                    writePacket(BleTcpPacket.WRITE_COMMAND, AhaKeyProtocol.queryDeviceStatus());
+                }
+                byte[] frame = waitForResponseFrame(AhaKeyProtocol.CMD_QUERY_STATUS, true, !failOnDisconnect, timeoutMs);
+                DeviceStatus status = AhaKeyProtocol.parseDeviceStatus(frame);
+                if (status == null) {
+                    throw new IOException("无法解析设备状态回读");
+                }
+                status.setConnected(true);
+                if (cachedStatus.getDeviceName() != null && !cachedStatus.getDeviceName().isBlank()) {
+                    status.setDeviceName(cachedStatus.getDeviceName());
+                }
+                status.setFirmwareCatalogKey(cachedStatus.getFirmwareCatalogKey());
+                status.setIdentityState(firmwareIdentity.state());
+                if (status.getWorkMode() == cachedStatus.getWorkMode()) status.setSavedBindings(cachedStatus.getSavedBindings());
+                cachedStatus = status;
+                lastStatusUpdateTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
+                callback.onStatusReceived(status);
+                return status;
+            } finally {
+                commandLock.unlock();
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    private String sleepWaitTimeStatusMessage(byte status) {
+        return switch (status) {
+            case 1 -> "非法值";
+            case 2 -> "固化失败";
+            case 3 -> "数据长度错误";
+            default -> "设备返回错误码 " + status;
+        };
+    }
+
+    private void startReader() {
+        logger.info("[BLE] startReader 开始创建读取线程");
+        final long generation = connectionGeneration;
+        final InputStream sessionInput = inputStream;
+        readerThread = new Thread(() -> {
+            logger.info("[BLE] readerThread 已启动");
+            byte[] header = new byte[3];
+            try {
+                while (isConnected && !Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted()) {
+                    if (!readFully(sessionInput, header, 3)) {
+                        logger.warn("[BLE] readerThread: 读取头部失败，连接可能已断开");
+                        break;
+                    }
+                    int len = (header[1] & 0xFF) | ((header[2] & 0xFF) << 8);
+                    byte[] body = len > 0 ? new byte[len] : new byte[0];
+                    if (len > 0 && !readFully(sessionInput, body, len)) {
+                        logger.warn("[BLE] readerThread: 读取数据失败，连接可能已断开");
+                        break;
+                    }
+                    if (generation != connectionGeneration) break;
+                    handleSessionPacket(generation, header[0], body);
+                }
+            } catch (IOException e) {
+                logger.warn("[BLE] readerThread: 读取异常 - {}", e.getMessage());
+                if (isConnected) {
+                    callback.onError("BLE 桥连接断开: " + e.getMessage());
+                }
+            } finally {
+                logger.info("[BLE] readerThread: 线程退出，isConnected={}, isInterrupted={}", 
+                    isConnected, Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted());
+                if (isConnected && Thread.currentThread() == readerThread) {
+                    logger.info("[BLE] readerThread: 触发自动断开连接");
+                    disconnect();
+                }
+            }
+        }, "ble-tcp-reader");
+        readerThread.setDaemon(true);
+        readerThread.start();
+        logger.info("[BLE] startReader: 读取线程已启动");
+    }
+
+    private void handleSessionPacket(long generation, byte type, byte[] data) {
+        commandLock.lock();
+        try { if (generation == connectionGeneration) handlePacket(type, data); }
+        finally { commandLock.unlock(); }
+    }
+
+    private void handlePacket(byte type, byte[] data) {
+        logger.debug("收到 TCP 包: type=0x{}, len={}", Integer.toHexString(type & 0xFF), data == null ? 0 : data.length);
+        switch (type) {
+            case BleTcpPacket.BLE_NOTIFY -> onBleNotify(data);
+            case BleTcpPacket.DEVICE_INFO_RESP -> {
+                if (data != null && data.length >= 8) {
+                    int battery = data[0] & 0xFF;
+                    int firmwareMain = data[2] & 0xFF;
+                    int firmwareSub = data[3] & 0xFF;
+                    int workMode = data[4] & 0xFF;
+                    int switchState = data[6] & 0xFF;
+                    
+                    // 验证数据有效性
+                    boolean isValidBattery = battery >= 0 && battery <= 100;
+                    boolean isValidWorkMode = workMode >= 0 && workMode <= 3;
+                    
+                    logger.info("收到设备信息 - 电量: {}, 工作模式: {}, 拨杆: {}, 有效: {}", 
+                        battery, workMode, switchState, isValidBattery && isValidWorkMode);
+                    
+                    // 更新最后状态更新时间
+                    lastStatusUpdateTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
+                    
+                    // 更新缓存状态
+                    cachedStatus.setBatteryLevel(battery);
+                    cachedStatus.setFirmwareMain(firmwareMain);
+                    cachedStatus.setFirmwareSub(firmwareSub);
+                    cachedStatus.setWorkMode(workMode);
+                    cachedStatus.setSwitchState(switchState);
+                    
+                    // 如果数据有效，确保标记为已连接
+                    if (isValidBattery && isValidWorkMode) {
+                        cachedStatus.setConnected(true);
+                        cachedStatus.setDeviceName("AhaKey Keyboard");
+                    }
+                    
+                    callback.onStatusReceived(cachedStatus);
+                }
+            }
+            case BleTcpPacket.BLE_STATUS_RESP -> {
+                if (data != null && data.length > 0) {
+                    // 解析BLE状态响应（参考Python的parse_status_response）
+                    // 格式: [connected:1][name_len:1][name:N][mac_len:1][mac:N][is_target:1]
+                    boolean bleConnected = (data[0] & 0xFF) == 1;
+                    String deviceName = "";
+                    
+                    if (data.length >= 3) {
+                        int nameLen = data[1] & 0xFF;
+                        if (nameLen > 0 && data.length >= 2 + nameLen) {
+                            deviceName = new String(data, 2, nameLen);
+                        }
+                    }
+                    
+                    logger.info("BLE状态响应 - 连接: {}, 设备名: {}", bleConnected, deviceName.isEmpty() ? "(empty)" : deviceName);
+                    
+                    lastStatusUpdateTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
+                    
+                    boolean wasConnected = cachedStatus.isConnected();
+                    cachedStatus.setConnected(bleConnected);
+                    cachedStatus.setDeviceName(bleConnected ? deviceName : "");
+                    
+                    // 如果是从断开变为连接，通知回调
+                    if (bleConnected && !wasConnected) {
+                        callback.onConnected();
+                    }
+                    
+                    // 如果是从连接变为断开，更新状态并唤醒等待线程
+                    if (!bleConnected && wasConnected) {
+                        isConnected = false;
+                        resetDisplaySession();
+                        commandLock.lock();
+                        try {
+                            responseReady.signalAll();
+                        } finally {
+                            commandLock.unlock();
+                        }
+                    }
+                    
+                    callback.onStatusReceived(cachedStatus);
+                }
+            }
+            default -> {
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    private void onBleNotify(byte[] data) {
+        logger.debug("收到 BLE NOTIFY 通知，数据长度: {}", data.length);
+        lastStatusUpdateTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
+        
+        // 打印前16字节的十六进制数据
+        StringBuilder hex = new StringBuilder();
+        for (int i = 0; i < Math.min(data.length, 16); i++) {
+            hex.append(String.format("%02X ", data[i]));
+        }
+        logger.debug("数据内容(前16字节): {}", hex);
+
+        List<byte[]> frames = reassembleNotifyFrames(data);
+        if (frames.isEmpty()) {
+            logger.debug("BLE notify 分片已缓存，等待完整帧");
+            return;
+        }
+        for (byte[] frame : frames) {
+            processNotifyFrame(frame);
+        }
+    }
+
+    private void onSessionNotify(long generation, byte[] data) {
+        commandLock.lock();
+        try { if (generation == connectionGeneration) onBleNotify(data); }
+        finally { commandLock.unlock(); }
+    }
+
+    private List<byte[]> reassembleNotifyFrames(byte[] data) {
+        List<byte[]> frames = new ArrayList<>();
+        if (data == null || data.length == 0) {
+            return frames;
+        }
+
+        synchronized (notifyReassemblyBuffer) {
+            if (data.length > notifyReassemblyBuffer.length - notifyReassemblyLength) {
+                logger.warn("BLE notify 重组缓冲区溢出，丢弃未完成分片");
+                notifyReassemblyLength = 0;
+            }
+            if (data.length > notifyReassemblyBuffer.length) {
+                logger.warn("BLE notify 单片过长，无法重组: {} bytes", data.length);
+                return frames;
+            }
+
+            System.arraycopy(data, 0, notifyReassemblyBuffer, notifyReassemblyLength, data.length);
+            notifyReassemblyLength += data.length;
+
+            while (true) {
+                int start = findFrameStart(notifyReassemblyBuffer, notifyReassemblyLength);
+                if (start < 0) {
+                    boolean trailingHeader = notifyReassemblyLength > 0 && notifyReassemblyBuffer[notifyReassemblyLength - 1] == (byte) 0xAA;
+                    notifyReassemblyLength = trailingHeader ? 1 : 0;
+                    if (trailingHeader) notifyReassemblyBuffer[0] = (byte) 0xAA;
+                    return frames;
+                }
+                if (start > 0) {
+                    shiftNotifyBuffer(start);
+                }
+
+                int end = findFrameEnd(notifyReassemblyBuffer, notifyReassemblyLength);
+                // An invalid binary K1 frame has no safe interior delimiter to resynchronize on.
+                if(end==-2){notifyReassemblyLength=0;return frames;}
+                if (end < 0) {
+                    return frames;
+                }
+
+                byte[] frame = Arrays.copyOfRange(notifyReassemblyBuffer, 0, end + 2);
+                frames.add(frame);
+                shiftNotifyBuffer(end + 2);
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    private boolean startsWithFrameHeader(byte[] data) {
+        return data.length >= 2 && data[0] == (byte) 0xAA && data[1] == (byte) 0xBB;
+    }
+
+    private int findFrameStart(byte[] buffer, int len) {
+        for (int i = 0; i + 1 < len; i++) {
+            if (buffer[i] == (byte) 0xAA && buffer[i + 1] == (byte) 0xBB) {
+                return i;
+            }
+        }
+        return -1;
+    }
+
+    private int findFrameEnd(byte[] buffer, int len) {
+        int k1 = com.example.ahakey.protocol.K1RouteProtocol.replyLength(buffer,0,len,k1ReplyRequest);
+        if(k1>0)return k1-2;
+        if(k1!=-1)return k1==0?-1:-2;
+        int fixed = AhaKeyResponseParser.displayReplyLength(buffer, 0, len);
+        if (fixed > 0) return fixed - 2;
+        if (fixed != -1) return -1;
+        for (int i = 3; i + 1 < len; i++) {
+            if (buffer[i] == (byte) 0xCC && buffer[i + 1] == (byte) 0xDD) {
+                return i;
+            }
+        }
+        return -1;
+    }
+
+    private void shiftNotifyBuffer(int consumed) {
+        if (consumed >= notifyReassemblyLength) {
+            notifyReassemblyLength = 0;
+            return;
+        }
+        int remaining = notifyReassemblyLength - consumed;
+        System.arraycopy(notifyReassemblyBuffer, consumed, notifyReassemblyBuffer, 0, remaining);
+        notifyReassemblyLength = remaining;
+    }
+
+    private void processNotifyFrame(byte[] data) {
+        int opcode = data.length > 2 ? data[2] & 255 : -1;
+        if (opcode == 0x88 || opcode == 0x89 || opcode == 0x8A || opcode == 0x8B || opcode == 0x8C || opcode == 0x8E) {
+            commandLock.lock();
+            try {
+                if (displayLease != null && displayLease.generation == connectionGeneration && displayExpected == data[2]) {
+                    displayReply = data.clone();
+                    responseReady.signalAll();
+                }
+            } finally { commandLock.unlock(); }
+            return;
+        }
+        if (!AhaKeyProtocol.isValidFrame(data)) {
+            logger.warn("无效的帧格式 - isValidFrame 返回 false");
+            // 检查帧头帧尾
+            if (data.length >= 4) {
+                logger.debug("帧头: {}, 帧尾: {}", 
+                    String.format("%02X%02X", data[0], data[1]),
+                    String.format("%02X%02X", data[data.length-2], data[data.length-1]));
+            }
+            return;
+        }
+        DeviceStatus status = AhaKeyProtocol.parseDeviceStatus(data);
+        if (status != null) {
+            logger.info("解析到设备状态 - 电量: {}, 工作模式: {}, 拨杆状态: {}", 
+                status.getBatteryLevel(), 
+                status.getWorkMode(), 
+                status.getSwitchState());
+            if (usbTransport.isOpen()) {
+                status.setDeviceName("AhaKey USB");
+            } else if (cachedStatus.getDeviceName() != null && !cachedStatus.getDeviceName().isBlank()) {
+                status.setDeviceName(cachedStatus.getDeviceName());
+            }
+            status.setFirmwareCatalogKey(cachedStatus.getFirmwareCatalogKey());
+            status.setIdentityState(firmwareIdentity.state());
+            status.setConnected(true);
+            if (status.getWorkMode() == cachedStatus.getWorkMode()) status.setSavedBindings(cachedStatus.getSavedBindings());
+            cachedStatus = status;
+            enqueueNotifyFrame(data);
+            callback.onStatusReceived(status);
+            return;
+        }
+        logger.debug("parseDeviceStatus 返回 null");
+
+        enqueueNotifyFrame(data);
+    }
+
+    private void enqueueNotifyFrame(byte[] data) {
+        commandLock.lock();
+        try {
+            byte receivedCmd = data[2];
+            Deque<byte[]> frames = pendingNotifyFramesByCommand.computeIfAbsent(receivedCmd, ignored -> new ArrayDeque<>());
+            frames.addLast(data);
+            while (frames.size() > 16) {
+                frames.removeFirst();
+            }
+            responseReady.signalAll();
+            logger.debug("收到响应 0x{}，唤醒等待线程", Integer.toHexString(receivedCmd & 0xFF));
+        } finally {
+            commandLock.unlock();
+        }
+    }
+
+    private static String bytesToHex(byte[] bytes, int len) {
+        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
+        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
+            sb.append(String.format("%02X", bytes[i]));
+        }
+        return sb.toString();
+    }
+
+    private static boolean readFully(InputStream in, byte[] buf, int len) throws IOException {
+        int read = 0;
+        while (read < len) {
+            int n = in.read(buf, read, len - read);
+            if (n < 0) {
+                return false;
+            }
+            read += n;
+        }
+        return true;
+    }
+}

+    private Map<String, WaitingState> readWaitingStates(Path dataDir, Set<String> composerIds, String cursorVersion,

+        if (!WAITING_SCHEMA_VERSIONS.contains(cursorVersion)

+    private String readGeneration(Connection connection, String id) throws Exception {

+package com.example.ahakey.service;
+
+import com.example.ahakey.model.ModeSlot;
+import com.example.ahakey.model.StudioPart;
+import com.example.ahakey.model.StudioState;
+import com.example.ahakey.model.KeyConfig;
+import com.example.ahakey.protocol.AhaKeyProtocol;
+import com.example.ahakey.protocol.AhaKeyResponseParser;
+
+import java.util.ArrayList;
+import java.util.Arrays;
+import java.util.List;
+import java.util.function.Consumer;
+
+/** 对齐 Swift `commandsForModes` + `writeCommandsSequentially`。 */
+public final class DeviceSyncService {
+    public record LabeledCommand(byte[] data, String label) {
+    }
+
+    private DeviceSyncService() {
+    }
+
+    public static String sideSwitchActionSummary(byte[] payload) {
+        if (payload == null || payload.length == 0) return "无动作";
+        if (isSideSwitchMacroActionPayload(payload)) return "自定义宏";
+        byte[] keys = isSideSwitchActionEnvelope(payload) ? Arrays.copyOfRange(payload, 2, 2 + (payload[1] & 255)) : payload;
+        java.util.LinkedHashSet<String> names = new java.util.LinkedHashSet<>();
+        for (byte item : keys) {
+            int code = item & 255;
+            if (code == 0) continue;
+            names.add(switch (code) {
+                case 0xE0 -> "Ctrl"; case 0xE1 -> "Shift"; case 0xE2 -> "Alt"; case 0xE3 -> "Win";
+                case 0xE4 -> "右Ctrl"; case 0xE5 -> "右Shift"; case 0xE6 -> "右Alt"; case 0xE7 -> "右Win";
+                default -> com.example.ahakey.model.HIDUsage.getName(code);
+            });
+        }
+        return names.isEmpty() ? "无动作" : String.join("+", names);
+    }
+
+    public static List<LabeledCommand> commandsForModes(StudioState state, ModeSlot... modes) {
+        return commandsForModes(state, false, modes);
+    }
+    public static List<LabeledCommand> commandsForModes(StudioState state, boolean omitK1, ModeSlot... modes) {
+        List<LabeledCommand> out = new ArrayList<>();
+        for (ModeSlot mode : modes) {
+            int modeIndex = mode.getIndex();
+            for (StudioPart part : List.of(
+                StudioPart.KEY1, StudioPart.KEY2, StudioPart.KEY3, StudioPart.KEY4
+            )) {
+                if (omitK1 && part == StudioPart.KEY1) continue;
+                var key = state.getKeyConfig(mode, part);
+                int keyIndex = StudioState.keyIndexFor(part);
+                
+                if (key.usesMacro()) {
+                    out.add(new LabeledCommand(
+                        AhaKeyProtocol.setKeyMacro(modeIndex, keyIndex, encodeKeyActionPayload(key)),
+                        mode.getTitle() + " " + part.getTitle() + " 宏"
+                    ));
+                } else {
+                    out.add(new LabeledCommand(
+                        AhaKeyProtocol.setKeyMapping(modeIndex, keyIndex, encodeKeyActionPayload(key)),
+                        mode.getTitle() + " " + part.getTitle() + " 键码"
+                    ));
+                }
+                
+                out.add(new LabeledCommand(
+                    AhaKeyProtocol.setKeyDescription(modeIndex, keyIndex, key.getDescription()),
+                    mode.getTitle() + " " + part.getTitle() + " 描述"
+                ));
+            }
+
+            out.add(new LabeledCommand(
+                AhaKeyProtocol.setAiLightConfig(modeIndex, state.getAiLightEffectBytes(mode)),
+                mode.getTitle() + " AI 状态灯效"
+            ));
+        }
+
+        out.add(new LabeledCommand(AhaKeyProtocol.setLightBrightness(state.getLightBrightness()), "灯光亮度"));
+        out.add(new LabeledCommand(AhaKeyProtocol.saveConfig(), "保存全部配置到设备"));
+        return out;
+    }
+
+    public static List<byte[]> restoreKeyCommands(com.example.ahakey.firmware.DeviceBackup.Key key) {
+        byte[] payload = java.util.HexFormat.of().parseHex(key.payloadHex());
+        if (key.actionType() != AhaKeyProtocol.ORDINARY_KEY_ACTION_EMPTY && key.actionType() != (AhaKeyProtocol.SUB_MACRO & 255) && key.actionType() != (AhaKeyProtocol.SUB_SHORTCUT & 255))
+            throw new IllegalArgumentException("不支持的按键动作类型");
+        return List.of(key.actionType() == (AhaKeyProtocol.SUB_MACRO & 255)
+                ? AhaKeyProtocol.setKeyMacro(key.mode(), key.index(), payload)
+                : AhaKeyProtocol.setKeyMapping(key.mode(), key.index(), payload),
+                AhaKeyProtocol.setKeyDescription(key.mode(), key.index(), key.description()), AhaKeyProtocol.saveConfig());
+    }
+    public static byte[] encodeKeyActionPayload(KeyConfig key) {
+        if (key.usesMacro()) {
+            List<Byte> macroBytes = new ArrayList<>();
+            for (int i = 0; i < key.getMacroStepCount(); i++) {
+                String actionType = key.getMacroStepAction(i);
+                int param = key.getMacroStepParam(i);
+                byte action = switch (actionType) {
+                    case "DOWN_KEY" -> 0x01;
+                    case "UP_KEY" -> 0x02;
+                    case "DELAY" -> 0x03;
+                    default -> 0x00;
+                };
+                macroBytes.add(action);
+                macroBytes.add((byte) param);
+            }
+            byte[] macroData = new byte[macroBytes.size()];
+            for (int i = 0; i < macroBytes.size(); i++) {
+                macroData[i] = macroBytes.get(i);
+            }
+            return macroData;
+        }
+
+        int hidCode = key.getHidCode();
+        int modifiers = hidCode & 0xFF00;
+        int baseCode = hidCode & 0xFF;
+        List<Byte> keyCodes = new ArrayList<>();
+        if ((modifiers & 0x200) != 0) keyCodes.add((byte) 0xE0);
+        if ((modifiers & 0x2000) != 0) keyCodes.add((byte) 0xE4);
+        if ((modifiers & 0x100) != 0) keyCodes.add((byte) 0xE1);
+        if ((modifiers & 0x1000) != 0) keyCodes.add((byte) 0xE5);
+        if ((modifiers & 0x400) != 0) keyCodes.add((byte) 0xE2);
+        if ((modifiers & 0x4000) != 0) keyCodes.add((byte) 0xE6);
+        if ((modifiers & 0x800) != 0) keyCodes.add((byte) 0xE3);
+        if ((modifiers & 0x8000) != 0) keyCodes.add((byte) 0xE7);
+        if (baseCode != 0) {
+            keyCodes.add((byte) baseCode);
+        }
+        byte[] hid = new byte[keyCodes.size()];
+        for (int i = 0; i < keyCodes.size(); i++) {
+            hid[i] = keyCodes.get(i);
+        }
+        return hid;
+    }
+
+    public static byte[] encodeSideSwitchActionPayload(KeyConfig key) {
+        KeyConfig safeKey = key == null ? new KeyConfig(0, "") : key;
+        byte[] rawPayload = encodeKeyActionPayload(safeKey);
+        if (rawPayload.length > 255) {
+            throw new IllegalArgumentException("侧拨 Custom 动作内容超过 255 字节");
+        }
+        byte[] wrapped = new byte[2 + rawPayload.length];
+        wrapped[0] = safeKey.usesMacro() ? AhaKeyProtocol.SUB_MACRO : AhaKeyProtocol.SUB_SHORTCUT;
+        wrapped[1] = (byte) rawPayload.length;
+        System.arraycopy(rawPayload, 0, wrapped, 2, rawPayload.length);
+        return wrapped;
+    }
+
+    public static KeyConfig keyConfigFromReadback(AhaKeyResponseParser.OrdinaryKeyReadback readback) {
+        KeyConfig key = keyConfigFromActionPayload(
+            readback.actionPayload(),
+            readback.actionType() == (AhaKeyProtocol.SUB_MACRO & 0xFF)
+        );
+        key.setDescription(readback.description());
+        return key;
+    }
+
+    public static KeyConfig keyConfigFromSideSwitchActionPayload(byte[] actionPayload, boolean macroFallback) {
+        byte[] safePayload = actionPayload == null ? new byte[0] : actionPayload;
+        if (isSideSwitchActionEnvelope(safePayload)) {
+            int len = safePayload[1] & 0xFF;
+            byte[] rawPayload = Arrays.copyOfRange(safePayload, 2, 2 + len);
+            return keyConfigFromActionPayload(rawPayload, safePayload[0] == AhaKeyProtocol.SUB_MACRO);
+        }
+        return keyConfigFromActionPayload(safePayload, macroFallback);
+    }
+
+    public static KeyConfig keyConfigFromActionPayload(byte[] actionPayload, boolean macro) {
+        KeyConfig key = new KeyConfig(0, "");
+        byte[] safePayload = actionPayload == null ? new byte[0] : actionPayload;
+        if (macro) {
+            for (int i = 0; i + 1 < safePayload.length; i += 2) {
+                int action = safePayload[i] & 0xFF;
+                int param = safePayload[i + 1] & 0xFF;
+                String actionType = switch (action) {
+                    case 0x01 -> "DOWN_KEY";
+                    case 0x02 -> "UP_KEY";
+                    case 0x03 -> "DELAY";
+                    default -> "DELAY";
+                };
+                key.addMacroStep(actionType, param);
+            }
+        } else {
+            key.setHidCode(decodeShortcutPayload(safePayload));
+        }
+        return key;
+    }
+
+    public static boolean isMacroActionPayload(byte[] actionPayload) {
+        if (actionPayload == null || actionPayload.length == 0 || actionPayload.length % 2 != 0) {
+            return false;
+        }
+        for (int i = 0; i < actionPayload.length; i += 2) {
+            int action = actionPayload[i] & 0xFF;
+            if (action != 0x01 && action != 0x02 && action != 0x03) {
+                return false;
+            }
+        }
+        return true;
+    }
+
+    public static boolean isSideSwitchMacroActionPayload(byte[] actionPayload) {
+        byte[] safePayload = actionPayload == null ? new byte[0] : actionPayload;
+        if (isSideSwitchActionEnvelope(safePayload)) {
+            return safePayload[0] == AhaKeyProtocol.SUB_MACRO;
+        }
+        return isMacroActionPayload(safePayload);
+    }
+
+    private static boolean isSideSwitchActionEnvelope(byte[] actionPayload) {
+        if (actionPayload == null || actionPayload.length < 2) {
+            return false;
+        }
+        int type = actionPayload[0] & 0xFF;
+        if (type != (AhaKeyProtocol.SUB_SHORTCUT & 0xFF) && type != (AhaKeyProtocol.SUB_MACRO & 0xFF)) {
+            return false;
+        }
+        int len = actionPayload[1] & 0xFF;
+        return len <= actionPayload.length - 2;
+    }
+
+    public static boolean matchesReadback(KeyConfig key, AhaKeyResponseParser.OrdinaryKeyReadback readback) {
+        int expectedType = key.usesMacro() ? AhaKeyProtocol.SUB_MACRO & 0xFF : AhaKeyProtocol.SUB_SHORTCUT & 0xFF;
+        byte[] expectedPayload = encodeKeyActionPayload(key);
+        boolean expectedEmptyShortcut = !key.usesMacro() && expectedPayload.length == 0;
+        boolean typeMatches = readback.actionType() == expectedType
+            || (expectedEmptyShortcut && readback.actionType() == AhaKeyProtocol.ORDINARY_KEY_ACTION_EMPTY);
+        return typeMatches
+            && Arrays.equals(expectedPayload, readback.actionPayload())
+            && sanitizeDescription(key.getDescription()).equals(sanitizeDescription(readback.description()));
+    }
+
+    private static int decodeShortcutPayload(byte[] payload) {
+        int modifiers = 0;
+        int baseCode = 0;
+        for (byte item : payload) {
+            int code = item & 0xFF;
+            switch (code) {
+                case 0xE0 -> modifiers |= 0x200;
+                case 0xE4 -> modifiers |= 0x2000;
+                case 0xE1 -> modifiers |= 0x100;
+                case 0xE5 -> modifiers |= 0x1000;
+                case 0xE2 -> modifiers |= 0x400;
+                case 0xE6 -> modifiers |= 0x4000;
+                case 0xE3 -> modifiers |= 0x800;
+                case 0xE7 -> modifiers |= 0x8000;
+                default -> {
+                    if (code != 0) {
+                        baseCode = code;
+                    }
+                }
+            }
+        }
+        return modifiers | baseCode;
+    }
+
+    public static String sanitizeDescription(String value) {
+        if (value == null) {
+            return "";
+        }
+        String ascii = value.chars()
+            .filter(c -> c >= 0x20 && c <= 0x7E)
+            .limit(20)
+            .collect(StringBuilder::new, StringBuilder::appendCodePoint, StringBuilder::append)
+            .toString();
+        return ascii.strip(); // Firmware readback strips ASCII padding at both ends.
+    }
+
+    public static void writeSequentially(
+        BleManager ble,
+        List<LabeledCommand> commands,
+        Runnable onComplete,
+        Runnable onError,
+        Consumer<String> onProgress
+    ) {
+        new Thread(() -> {
+            try (var transaction = ble.maintenance().normalTransaction()) {
+                int i = 0;
+                for (LabeledCommand cmd : commands) {
+                    i++;
+                    if (onProgress != null) {
+                        onProgress.accept("保存中 (" + i + "/" + commands.size() + ") " + cmd.label());
+                    }
+                    ble.sendCommand(cmd.data());
+                    Thread.sleep(50);
+                }
+                Thread.sleep(250);
+                if (onComplete != null) {
+                    onComplete.run();
+                }
+            } catch (Exception e) {
+                if (onProgress != null) {
+                    onProgress.accept("保存失败：" + e.getMessage());
+                }
+                if (onError != null) {
+                    onError.run();
+                }
+            }
+        }, "aha-device-sync").start();
+    }

+package com.example.ahakey.service;
+
+import com.example.ahakey.model.IDEState;
+import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode;
+import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
+import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.node.ObjectNode;
+import org.slf4j.Logger;
+import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
+
+import java.io.BufferedReader;
+import java.io.IOException;
+import java.io.InputStreamReader;
+import java.io.PrintWriter;
+import java.net.InetSocketAddress;
+import java.net.ServerSocket;
+import java.net.Socket;
+import java.util.HashMap;
+import java.util.Map;
+import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
+import java.util.concurrent.Executors;
+import java.util.regex.Matcher;
+import java.util.regex.Pattern;
+
+public class HookDispatchServer {
+    private static final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(HookDispatchServer.class);
+    public static final int DEFAULT_PORT = 8765;
+
+    @FunctionalInterface
+    public interface ApprovalCallback {
+        boolean requestApproval(String platform, String eventName);
+    }
+
+    enum Platform { CLAUDE, CODEX, KIMI, CURSOR }
+    record EventEntry(Platform platform, IDEState state) {}
+    record HookPayload(String eventName, JsonNode json) {}
+
+    private static final Map<String, EventEntry> EVENT_MAP = new HashMap<>();
+
+    static {
+        for (String[] e : new String[][]{
+            {"SessionStart", "SESSION_START"}, {"SessionEnd", "SESSION_END"},
+            {"PreToolUse", "PRE_TOOL_USE"}, {"PostToolUse", "POST_TOOL_USE"},
+            {"Notification", "NOTIFICATION"}, {"TaskCompleted", "TASK_COMPLETED"},
+            {"Stop", "STOP"}, {"UserPromptSubmit", "USER_PROMPT_SUBMIT"}
+        }) EVENT_MAP.put(e[0], new EventEntry(Platform.CLAUDE, IDEState.valueOf(e[1])));
+        EVENT_MAP.put("PermissionRequest", new EventEntry(Platform.CLAUDE, IDEState.PERMISSION_REQUEST));
+
+        for (String[] e : new String[][]{
+            {"CodexSessionStart", "SESSION_START"}, {"CodexSessionEnd", "SESSION_END"},
+            {"CodexPreToolUse", "PRE_TOOL_USE"}, {"CodexPostToolUse", "POST_TOOL_USE"},
+            {"CodexStop", "STOP"}, {"CodexTaskCompleted", "TASK_COMPLETED"},
+            {"CodexUserPromptSubmit", "USER_PROMPT_SUBMIT"}
+        }) EVENT_MAP.put(e[0], new EventEntry(Platform.CODEX, IDEState.valueOf(e[1])));
+        EVENT_MAP.put("CodexPermissionRequest", new EventEntry(Platform.CODEX, IDEState.PERMISSION_REQUEST));
+
+        for (String[] e : new String[][]{
+            {"KimiNotification", "NOTIFICATION"}, {"KimiSessionStart", "SESSION_START"},
+            {"KimiSessionEnd", "SESSION_END"}, {"KimiPreToolUse", "PRE_TOOL_USE"},
+            {"KimiPostToolUse", "POST_TOOL_USE"}, {"KimiUserPromptSubmit", "USER_PROMPT_SUBMIT"},
+            {"KimiStop", "STOP"}
+        }) EVENT_MAP.put(e[0], new EventEntry(Platform.KIMI, IDEState.valueOf(e[1])));
+
+        for (String[] e : new String[][]{
+            {"sessionStart", "SESSION_START"}, {"sessionEnd", "SESSION_END"},
+            {"preToolUse", "PRE_TOOL_USE"}, {"postToolUse", "POST_TOOL_USE"},
+            {"stop", "STOP"}
+        }) EVENT_MAP.put(e[0], new EventEntry(Platform.CURSOR, IDEState.valueOf(e[1])));
+    }
+
+    private final BleManager bleManager;
+    private final AiRuntimeDisplayService runtimeDisplayService;
+    private final ObjectMapper mapper = new ObjectMapper();
+    private final int port;
+    private ServerSocket serverSocket;
+    private ExecutorService executor;
+    private volatile boolean running;
+    private ApprovalCallback approvalCallback;
+
+    public HookDispatchServer(BleManager bleManager) {
+        this(bleManager, null, DEFAULT_PORT);
+    }
+
+    public HookDispatchServer(BleManager bleManager, int port) {
+        this(bleManager, null, port);
+    }
+
+    public HookDispatchServer(BleManager bleManager, AiRuntimeDisplayService runtimeDisplayService) {
+        this(bleManager, runtimeDisplayService, DEFAULT_PORT);
+    }
+
+    public HookDispatchServer(BleManager bleManager, AiRuntimeDisplayService runtimeDisplayService, int port) {
+        this.bleManager = bleManager;
+        this.runtimeDisplayService = runtimeDisplayService;
+        this.port = port;
+    }
+
+    public void setApprovalCallback(ApprovalCallback callback) {
+        this.approvalCallback = callback;
+    }
+
+    public void start() {
+        if (running) {
+            return;
+        }
+        executor = Executors.newCachedThreadPool(r -> {
+            Thread t = new Thread(r, "hook-dispatch");
+            t.setDaemon(true);
+            return t;
+        });
+
+        int attempts = 0;
+        int tryPort = port;
+        while (attempts < 10) {
+            try {
+                serverSocket = new ServerSocket();
+                serverSocket.setReuseAddress(true);
+                serverSocket.bind(new InetSocketAddress("127.0.0.1", tryPort));
+                running = true;
+                logger.info("Hook dispatch server started - 127.0.0.1:{}", tryPort);
+                break;
+            } catch (IOException e) {
+                logger.warn("Hook dispatch port {} is busy, trying next port", tryPort);
+                tryPort++;
+                attempts++;
+            }
+        }
+
+        if (!running) {
+            logger.error("Hook dispatch server failed to start");
+            return;
+        }
+        executor.submit(this::acceptLoop);
+    }
+
+    public int getActualPort() {
+        return serverSocket != null ? serverSocket.getLocalPort() : -1;
+    }
+
+    public boolean isRunning() {
+        return running;
+    }
+
+    private void acceptLoop() {
+        while (running && !serverSocket.isClosed()) {
+            try {
+                Socket client = serverSocket.accept();
+                executor.submit(() -> handleClient(client));
+            } catch (IOException e) {
+                if (running) {
+                    logger.warn("Hook dispatch accept failed: {}", e.getMessage());
+                }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    private boolean checkAutoApproval(boolean forceRefresh) {
+        return bleManager.refreshAutoApproval();
+    }
+
+    private void handleClient(Socket client) {
+        try (client;
+             BufferedReader reader = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(client.getInputStream()));
+             PrintWriter writer = new PrintWriter(client.getOutputStream(), true)) {
+            String line = reader.readLine();
+            if (line == null || line.isBlank()) {
+                writer.println("{\"ok\":false,\"error\":\"empty\"}");
+                return;
+            }
+
+            HookPayload payload = parsePayload(line.trim());
+            EventEntry entry = EVENT_MAP.get(payload.eventName());
+            if (entry == null) {
+                logger.warn("Unknown hook event rejected; raw input omitted");
+                writer.println("{\"ok\":false,\"error\":\"unknown event\"}");
+                return;
+            }
+
+            switch (entry.platform()) {
+                case CLAUDE -> handleClaudeEvent(writer, payload.eventName(), entry.state(), payload.json());
+                case CODEX -> handleCodexEvent(writer, payload.eventName(), entry.state(), payload.json());
+                case KIMI -> handleKimiEvent(writer, payload.eventName(), entry.state(), payload.json());
+                case CURSOR -> handleCursorEvent(writer, payload.eventName(), entry.state(), payload.json());
+            }
+        } catch (IOException e) {
+            logger.debug("Hook client handling failed: {}", e.getMessage());
+        }
+    }
+
+    private void handleClaudeEvent(PrintWriter writer, String eventName, IDEState state, JsonNode payload) {
+        if (state == IDEState.PERMISSION_REQUEST) {
+            boolean auto = checkAutoApproval(false);
+            sendRuntimeState("Claude", state, payload);
+            boolean approved = auto;
+            writer.println("{\"ok\":true,\"event\":\"" + eventName + "\",\"autoApproved\":" + approved + "}");
+            return;
+        }
+        handleGeneric(writer, eventName, state, "Claude", payload);
+    }
+
+    private void handleCodexEvent(PrintWriter writer, String eventName, IDEState state, JsonNode payload) {
+        boolean needApproval = "CodexPreToolUse".equals(eventName) || state == IDEState.PERMISSION_REQUEST;
+        if (needApproval) {
+            boolean auto = checkAutoApproval(true);
+            sendRuntimeState("Codex", state, payload);
+            boolean approved = auto;
+            writer.println("{\"ok\":true,\"event\":\"" + eventName + "\",\"autoApproved\":" + approved + "}");
+            return;
+        }
+        handleGeneric(writer, eventName, state, "Codex", payload);
+    }
+
+    private void handleKimiEvent(PrintWriter writer, String eventName, IDEState state, JsonNode payload) {
+        if ("KimiPreToolUse".equals(eventName)) {
+            boolean auto = checkAutoApproval(true);
+            sendRuntimeState("Kimi", state, payload);
+            // The Kimi native adapter supplies AUTO; an empty hook result preserves native decisions.
+            writer.println("{}");
+            return;
+        }
+        handleGeneric(writer, eventName, state, "Kimi", payload);
+    }
+
+    private void handleCursorEvent(PrintWriter writer, String eventName, IDEState state, JsonNode payload) {
+        if ("preToolUse".equals(eventName)) {
+            boolean auto = checkAutoApproval(true);
+            sendRuntimeState("Cursor", state, payload);
+            if (auto) {
+                writer.println("{\"permission\":\"allow\"}");
+            } else {
+                writer.println("{\"ok\":true,\"cursorPermission\":\"defer_to_native\"}");
+            }
+            return;
+        }
+        handleGeneric(writer, eventName, state, "Cursor", payload);
+    }
+
+    private void handleGeneric(PrintWriter writer, String eventName, IDEState state, String platform, JsonNode payload) {
+        AiRuntimeDisplayService.Delivery delivery = runtimeDisplayService == null
+                ? (sendRuntimeState(platform, state, payload) ? AiRuntimeDisplayService.Delivery.SENT : AiRuntimeDisplayService.Delivery.FAILED)
+                : runtimeDisplayService.handleHookEventResult(platform, state, payload);
+        boolean displayUpdated = delivery == AiRuntimeDisplayService.Delivery.SENT;
+        writer.println("{\"ok\":true,\"event\":\"" + eventName + "\",\"state\":" + state.getCode()
+            + ",\"displayUpdated\":" + displayUpdated + ",\"delivery\":\"" + delivery.name() + "\"}");
+    }
+
+    private boolean sendRuntimeState(String platform, IDEState state, JsonNode payload) {
+        try {
+            if (runtimeDisplayService != null) {
+                return runtimeDisplayService.handleHookEvent(platform, state, payload);
+            }
+            return bleManager.sendRuntimeState((byte) state.getCode());
+        } catch (Exception e) {
+            logger.warn("[{}] runtime state update failed: {}", platform, e.getMessage());
+            return false;
+        }
+    }
+
+    private HookPayload parsePayload(String line) {
+        if (line.startsWith("{")) {
+            try {
+                JsonNode node = mapper.readTree(line);
+                String eventName = node.path("cmd").asText("");
+                if (eventName.isBlank()) {
+                    eventName = node.path("hook_event_name").asText("");
+                }
+                if (!eventName.isBlank()) {
+                    return new HookPayload(eventName, node);
+                }
+            } catch (Exception e) {
+                logger.debug("Hook JSON parse failed: {}", e.getClass().getSimpleName());
+                HookPayload fallback = parseMalformedJsonPayload(line);
+                if (fallback != null && !fallback.eventName().isBlank()) {
+                    return fallback;
+                }
+            }
+        }
+        return new HookPayload(line, null);
+    }
+
+    private HookPayload parseMalformedJsonPayload(String line) {
+        ObjectNode node = mapper.createObjectNode();
+        copyJsonStringField(line, node, "cmd");
+        copyJsonStringField(line, node, "hook_event_name");
+        copyJsonStringField(line, node, "conversation_id");
+        copyJsonStringField(line, node, "conversationId");
+        copyJsonStringField(line, node, "session_id");
+        copyJsonStringField(line, node, "sessionId");
+        copyJsonStringField(line, node, "composerId");
+        copyJsonStringField(line, node, "composer_id");
+        copyJsonStringField(line, node, "transcript_path");
+        copyJsonStringField(line, node, "transcriptPath");
+        copyJsonStringField(line, node, "cwd");
+        copyJsonStringField(line, node, "current_working_directory");
+        copyJsonStringField(line, node, "currentWorkingDirectory");
+
+        String eventName = node.path("cmd").asText("");
+        if (eventName.isBlank()) {
+            eventName = node.path("hook_event_name").asText("");
+        }
+        return eventName.isBlank() ? null : new HookPayload(eventName, node);
+    }
+
+    private void copyJsonStringField(String source, ObjectNode target, String fieldName) {
+        Matcher matcher = Pattern.compile("\\\\?\"" + Pattern.quote(fieldName) + "\\\\?\"\\s*:\\s*\\\\?\"([^\"\\\\]*(?:\\\\.[^\"\\\\]*)*)")
+            .matcher(source);
+        if (matcher.find()) {
+            target.put(fieldName, unescapeLooseJsonString(matcher.group(1)));
+        }
+    }
+
+    private String unescapeLooseJsonString(String value) {
+        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
+            return "";
+        }
+        return value
+            .replace("\\\\", "\\")
+            .replace("\\/", "/")
+            .replace("\\\"", "\"");
+    }
+
+    public void stop() {
+        running = false;
+        try {
+            if (serverSocket != null && !serverSocket.isClosed()) {
+                serverSocket.close();
+            }
+        } catch (IOException e) {
+            logger.warn("Hook dispatch close failed: {}", e.getMessage());
+        }
+        if (executor != null) {
+            executor.shutdownNow();
+        }
+        logger.info("Hook dispatch server stopped");
+    }
+}

+package com.example.ahakey.service;
+
+import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode;
+import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
+import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.node.ArrayNode;
+import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.node.ObjectNode;
+
+import java.nio.file.Files;
+import java.nio.file.Path;
+import java.nio.file.Paths;
+import java.nio.file.StandardCopyOption;
+import java.util.Arrays;
+import java.util.ArrayList;
+import java.util.List;
+import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
+import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
+import java.io.IOException;
+import java.util.regex.Pattern;
+import java.util.regex.Matcher;
+import java.util.Map;
+import java.util.function.Consumer;
+import java.util.function.IntSupplier;
+
+/**
+ * Hook 安装器 - 独立于 UI 的 Hook 管理服务
+ * 负责所有平台（Claude、Cursor、Codex、Kimi）的 Hook 安装、卸载和脚本生成
+ */
+public class HookInstaller {
+
+    private final IntSupplier portSupplier;
+    private final Consumer<String> logger;
+    private final ObjectMapper mapper = new ObjectMapper()
+            .enable(com.fasterxml.jackson.core.JsonParser.Feature.STRICT_DUPLICATE_DETECTION)
+            .enable(com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.DeserializationFeature.FAIL_ON_TRAILING_TOKENS);
+
+    // 各平台 Hook 脚本名称
+    private static final String CORE_SCRIPT_NAME   = "ahakey-core.ps1";
+    private static final String CLAUDE_SCRIPT_NAME = "ahakey-claude.ps1";
+    private static final String CODEX_SCRIPT_NAME  = "ahakey-codex.ps1";
+    private static final String KIMI_SCRIPT_NAME   = "ahakey-kimi.ps1";
+    private static final String CURSOR_SCRIPT_NAME = "ahakey-cursor.ps1";
+
+    // Hook 配置路径常量
+    public static final String CODEX_SIDECAR_NAME = ".ahakey_codex_hooks_v1";
+    public static final String AHAKEY_HOOK_VERSION = "wd009-native-defer-v1";
+    public enum HookStatus { DETECTING, APP_NOT_FOUND, NOT_INSTALLED, OUTDATED, LATEST, ERROR }
+    public record HookWriteResult(boolean success, String reason) {}
+    public record HookInspection(HookStatus status, String reason) {}
+    private static final Object HOOK_FILES_LOCK = new Object();
+    public static final String CODEX_HOOK_BLOCK_START = "# BEGIN AhaKey Codex Hooks";
+    public static final String CODEX_HOOK_BLOCK_END = "# END AhaKey Codex Hooks";
+    public static final String KIMI_HOOK_BLOCK_START = "# BEGIN AhaKey Kimi Hooks";
+    public static final String KIMI_HOOK_BLOCK_END = "# END AhaKey Kimi Hooks";
+
+    // Claude: 9 个事件
+    private static final String[][] CLAUDE_EVENTS = {
+        {"SessionStart", "10"}, {"SessionEnd", "10"}, {"PreToolUse", "10"},
+        {"PostToolUse", "10"}, {"PermissionRequest", "60"}, {"Notification", "10"},
+        {"TaskCompleted", "10"}, {"Stop", "10"}, {"UserPromptSubmit", "10"}
+    };
+
+    // Cursor: 5 个事件（preToolUse 需要长超时，因为手动模式弹出用户确认对话框）
+    private static final String[][] CURSOR_EVENTS = {
+        {"sessionStart", "10"}, {"sessionEnd", "10"}, {"preToolUse", "120"},
+        {"postToolUse", "10"}, {"stop", "10"}
+    };
+
+    // Codex: 6 个事件（与 Python CODEX_HOOK_EVENTS 完全一致）
+    private static final String[][] CODEX_EVENTS = {
+        {"SessionStart", "CodexSessionStart", "10"},
+        {"SessionEnd", "CodexSessionEnd", "10"},
+        {"PostToolUse", "CodexPostToolUse", "10"},
+        {"PreToolUse", "CodexPreToolUse", "20"},
+        {"PermissionRequest", "CodexPermissionRequest", "20"},
+        {"TaskCompleted", "CodexTaskCompleted", "10"},
+        {"UserPromptSubmit", "CodexUserPromptSubmit", "10"},
+        {"Stop", "CodexStop", "10"}
+    };
+
+    // Kimi: 7 个事件（与 TopBar.java 及 HookDispatchServer.java 保持一致）
+    // 第一列：标准事件名（写入 Kimi 配置文件，必须是 Kimi CLI 支持的值）
+    // 第二列：内部事件名（传递给 HookDispatchServer，用于映射到 IDEState）
+    private static final String[][] KIMI_EVENTS = {
+        {"Notification", "KimiNotification", "10"},
+        {"SessionStart", "KimiSessionStart", "10"},
+        {"SessionEnd", "KimiSessionEnd", "10"},
+        {"PreToolUse", "KimiPreToolUse", "20"},
+        {"PostToolUse", "KimiPostToolUse", "10"},
+        {"UserPromptSubmit", "KimiUserPromptSubmit", "10"},
+        {"Stop", "KimiStop", "10"}
+    };

+    public HookInstaller(int dispatchPort, Consumer<String> logger) {
+        this(() -> dispatchPort, logger);
+    }
+
+    public HookInstaller(IntSupplier portSupplier, Consumer<String> logger) {
+        this.portSupplier = portSupplier;
+        this.logger = logger;
+    }
+
+    private int currentPort() {
+        return portSupplier.getAsInt();
+    }
+
+    /**
+     * 生成所有 Hook 脚本（core + 各平台专属）
+     */
+    public void generateAllScripts() {
+        String home = System.getProperty("user.home");
+        Path hooksDir = Paths.get(home, ".ahakey", "hooks");
+        try {
+            Files.createDirectories(hooksDir);
+            generateCoreScript(hooksDir);
+            generateClaudeScript(hooksDir);
+            generateCodexScript(hooksDir);
+            generateKimiScript(hooksDir);
+            generateCursorScript(hooksDir);
+            log("[安装] 已生成所有 Hook 脚本");
+        } catch (Exception e) {
+            log("[警告] 生成 Hook 脚本失败: " + e.getMessage());
+        }
+    }
+
+    /**
+     * 安装指定平台的 Hook
+     */
+    public void install(String platform) {
+        installOrUpdate(platform);
+    }
+
+    public HookWriteResult installOrUpdate(String platform) {
+        synchronized (HOOK_FILES_LOCK) {
+            String step = "检查配置";
+            try {
+                scriptName(platform); // Validate before touching any file.
+                LinkedHashMap<Path, byte[]> plan = installPlan(platform);
+                step = "备份";
+                for (Path path : plan.keySet()) backupFile(path);
+                step = "写入";
+                for (var entry : plan.entrySet()) writeManagedFile(entry.getKey(), entry.getValue());
+                step = "回读核验";
+                for (var entry : plan.entrySet()) {
+                    if (!Arrays.equals(Files.readAllBytes(entry.getKey()), entry.getValue()))
+                        throw new IOException("写后内容不一致: " + entry.getKey());
+                }
+                HookInspection actual = inspectHook(platform);
+                if (actual.status() != HookStatus.LATEST) throw new IOException(actual.reason());
+                log("[成功] " + platform + " 脚本与配置已回读核验");
+                return new HookWriteResult(true, platform + "：已更新并核验本地脚本和配置");
+            } catch (Exception e) {
+                Throwable cause=e; while(cause.getCause()!=null)cause=cause.getCause();
+                String reason=platform+"／"+step+"失败："+cause.getMessage()+"；已完成的备份保留";
+                log("[错误] " + reason);
+                return new HookWriteResult(false, reason);
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    public Map<String, HookWriteResult> installOrUpdateAll(List<String> platforms) {
+        Map<String, HookWriteResult> results = new LinkedHashMap<>();
+        for (String platform : platforms) results.put(platform, installOrUpdate(platform));
+        return results;
+    }
+
+    /** Atomic file replacement; override only in isolated failure-injection checks. */
+    protected void writeManagedFile(Path path, byte[] content) throws Exception {
+        Files.createDirectories(path.getParent());
+        Path temporary = Files.createTempFile(path.getParent(), ".ahakey-write-", ".tmp");
+        try {
+            Files.write(temporary, content);
+            try { Files.move(temporary, path, StandardCopyOption.ATOMIC_MOVE, StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING); }
+            catch (java.nio.file.AtomicMoveNotSupportedException unsupported) {
+                Files.move(temporary, path, StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);
+            }
+        } finally { Files.deleteIfExists(temporary); }
+    }
+
+    /**
+     * 卸载指定平台的 Hook
+     */
+    public void uninstall(String platform) {
+        switch (platform) {
+            case "Claude": uninstallClaudeHooks(); break;
+            case "Cursor": uninstallCursorHooks(); break;
+            case "Codex": uninstallCodexHooks(); break;
+            case "Kimi": uninstallKimiHooks(); break;
+            default: log("[错误] 未知 Hook 类型: " + platform);
+        }
+    }
+
+    /**
+     * 检查指定平台的 Hook 是否已安装
+     */
+    public boolean isInstalled(String platform) {
+        synchronized (HOOK_FILES_LOCK) {
+            try { return hasManagedConfiguration(platform); }
+            catch (Exception e) { return false; }
+        }
+    }
+
+    public HookStatus getHookStatus(String platform) { return inspectHook(platform).status(); }
+
+    public HookInspection inspectHook(String platform) {
+        synchronized (HOOK_FILES_LOCK) {
+            try {
+                String scriptName=scriptName(platform);
+                requirePort();
+                if (!isAppDetected(platform)) return new HookInspection(HookStatus.APP_NOT_FOUND, "未检测到对应应用的本地目录");
+                if (!hasManagedConfiguration(platform)) return new HookInspection(HookStatus.NOT_INSTALLED, "尚未找到本平台的 AhaKey 事件配置");
+                Path dir=Paths.get(System.getProperty("user.home"),".ahakey","hooks");
+                for (String name : List.of(scriptName, CORE_SCRIPT_NAME)) {
+                    Path script=dir.resolve(name);
+                    if (!Files.exists(script)) return new HookInspection(HookStatus.OUTDATED,"缺少脚本："+name);
+                    String expected=name.equals(CORE_SCRIPT_NAME)?coreScriptContent():platformScriptContent(platform);
+                    if (!normalizedScript(Files.readString(script,StandardCharsets.UTF_8)).equals(normalizedScript(expected)))
+                        return new HookInspection(HookStatus.OUTDATED,(name.equals(CORE_SCRIPT_NAME)?"共享 core 内容或服务端口不匹配：":"平台脚本内容不匹配：")+name);
+                }
+                String mismatch=configurationMismatch(platform);
+                if (mismatch!=null) return new HookInspection(HookStatus.OUTDATED,mismatch);
+                String auxiliary="";
+                if (platform.equals("Codex")) {
+                    Path marker=Paths.get(System.getProperty("user.home"),".codex",CODEX_SIDECAR_NAME);
+                    try {
+                        if (!Files.exists(marker) || !Files.readString(marker,StandardCharsets.UTF_8).contains(AHAKEY_HOOK_VERSION))
+                            auxiliary="；辅助安装记录缺失或较旧，无需因此重装";
+                    } catch(IOException unreadable) { auxiliary="；辅助安装记录不可读取，不影响已核验内容"; }
+                }
+                return new HookInspection(HookStatus.LATEST,"当前软件所需的脚本与配置已匹配"+auxiliary);
+            } catch(Exception e) {
+                return new HookInspection(HookStatus.ERROR,platform+" 配置或脚本无法核验（"+managedConfigPath(platform).getParent()+"）："+e.getMessage());
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    // ==================== 脚本生成 ====================
+
+    private void generateCoreScript(Path hooksDir) throws Exception {
+        Files.write(hooksDir.resolve(CORE_SCRIPT_NAME), coreScriptContent().getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
+    }

+    private String coreScriptContent() {
+        String content =
+            "# AhaKey Core - Auto-generated, do not edit\n" +
+            "# ahakey-hook-version: " + AHAKEY_HOOK_VERSION + "\n" +
+            "# Contains TCP connection logic, to be dot-sourced by platform-specific scripts\n" +
+            "try {\n" +
+            "    $stdinText = $null\n" +
+            "    if ([Console]::IsInputRedirected) { $stdinText = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() }\n" +
+            "} catch { }\n" +
+            "$payload = [ordered]@{ cmd = $EventName; ahakeyHookVersion = '" + AHAKEY_HOOK_VERSION + "'; cwd = (Get-Location).Path }\n" +
+            "function Add-AhaKeyField([string]$Name) {\n" +
+            "    $m = [regex]::Match($stdinText, '\"' + $Name + '\"\\s*:\\s*\"([^\"]*)\"')\n" +
+            "    if ($m.Success) { $payload[$Name] = $m.Groups[1].Value }\n" +
+            "}\n" +
+            "if ($stdinText -and $stdinText.Trim().Length -gt 0) {\n" +
+            "    try { $payload.hookInput = ($stdinText | ConvertFrom-Json) } catch {\n" +
+            "        Add-AhaKeyField 'conversation_id'\n" +
+            "        Add-AhaKeyField 'conversationId'\n" +
+            "        Add-AhaKeyField 'session_id'\n" +
+            "        Add-AhaKeyField 'sessionId'\n" +
+            "        Add-AhaKeyField 'composerId'\n" +
+            "        Add-AhaKeyField 'composer_id'\n" +
+            "        Add-AhaKeyField 'transcript_path'\n" +
+            "        Add-AhaKeyField 'transcriptPath'\n" +
+            "        $payload.hookInputRawBase64 = [Convert]::ToBase64String([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($stdinText))\n" +
+            "    }\n" +
+            "}\n" +
+            "$jsonLine = ($payload | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 20 -Compress)\n" +
+            "try {\n" +
+            "    $tcp = New-Object System.Net.Sockets.TcpClient\n" +
+            "    $tcp.Connect('127.0.0.1', " + currentPort() + ")\n" +
+            "    $writer = New-Object System.IO.StreamWriter($tcp.GetStream())\n" +
+            "    $writer.WriteLine($jsonLine)\n" +
+            "    $writer.Flush()\n" +
+            "    $reader = New-Object System.IO.StreamReader($tcp.GetStream())\n" +
+            "    $response = $reader.ReadLine()\n" +
+            "    $tcp.Close()\n" +
+            "} catch {\n" +
+            "    $response = $null\n" +
+            "}\n";
+        return content;
+    }
