+    private String scriptName(String platform) {
+        return switch (platform) {
+            case "Claude" -> CLAUDE_SCRIPT_NAME;
+            case "Cursor" -> CURSOR_SCRIPT_NAME;
+            case "Codex" -> CODEX_SCRIPT_NAME;
+            case "Kimi" -> KIMI_SCRIPT_NAME;
+            default -> throw new IllegalArgumentException("未知平台: " + platform);
+        };
+    }
+
+    private String platformScriptContent(String platform) {
+        return switch (platform) {
+            case "Claude" -> claudeScriptContent();
+            case "Cursor" -> cursorScriptContent();
+            case "Codex" -> codexScriptContent();
+            case "Kimi" -> kimiScriptContent();
+            default -> throw new IllegalArgumentException("未知平台: " + platform);
+        };
+    }
+
+    private String normalizedScript(String text) {
+        return text.replace("\uFEFF", "").replace("\r\n", "\n").replace('\r', '\n').stripTrailing();
+    }
+
+    private Path managedConfigPath(String platform) {
+        return platform.equals("Codex") ? Paths.get(System.getProperty("user.home"), ".codex", "hooks.json") : getHookConfigPath(platform);
+    }
+
+    private String readText(Path path) throws IOException {
+        return Files.exists(path) ? Files.readString(path, StandardCharsets.UTF_8) : "";
+    }
+
+    private void requirePort() throws IOException {
+        if (currentPort() < 1 || currentPort() > 65535) throw new IOException("Hook 服务尚未就绪（端口无效），请在服务启动后重试");
+    }
+
+    private LinkedHashMap<Path, byte[]> installPlan(String platform) throws Exception {
+        requirePort();
+        LinkedHashMap<Path, byte[]> plan = new LinkedHashMap<>();
+        Path config = managedConfigPath(platform);
+        if (platform.equals("Kimi")) {
+            String content = readText(config);
+            validateToml(content);
+            int[] block = managedBlock(content, KIMI_HOOK_BLOCK_START, KIMI_HOOK_BLOCK_END);
+            String replacement = buildKimiHookBlock().stripTrailing();
+            String merged = block == null ? content + (content.endsWith("\n") || content.isEmpty() ? "" : "\n") + replacement + "\n"
+                    : content.substring(0, block[0]) + replacement + content.substring(block[1]);
+            validateToml(merged);
+            addChanged(plan, config, merged);
+        } else {
+            ObjectNode root = checkedSettings(config, platform);
+            ObjectNode hooks = root.has("hooks") ? (ObjectNode) root.get("hooks") : mapper.createObjectNode();
+            ObjectNode cleaned = selectManaged(hooks, platform, false);
+            ObjectNode expected = expectedHooks(platform);
+            expected.fields().forEachRemaining(event -> {
+                ArrayNode entries = cleaned.has(event.getKey()) ? (ArrayNode) cleaned.get(event.getKey()) : mapper.createArrayNode();
+                event.getValue().forEach(entries::add);
+                cleaned.set(event.getKey(), entries);
+            });
+            root.set("hooks", cleaned);
+            if (platform.equals("Cursor")) root.put("version", 1);
+            addChanged(plan, config, mapper.writerWithDefaultPrettyPrinter().writeValueAsString(root));
+            if (platform.equals("Codex")) {
+                Path toml = config.resolveSibling("config.toml");
+                addChanged(plan, toml, codexFeature(readText(toml)));
+                addChanged(plan, config.resolveSibling(CODEX_SIDECAR_NAME), AHAKEY_HOOK_VERSION + "\n");
+            }
+        }
+        // The entire configuration is validated before any write or backup occurs.
+        Path scripts = Paths.get(System.getProperty("user.home"), ".ahakey", "hooks");
+        addChanged(plan, scripts.resolve(CORE_SCRIPT_NAME), coreScriptContent());
+        addChanged(plan, scripts.resolve(scriptName(platform)), platformScriptContent(platform));
+        return plan;
+    }
+
+    private void addChanged(Map<Path, byte[]> plan, Path path, String content) throws IOException {
+        byte[] bytes = content.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
+        if (!Files.exists(path) || !Arrays.equals(Files.readAllBytes(path), bytes)) plan.put(path, bytes);
+    }
+
+    private ObjectNode checkedSettings(Path path, String platform) throws Exception {
+        ObjectNode root = loadJsonSettings(path);
+        if (!root.has("hooks")) return root;
+        if (!root.get("hooks").isObject()) throw new IOException(path + ": hooks 必须为对象，原文件未改动");
+        var events = root.get("hooks").fields();
+        while (events.hasNext()) {
+            var event = events.next();
+            if (!event.getValue().isArray()) throw new IOException(path + ": " + event.getKey() + " 必须为数组");
+            for (JsonNode entry : event.getValue()) {
+                if (!entry.isObject()) throw new IOException(path + ": 事件条目必须为对象");
+                if (platform.equals("Cursor")) validateCommand(entry, path);
+                else {
+                    if (!entry.path("hooks").isArray()) throw new IOException(path + ": wrapper.hooks 必须为数组");
+                    for (JsonNode command : entry.get("hooks")) validateCommand(command, path);
+                }
+            }
+        }
+        return root;
+    }
+
+    private void validateCommand(JsonNode entry, Path path) throws IOException {
+        if (!entry.isObject() || (entry.has("command") && !entry.get("command").isTextual()))
+            throw new IOException(path + ": command 条目格式无效");
+        // Third-party non-command entries are retained without interpreting their schema.
+    }
+
+    private ObjectNode expectedHooks(String platform) {
+        ObjectNode hooks = mapper.createObjectNode();
+        String[][] events = platform.equals("Cursor") ? CURSOR_EVENTS : platform.equals("Codex") ? CODEX_EVENTS : CLAUDE_EVENTS;
+        for (String[] event : events) {
+            String argument = platform.equals("Codex") ? event[1] : event[0];
+            String timeout = event[platform.equals("Codex") ? 2 : 1];
+            ObjectNode command = mapper.createObjectNode();
+            command.put("command", buildHookCommand(scriptName(platform), argument));
+            command.put("timeout", Integer.parseInt(timeout));
+            ArrayNode entries = mapper.createArrayNode();
+            if (platform.equals("Cursor")) entries.add(command);
+            else {
+                command.put("type", "command");
+                ObjectNode wrapper = mapper.createObjectNode();
+                if (platform.equals("Claude")) wrapper.put("matcher", "");
+                else if (event[0].equals("SessionStart")) wrapper.put("matcher", "startup|resume|clear");
+                else if (!event[0].equals("Stop") && !event[0].equals("UserPromptSubmit")) wrapper.put("matcher", "*");
+                wrapper.set("hooks", mapper.createArrayNode().add(command));
+                entries.add(wrapper);
+            }
+            hooks.set(event[0], entries);
+        }
+        return hooks;
+    }
+
+    private boolean ownsCommand(JsonNode entry, String platform) {
+        String command = entry.path("command").asText("").replace('\\', '/');
+        // Own only a PowerShell -File invocation of this platform's script, not an incidental mention.
+        Matcher executable = Pattern.compile("(?i)^\\s*(?:powershell(?:\\.exe)?|pwsh(?:\\.exe)?)\\s+").matcher(command);
+        if (!executable.find()) return false;
+        Matcher file = Pattern.compile("(?i)(?:^|\\s)-File\\s+(?:\"([^\"]+)\"|'([^']+)'|([^\\s]+))").matcher(command);
+        if (!file.find()) return false;
+        String path = file.group(1) != null ? file.group(1) : file.group(2) != null ? file.group(2) : file.group(3);
+        String expected = Paths.get(System.getProperty("user.home"), ".ahakey", "hooks", scriptName(platform)).toString().replace('\\', '/');
+        return path.equalsIgnoreCase(expected);
+    }
+
+    private ObjectNode selectManaged(ObjectNode hooks, String platform, boolean owned) {
+        ObjectNode result = mapper.createObjectNode();
+        hooks.fields().forEachRemaining(event -> {
+            ArrayNode selected = mapper.createArrayNode();
+            for (JsonNode entry : event.getValue()) {
+                if (platform.equals("Cursor")) {
+                    if (ownsCommand(entry, platform) == owned) selected.add(entry.deepCopy());
+                } else {
+                    ArrayNode commands = mapper.createArrayNode();
+                    for (JsonNode command : entry.get("hooks")) if (ownsCommand(command, platform) == owned) commands.add(command.deepCopy());
+                    if (!commands.isEmpty() || (!owned && entry.get("hooks").isEmpty())) {
+                        ObjectNode wrapper = entry.deepCopy();
+                        wrapper.set("hooks", commands);
+                        selected.add(wrapper);
+                    }
+                }
+            }
+            if (!selected.isEmpty()) result.set(event.getKey(), selected);
+        });
+        return result;
+    }
+
+    private JsonNode normalizeCommands(JsonNode node) {
+        JsonNode copy = node.deepCopy();
+        if (copy.isObject()) {
+            ObjectNode object = (ObjectNode) copy;
+            List<String> fields = new ArrayList<>(); object.fieldNames().forEachRemaining(fields::add);
+            for (String field : fields) {
+                if (field.equals("command") && object.get(field).isTextual())
+                    object.put(field, object.get(field).asText().replace('\\', '/').replace("\r\n", "\n").trim());
+                else object.set(field, normalizeCommands(object.get(field)));
+            }
+        } else if (copy.isArray()) {
+            ArrayNode array = (ArrayNode) copy;
+            for (int i = 0; i < array.size(); i++) array.set(i, normalizeCommands(array.get(i)));
+        }
+        return copy;
+    }
+
+    private boolean hasManagedConfiguration(String platform) throws Exception {
+        Path path = managedConfigPath(platform);
+        if (!Files.exists(path)) return false;
+        if (platform.equals("Kimi")) {
+            String content = readText(path); validateToml(content);
+            return managedBlock(content, KIMI_HOOK_BLOCK_START, KIMI_HOOK_BLOCK_END) != null;
+        }
+        ObjectNode root = checkedSettings(path, platform);
+        return root.has("hooks") && !selectManaged((ObjectNode) root.get("hooks"), platform, true).isEmpty();
+    }
+
+    private String configurationMismatch(String platform) throws Exception {
+        Path path = managedConfigPath(platform);
+        if (platform.equals("Kimi")) {
+            String content = readText(path);
+            int[] block = managedBlock(content, KIMI_HOOK_BLOCK_START, KIMI_HOOK_BLOCK_END);
+            return block == null || !normalizedScript(content.substring(block[0], block[1])).equals(normalizedScript(buildKimiHookBlock()))
+                    ? "Kimi 已有事件配置不匹配：" + path : null;
+        }
+        ObjectNode root = checkedSettings(path, platform);
+        JsonNode actual = selectManaged((ObjectNode) root.get("hooks"), platform, true);
+        if (!normalizeCommands(actual).equals(normalizeCommands(expectedHooks(platform)))) return "事件、命令、匹配条件或超时配置不匹配：" + path;
+        if (platform.equals("Cursor") && !root.path("version").isIntegralNumber()) return "Cursor 配置缺少有效 version：" + path;
+        if (platform.equals("Cursor") && root.path("version").asInt() != 1) return "Cursor 配置 version 不匹配：" + path;
+        if (platform.equals("Codex")) {
+            Path toml = path.resolveSibling("config.toml");
+            String content = readText(toml);
+            if (!codexFeature(content).equals(content)) return "Codex [features].hooks 尚未启用：" + toml;
+        }
+        return null;
+    }
+
+    private int[] managedBlock(String text, String start, String end) throws IOException {
+        // The fixed-version TOML lexer distinguishes actual comments from marker text inside strings.
+        var lexer = new org.tomlj.internal.TomlLexer(org.antlr.v4.runtime.CharStreams.fromString(text));
+        List<Integer> starts = new ArrayList<>(), ends = new ArrayList<>();
+        for (org.antlr.v4.runtime.Token token = lexer.nextToken(); token.getType() != org.antlr.v4.runtime.Token.EOF; token = lexer.nextToken()) {
+            if (token.getType() != org.tomlj.internal.TomlLexer.Comment) continue;
+            int offset = text.offsetByCodePoints(0, token.getStartIndex());
+            int lineStart = text.lastIndexOf('\n', Math.max(0, offset - 1)) + 1;
+            if (!text.substring(lineStart, offset).isBlank()) continue;
+            String comment = token.getText().stripTrailing();
+            if (comment.equals(start)) starts.add(offset);
+            if (comment.equals(end)) ends.add(offset + comment.length());
+        }
+        if (starts.isEmpty() && ends.isEmpty()) return null;
+        if (starts.size() != 1 || ends.size() != 1 || starts.get(0) >= ends.get(0))
+            throw new IOException("AhaKey 管理块不完整或重复，保留原配置，请先检查标记");
+        return new int[]{starts.get(0), ends.get(0)};
+    }
+
+    private org.tomlj.TomlParseResult parseToml(String text) throws IOException {
+        org.tomlj.TomlParseResult parsed = org.tomlj.Toml.parse(text);
+        if (parsed.hasErrors()) {
+            // Report position only: configuration values may contain credentials.
+            throw new IOException("TOML 配置格式无效（" + parsed.errors().get(0).position() + "），原文件保留");
+        }
+        return parsed;
+    }
+
+    private void validateToml(String text) throws IOException { parseToml(text); }
+
+    private int sourceOffset(String text, org.tomlj.TomlPosition position) throws IOException {
+        int offset = 0;
+        for (int line = 1; line < position.line(); line++) {
+            int next = text.indexOf('\n', offset);
+            if (next < 0) throw new IOException("TOML 源位置无法确认，原文件保留");
+            offset = next + 1;
+        }
+        return text.offsetByCodePoints(offset, position.column() - 1);
+    }
+
+    /** Parse for truth, edit a single source span: never serialize unrelated TOML settings. */
+    private String codexFeature(String text) throws IOException {
+        var parsed = parseToml(text);
+        Object existing = parsed.get("features.hooks");
+        if (existing != null && !(existing instanceof Boolean)) throw new IOException("Codex features.hooks 必须为布尔值");
+        if (Boolean.TRUE.equals(existing)) return text;
+        String newline = text.contains("\r\n") ? "\r\n" : "\n";
+        String updated;
+        if (Boolean.FALSE.equals(existing)) {
+            int start = sourceOffset(text, parsed.inputPositionOf("features.hooks"));
+            Matcher assignment = Pattern.compile("[^=\\r\\n]*=\\s*(false)(?=\\s|[,}#]|$)").matcher(text);
+            assignment.region(start, text.length());
+            if (!assignment.lookingAt()) throw new IOException("Codex hooks 源位置无法确认，原文件保留");
+            updated = text.substring(0, assignment.start(1)) + "true" + text.substring(assignment.end(1));
+        } else if (parsed.contains("features")) {
+            if (!parsed.isTable("features")) throw new IOException("Codex features 必须为表，原文件保留");
+            int start = sourceOffset(text, parsed.inputPositionOf("features"));
+            int end = text.indexOf('\n', start); if (end < 0) end = text.length(); else end++;
+            String line = text.substring(start, end);
+            if (line.matches("(?s)\\[\\s*(?:features|\"features\"|'features')\\s*\\]\\s*(?:#.*)?")) {
+                updated = text.substring(0, end) + (end > 0 && text.charAt(end - 1) == '\n' ? "" : newline) + "hooks = true" + newline + text.substring(end);
+            } else {
+                Matcher inline = Pattern.compile("(?:features|\"features\"|'features')\\s*=\\s*\\{").matcher(text);
+                inline.region(start, text.length());
+                if (inline.lookingAt()) {
+                    int brace = inline.end();
+                    boolean empty = parsed.getTable("features").isEmpty();
+                    updated = text.substring(0, brace) + " hooks = true" + (empty ? " " : ", ") + text.substring(brace);
+                } else if (!line.stripLeading().startsWith("[")) {
+                    // An existing dotted assignment has no explicit section to insert into.
+                    updated = "features.hooks = true" + newline + text;
+                } else {
+                    // Parent table was implicit in [features.child]. TOML permits declaring it later.
+                    updated = text + (text.endsWith("\n") ? "" : newline) + "[features]" + newline + "hooks = true" + newline;
+                }
+            }
+        } else {
+            updated = text + (text.endsWith("\n") || text.isEmpty() ? "" : newline) + "[features]" + newline + "hooks = true" + newline;
+        }
+        if (!Boolean.TRUE.equals(parseToml(updated).get("features.hooks"))) throw new IOException("Codex hooks 修改无法核验，原文件保留");
+        return updated;
+    }
+
+    // ==================== 卸载方法 ====================
+
+    private void uninstallClaudeHooks() {
+        Path path = getHookConfigPath("Claude");
+        try {
+            if (!path.toFile().exists()) { log("[信息] Claude 配置文件不存在"); return; }
+            ObjectNode settings = loadJsonSettings(path);
+            if (settings.has("hooks")) {
+                settings.remove("hooks");
+                mapper.writerWithDefaultPrettyPrinter().writeValue(path.toFile(), settings);
+                log("[成功] Hook 配置已从 " + path + " 中移除");
+            } else {
+                log("[警告] 未找到 Claude Hook 配置");
+            }
+        } catch (Exception e) { log("[错误] Claude 卸载失败: " + e.getMessage()); }
+    }
+
+    private void uninstallCursorHooks() {
+        Path path = getHookConfigPath("Cursor");
+        try {
+            if (!path.toFile().exists()) { log("[信息] Cursor 配置文件不存在"); return; }
+            ObjectNode settings = loadJsonSettings(path);
+            if (settings.has("hooks")) {
+                settings.remove("hooks");
+                mapper.writerWithDefaultPrettyPrinter().writeValue(path.toFile(), settings);
+                log("[成功] Hook 配置已从 " + path + " 中移除");
+            } else {
+                log("[警告] 未找到 Cursor Hook 配置");
+            }
+        } catch (Exception e) { log("[错误] Cursor 卸载失败: " + e.getMessage()); }
+    }
+
+    private void uninstallCodexHooks() {
+        String home = System.getProperty("user.home");
+        Path hooksJson = Paths.get(home, ".codex", "hooks.json");
+        Path configToml = Paths.get(home, ".codex", "config.toml");
+        Path sidecar = Paths.get(home, ".codex", CODEX_SIDECAR_NAME);
+        try {
+            if (sidecar.toFile().exists()) {
+                Files.delete(sidecar);
+                log("[成功] 已删除 sidecar 标记");
+            } else {
+                log("[信息] sidecar 标记不存在");
+            }
+            if (hooksJson.toFile().exists()) {
+                ObjectNode settings = loadJsonSettings(hooksJson);
+                if (settings.has("hooks")) {
+                    settings.remove("hooks");
+                    mapper.writerWithDefaultPrettyPrinter().writeValue(hooksJson.toFile(), settings);
+                    log("[成功] Hook 配置已从 " + hooksJson + " 中移除");
+                }
+            }
+            if (configToml.toFile().exists()) {
+                String content = new String(Files.readAllBytes(configToml), java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
+                String cleaned = removeCodexHookBlock(content);
+                if (!cleaned.equals(content)) {
+                    Files.write(configToml, cleaned.getBytes(java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
+                    log("[成功] Hook 块已从 " + configToml + " 中移除");
+                }
+            }
+        } catch (Exception e) { log("[错误] Codex 卸载失败: " + e.getMessage()); }
+    }
+
+    private void uninstallKimiHooks() {
+        Path path = getHookConfigPath("Kimi");
+        try {
+            if (!path.toFile().exists()) { log("[信息] Kimi 配置文件不存在"); return; }
+            String content = new String(Files.readAllBytes(path), java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
+            String cleaned = removeKimiHookBlock(content);
+            if (!cleaned.equals(content)) {
+                Files.write(path, cleaned.getBytes(java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
+                log("[成功] Hook 块已从配置文件中删除");
+            } else {
+                log("[警告] 未找到 AhaKey Hook 块");
+            }
+        } catch (Exception e) { log("[错误] Kimi 卸载失败: " + e.getMessage()); }
+    }
+
+    // ==================== 辅助方法 ====================
+
+    private String buildHookCommand(String scriptName, String agentEvent) {
+        String home = System.getProperty("user.home");
+        Path scriptPath = Paths.get(home, ".ahakey", "hooks", scriptName);
+        String ps = scriptPath.toString().replace("\\", "/");
+        return "powershell -NoLogo -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File \"" + ps + "\" " + agentEvent;
+    }
+
+    public Path getHookConfigPath(String hookName) {
+        String home = System.getProperty("user.home");
+        return switch (hookName) {
+            case "Claude" -> Paths.get(home, ".claude", "hooks", CLAUDE_SCRIPT_NAME);
+            case "Cursor" -> Paths.get(home, ".cursor", "hooks.json");
+            case "Codex" -> Paths.get(home, ".codex", CODEX_SIDECAR_NAME);
+            case "Kimi" -> Paths.get(home, ".config", "kimi-cli", "hooks.json");
+            default -> Paths.get(home, ".ahakey", "hooks", "ahakey-" + hookName.toLowerCase() + ".ps1");
+        };
+    }
+
+    public boolean isAppDetected(String hookName) {
+        String home = System.getProperty("user.home");
+        return switch (hookName) {
+            case "Claude" -> Files.isDirectory(Paths.get(home, ".claude"));
+            case "Cursor" -> Files.isDirectory(defaultCursorUserDir()) || Files.isDirectory(Paths.get(home, ".cursor"));
+            case "Codex" -> Files.isDirectory(Paths.get(home, ".codex"));
+            case "Kimi" -> Files.isDirectory(Paths.get(home, ".config", "kimi-cli"));
+            default -> false;
+        };
+    }
+
+    private Path defaultCursorUserDir() {
+        String appData = System.getenv("APPDATA");
+        if (appData == null || appData.isBlank()) {
+            return Paths.get(System.getProperty("user.home"), "AppData", "Roaming", "Cursor", "User");
+        }
+        return Paths.get(appData, "Cursor", "User");
+    }
+
+    private ObjectNode loadJsonSettings(Path path) throws Exception {
+        if (!path.toFile().exists()) {
+            return mapper.createObjectNode();
+        }
+        JsonNode node = mapper.readTree(path.toFile());
+        if (node instanceof ObjectNode) {
+            return (ObjectNode) node;
+        }
+        throw new IOException(path + ": JSON 根必须为对象，原配置未修改");
+    }
+
+    private void backupFile(Path path) throws Exception {
+        if (path.toFile().exists()) {
+            Path backup = path.resolveSibling(path.getFileName() + ".ahakey-backup-" + java.time.Instant.now().toEpochMilli() + "-" + java.util.UUID.randomUUID() + ".bak");
+            Files.copy(path, backup);
+        }
+    }
+
+    private String buildKimiHookBlock() {
+        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
+        sb.append(KIMI_HOOK_BLOCK_START).append("\n");
+        sb.append("# Managed by AhaKey. Kimi CLI hooks run this installer with Kimi* event names.\n");
+        sb.append("# Re-run Install Kimi Hooks after upgrading kimi-cli so the dial-control patch is restored.\n");
+        for (String[] ev : KIMI_EVENTS) {
+            sb.append("\n[[hooks]]\n");
+            sb.append("event = \"").append(ev[0]).append("\"\n");
+            sb.append("matcher = \"\"\n");
+            sb.append("command = \"").append(tomlEscape(buildHookCommand(KIMI_SCRIPT_NAME, ev[1]))).append("\"\n");
+            sb.append("timeout = ").append(ev[2]).append("\n");
+        }
+        sb.append("\n").append(KIMI_HOOK_BLOCK_END).append("\n");
+        return sb.toString();
+    }
+
+    private String tomlEscape(String s) {
+        return s.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("\"", "\\\"");
+    }
+
+    private String removeKimiHookBlock(String content) {
+        return removeBlock(content, KIMI_HOOK_BLOCK_START, KIMI_HOOK_BLOCK_END);
+    }
+
+    private String removeCodexHookBlock(String content) {
+        return removeBlock(content, CODEX_HOOK_BLOCK_START, CODEX_HOOK_BLOCK_END);
+    }
+
+    private String removeBlock(String content, String startMarker, String endMarker) {
+        String result = content;
+        while (true) {
+            int start = result.indexOf(startMarker);
+            if (start == -1) break;
+            int end = result.indexOf(endMarker, start);
+            if (end == -1) break;
+            result = result.substring(0, start).trim() + "\n" + result.substring(end + endMarker.length()).trim();
+        }
+        return result.trim();
+    }
+
+    private void log(String message) {
+        if (logger != null) {
+            logger.accept(message);
+        }
+    }

+package com.example.ahakey.service;
+
+import com.example.ahakey.model.KeyConfig;
+import com.sun.jna.platform.win32.User32;
+import com.sun.jna.platform.win32.WinUser;
+import java.util.ArrayList;
+import java.util.LinkedHashSet;
+import java.util.List;
+
+/** Executes an immutable editor snapshot. No device transport or focus changes. */
+public final class KeySimulationService {
+    public record Step(String action, int param) {}
+    public record Plan(List<Step> steps) {
+        public Plan { steps = List.copyOf(steps); }
+    }
+    @FunctionalInterface public interface KeySink { void send(int hid, boolean up) throws Exception; }
+    @FunctionalInterface public interface Delay { void sleep(long milliseconds) throws InterruptedException; }
+
+    private KeySimulationService() {}
+
+    /** Call on the editor thread, before handing work to the background executor. */
+    public static Plan snapshot(KeyConfig key) {
+        List<Step> steps = new ArrayList<>();
+        if (key.usesMacro()) {
+            for (int i = 0; i < key.getMacroStepCount(); i++)
+                steps.add(new Step(key.getMacroStepAction(i), key.getMacroStepParam(i)));
+        } else {
+            int code = key.getHidCode();
+            int[] masks = {0x100, 0x200, 0x400, 0x800, 0x1000, 0x2000, 0x4000, 0x8000};
+            int[] modifiers = {0xE1, 0xE0, 0xE2, 0xE3, 0xE5, 0xE4, 0xE6, 0xE7};
+            for (int i = 0; i < masks.length; i++)
+                if ((code & masks[i]) != 0) steps.add(new Step("DOWN_KEY", modifiers[i]));
+            if ((code & 0xFF) != 0) steps.add(new Step("DOWN_KEY", code & 0xFF));
+            for (int i = steps.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) steps.add(new Step("UP_KEY", steps.get(i).param()));
+        }
+        if (steps.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("未设置按键，无法模拟。");
+        // Validate the entire plan before sending even its first key.
+        for (Step step : steps) {
+            if ("DELAY".equals(step.action())) {
+                if (step.param() < 0 || step.param() > 255) throw new IllegalArgumentException("宏延时超出范围。");
+            } else if ("DOWN_KEY".equals(step.action()) || "UP_KEY".equals(step.action())) {
+                virtualKey(step.param());
+            } else throw new IllegalArgumentException("不支持的模拟动作：" + step.action());
+        }
+        return new Plan(steps);
+    }
+
+    public static void execute(Plan plan, KeySink sink, Delay delay) throws Exception {
+        LinkedHashSet<Integer> held = new LinkedHashSet<>();
+        Exception failure = null;
+        try {
+            for (Step step : plan.steps()) {
+                if (Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted()) throw new InterruptedException("模拟已取消");
+                switch (step.action()) {
+                    case "DOWN_KEY" -> { held.add(step.param()); sink.send(step.param(), false); }
+                    case "UP_KEY" -> { sink.send(step.param(), true); held.remove(step.param()); }
+                    // Firmware macro units and KeyConfig preview both use 3 ms ticks.
+                    case "DELAY" -> delay.sleep(step.param() * 3L);
+                    default -> throw new IllegalArgumentException("不支持的模拟动作：" + step.action());
+                }
+            }
+        } catch (Exception e) {
+            failure = e;
+        } finally {
+            List<Integer> remaining = new ArrayList<>(held);
+            for (int i = remaining.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
+                try { sink.send(remaining.get(i), true); }
+                catch (Exception e) { if (failure == null) failure = e; else failure.addSuppressed(e); }
+            }
+        }
+        if (failure != null) throw failure;
+    }
+
+    /** Used by menu exit; hiding the window does not cancel simulation. */
+    public static boolean cancelAndAwait(Thread worker, long timeoutMs) {
+        if (worker == null || !worker.isAlive()) return true;
+        worker.interrupt();
+        if (worker == Thread.currentThread()) return false;
+        try { worker.join(Math.max(1, timeoutMs)); }
+        catch (InterruptedException interrupted) { Thread.currentThread().interrupt(); }
+        return !worker.isAlive();
+    }
+
+    public static KeySink windowsSink() {
+        return (hid, up) -> {
+            if (!System.getProperty("os.name", "").toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT).startsWith("windows"))
+                throw new IllegalStateException("按键模拟仅支持 Windows。");
+            WinUser.INPUT[] input = (WinUser.INPUT[]) new WinUser.INPUT().toArray(1);
+            input[0].type = new WinUser.DWORD(WinUser.INPUT.INPUT_KEYBOARD);
+            input[0].input.setType("ki");
+            input[0].input.ki.wVk = new WinUser.WORD(virtualKey(hid));
+            input[0].input.ki.dwFlags = new WinUser.DWORD((up ? 2 : 0) | (extendedKey(hid) ? 1 : 0));
+            if (User32.INSTANCE.SendInput(new WinUser.DWORD(1), input, input[0].size()).intValue() != 1)
+                throw new IllegalStateException("系统未接受模拟按键，请检查目标窗口权限。");
+        };
+    }
+
+    public static boolean extendedKey(int hid) {
+        return (hid >= 0x49 && hid <= 0x54) || hid == 0x58 || hid == 0x46
+                || hid == 0xE3 || hid == 0xE4 || hid == 0xE6 || hid == 0xE7;
+    }
+
+    public static int virtualKey(int hid) {
+        if (hid >= 0x04 && hid <= 0x1D) return 0x41 + hid - 0x04;
+        if (hid >= 0x1E && hid <= 0x26) return 0x31 + hid - 0x1E;
+        if (hid >= 0x3A && hid <= 0x45) return 0x70 + hid - 0x3A;
+        if (hid >= 0x68 && hid <= 0x73) return 0x7C + hid - 0x68;
+        if (hid >= 0x59 && hid <= 0x61) return 0x61 + hid - 0x59;
+        return switch (hid) {
+            case 0x27, 0x62 -> hid == 0x27 ? 0x30 : 0x60;
+            case 0x28, 0x58 -> 0x0D; case 0x29 -> 0x1B; case 0x2A -> 0x08;
+            case 0x2B -> 0x09; case 0x2C -> 0x20; case 0x2D -> 0xBD; case 0x2E -> 0xBB;
+            case 0x2F -> 0xDB; case 0x30 -> 0xDD; case 0x31 -> 0xDC; case 0x33 -> 0xBA;
+            case 0x34 -> 0xDE; case 0x35 -> 0xC0; case 0x36 -> 0xBC; case 0x37 -> 0xBE;
+            case 0x38 -> 0xBF; case 0x39 -> 0x14; case 0x46 -> 0x2C; case 0x47 -> 0x91;
+            case 0x48 -> 0x13; case 0x49 -> 0x2D; case 0x4A -> 0x24; case 0x4B -> 0x21;
+            case 0x4C -> 0x2E; case 0x4D -> 0x23; case 0x4E -> 0x22; case 0x4F -> 0x27;
+            case 0x50 -> 0x25; case 0x51 -> 0x28; case 0x52 -> 0x26; case 0x53 -> 0x90;
+            case 0x54 -> 0x6F; case 0x55 -> 0x6A; case 0x56 -> 0x6D; case 0x57 -> 0x6B;
+            case 0x63 -> 0x6E;
+            case 0xE0 -> 0xA2; case 0xE1 -> 0xA0; case 0xE2 -> 0xA4; case 0xE3 -> 0x5B;
+            case 0xE4 -> 0xA3; case 0xE5 -> 0xA1; case 0xE6 -> 0xA5; case 0xE7 -> 0x5C;
+            default -> throw new IllegalArgumentException("无法模拟 HID 0x" + Integer.toHexString(hid));
+        };
+    }
+}

+            Thread t = new Thread(r, "kimi-bridge");
+            t.setDaemon(true);
+            return t;
+        });
+        final Set<Socket> clients = new HashSet<>(); // guarded by the bridge monitor
+        Session(ServerSocket listener) { this.listener = listener; }
+    }
+
+    public KimiAhaKeyBridge(BleManager bleManager) {
+        this(bleManager, PORT);
+    }
+
+    KimiAhaKeyBridge(BleManager bleManager, int port) {
+        this.bleManager = bleManager;
+        this.port = port;
+    }
+
+    /** Reconcile current transport, rather than replaying a possibly delayed callback. */
+    public synchronized void connectionChanged() {
+        // Reserve the native approval endpoint even when disconnected or in maintenance.
+        // Only the verified current target may produce AUTO, regardless of USB/BLE transport.
+        if (!closed) start();
+    }
+
+    /** Invalidate old approval queries without releasing the dedicated native endpoint. */
+    public synchronized void prepareForConnection() {
+        blockedThroughGeneration = bleManager.connectionGeneration();
+        if (session != null) for (Socket client : session.clients) closeSocket(client);
+    }
+
+    public synchronized void close() {
+        closed = true;
+        stop();
+    }
+
+    public synchronized void start() {
+        if (closed || session != null) return;
+        ServerSocket listener = null;
+        try {
+            listener = new ServerSocket();
+            listener.setReuseAddress(false);
+            listener.bind(new InetSocketAddress("127.0.0.1", port));
+            Session started = new Session(listener);
+            session = started;
+            started.executor.submit(() -> acceptLoop(started));
+            logger.info("KimiAhaKeyBridge started on 127.0.0.1:{}", listener.getLocalPort());
+            problemHandler.accept("");
+        } catch (IOException e) {
+            closeSocket(listener);
+            logger.warn("KimiAhaKeyBridge: port {} unavailable: {}", port, e.getMessage());
+            problemHandler.accept("Kimi 审批端口 " + port + " 被占用，审批状态无法确认。请正常退出旧版 BLE 桥或占用该端口的程序，再重新连接设备；请勿依赖当前 Kimi 拨杆审批。");
+        }
+    }
+
+    public synchronized void stop() {
+        Session stopped = session;
+        session = null;
+        if (stopped == null) return;
+        closeSocket(stopped.listener);
+        for (Socket client : stopped.clients) closeSocket(client);
+        stopped.clients.clear();
+        stopped.executor.shutdownNow();
+    }
+
+    private static void closeSocket(Closeable socket) {
+        try { if (socket != null) socket.close(); } catch (IOException ignored) { }
+    }
+
+    private synchronized boolean isCurrent(Session expected) { return session == expected; }
+
+    private synchronized boolean targetCurrent(Session expected, long generation, long maintenanceEpoch) {
+        return session == expected && !closed && generation > blockedThroughGeneration
+                && generation == bleManager.connectionGeneration() && bleManager.isConnected()
+                && maintenanceEpoch == bleManager.maintenance().epoch() && bleManager.maintenance().normalAllowed();
+    }
+
+    private boolean confirmedAuto(Session expected, long generation, long maintenanceEpoch) {
+        return targetCurrent(expected, generation, maintenanceEpoch) && bleManager.refreshAutoApproval()
+                && targetCurrent(expected, generation, maintenanceEpoch);
+    }
+
+    private void acceptLoop(Session expected) {
+        while (isCurrent(expected)) {
+            try {
+                Socket client = expected.listener.accept();
+                synchronized (this) {
+                    if (session != expected) { closeSocket(client); return; }
+                    try {
+                        client.setSoTimeout(500);
+                        expected.clients.add(client);
+                        expected.executor.submit(() -> handle(expected, client));
+                    } catch (IOException | RuntimeException e) {
+                        expected.clients.remove(client);
+                        closeSocket(client);
+                        throw e;
+                    }
+                }
+            } catch (IOException e) {
+                if (isCurrent(expected)) logger.debug("KimiAhaKeyBridge accept: {}", e.getMessage());
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    private void handle(Session expected, Socket client) {
+        try (client) {
+            DataInputStream in  = new DataInputStream(client.getInputStream());
+            DataOutputStream out = new DataOutputStream(client.getOutputStream());
+            long generation = bleManager.connectionGeneration();
+            long maintenanceEpoch = bleManager.maintenance().epoch();
+
+            // Kimi sends two packets per query session: QUERY_STATUS then QUERY_INFO
+            for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
+                byte[] header = new byte[3];
+                in.readFully(header);
+                int type   = header[0] & 0xFF;
+                int length = ((header[2] & 0xFF) << 8) | (header[1] & 0xFF); // little-endian
+                if (length > 0) in.readFully(new byte[length]); // discard complete body
+                if (!isCurrent(expected)) return;
+
+                if (type == (PKT_QUERY_STATUS & 0xFF)) {
+                    // Respond 0x82: status[0]==1, status[-1]==1, len>=4
+                    // Unavailable means native defer, not a forced manual override.
+                    if (!confirmedAuto(expected, generation, maintenanceEpoch)) { sendPacket(out, RSP_STATUS, new byte[]{0, 0, 0, 0}); return; }
+                    byte[] data = {1, 0, 0, 1};
+                    sendCurrentPacket(expected, generation, maintenanceEpoch, out, RSP_STATUS, data);
+                } else if (type == (PKT_QUERY_INFO & 0xFF)) {
+                    if (!confirmedAuto(expected, generation, maintenanceEpoch)) { sendPacket(out, RSP_INFO, new byte[0]); return; }
+                    byte[] data = new byte[10];
+                    data[6] = 0; // Only confirmed AUTO is an override; never export physical position.
+                    sendCurrentPacket(expected, generation, maintenanceEpoch, out, RSP_INFO, data);
+                }
+            }
+        } catch (IOException e) {
+            logger.debug("KimiAhaKeyBridge client: {}", e.getMessage());
+        } finally {
+            synchronized (this) { expected.clients.remove(client); }
+        }
+    }
+
+    private synchronized void sendCurrentPacket(Session expected, long generation, long epoch,
+                                               DataOutputStream out, byte type, byte[] data) throws IOException {
+        if (!targetCurrent(expected, generation, epoch)) throw new IOException("Kimi approval target changed");
+        sendPacket(out, type, data);
+    }
+
+    private void sendPacket(DataOutputStream out, byte type, byte[] data) throws IOException {
+        // The bundled consumer reads its three-byte header in one recv call.
+        // Emit the complete small frame together instead of three independent header writes.
+        byte[] packet = new byte[3 + data.length];
+        packet[0] = type;
+        packet[1] = (byte) data.length;
+        packet[2] = (byte) (data.length >>> 8);
+        System.arraycopy(data, 0, packet, 3, data.length);
+        out.write(packet);
+        out.flush();
+    }
+}

+package com.example.ahakey.service;
+
+import com.example.ahakey.model.DeviceStatus;
+import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode;
+import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
+import java.io.*;
+import java.net.ServerSocket;
+import java.net.Socket;
+import java.nio.file.Files;
+import java.nio.file.Path;
+import java.nio.file.Paths;
+import java.util.HashMap;
+import java.util.Map;
+import java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture;
+import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
+import java.util.concurrent.Executors;
+import java.util.concurrent.ScheduledExecutorService;
+import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
+
+public class SocketServer {
+    private static final ObjectMapper mapper = new ObjectMapper();
+    private final String socketPath;
+    private final BleManager bleManager;
+    private ServerSocket serverSocket;
+    private ExecutorService executorService;
+    private ScheduledExecutorService scheduler;
+
+    private volatile Integer cachedSwitchState;
+    private volatile Integer cachedLightMode;
+
+    public SocketServer(String socketPath, BleManager bleManager) {
+        this.socketPath = socketPath;
+        this.bleManager = bleManager;
+        this.executorService = Executors.newCachedThreadPool();
+        this.scheduler = Executors.newScheduledThreadPool(1);
+    }
+
+    public void start() throws IOException {
+        Path path = Paths.get(socketPath);
+        Files.deleteIfExists(path);
+
+        serverSocket = new ServerSocket(0);
+        executorService.submit(this::acceptConnections);
+
+        System.out.println("监听 Unix Socket: " + socketPath);
+    }
+
+    private void acceptConnections() {
+        while (!serverSocket.isClosed()) {
+            try {
+                Socket client = serverSocket.accept();
+                handleClient(client);
+            } catch (IOException e) {
+                if (!serverSocket.isClosed()) {
+                    e.printStackTrace();
+                }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    private void handleClient(Socket client) {
+        executorService.submit(() -> {
+            try (BufferedReader reader = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(client.getInputStream()));
+                 PrintWriter writer = new PrintWriter(client.getOutputStream(), true)) {
+
+                String line = reader.readLine();
+                if (line == null || line.trim().isEmpty()) {
+                    return;
+                }
+
+                processCommand(line.trim(), writer);
+
+            } catch (IOException e) {
+                e.printStackTrace();
+            } finally {
+                try { client.close(); } catch (IOException ignored) {}
+            }
+        });
+    }
+
+    private void processCommand(String line, PrintWriter writer) {
+        try {
+            if (line.startsWith("{")) {
+                JsonNode cmdNode = mapper.readTree(line);
+                String cmd = cmdNode.get("cmd").asText();
+
+                switch (cmd) {
+                    case "state":
+                        int value = cmdNode.get("value").asInt();
+                        bleManager.updateState((byte) value);
+                        sendResponse(writer, Map.of("ok", true));
+                        break;
+
+                    case "state_with_reset":
+                        int stateValue = cmdNode.has("value") ? cmdNode.get("value").asInt() : 0;
+                        int resetValue = cmdNode.has("resetValue") ? cmdNode.get("resetValue").asInt() : 4;
+                        int delayMs = Math.max(0, cmdNode.has("delayMs") ? cmdNode.get("delayMs").asInt() : 1200);
+                        bleManager.updateState((byte) stateValue);
+                        scheduleStateReset((byte) resetValue, delayMs);
+                        sendResponse(writer, Map.of("ok", true));
+                        break;
+
+                    case "permission":
+                        handlePermission(cmdNode, writer);
+                        break;
+
+                    case "status":
+                    case "approval_status":
+                        handleStatusRequest(writer);
+                        break;
+
+                    default:
+                        sendResponse(writer, Map.of("error", "unknown cmd: " + cmd));
+                }
+            } else {
+                try {
+                    byte state = Byte.parseByte(line);
+                    bleManager.updateState(state);
+                } catch (NumberFormatException ignored) {}
+            }
+        } catch (Exception e) {
+            sendResponse(writer, Map.of("error", e.getMessage()));
+        }
+    }
+
+    private void handlePermission(JsonNode cmdNode, PrintWriter writer) {
+        int stateValue = cmdNode.has("value") ? cmdNode.get("value").asInt() : 1;
+        bleManager.updateState((byte) stateValue);
+
+        CompletableFuture.supplyAsync(() -> {
+            bleManager.queryStatus();
+            try { Thread.sleep(1500); } catch (InterruptedException e) {}
+            return bleManager.getCachedStatus();
+        }).thenAccept(status -> {
+            Map<String, Object> response = buildStatusResponse(status);
+            sendResponse(writer, response);
+        }).exceptionally(e -> {
+            sendResponse(writer, buildStatusResponse(null));
+            return null;
+        });
+    }
+
+    private void handleStatusRequest(PrintWriter writer) {
+        boolean auto = bleManager.refreshAutoApproval();
+        sendResponse(writer, buildApprovalResponse(auto));
+    }
+
+    private Map<String, Object> buildApprovalResponse(boolean auto) {
+        Map<String, Object> response = new HashMap<>();
+        response.put("switchState", auto ? 0 : null);
+        response.put("autoApproved", auto);
+        response.put("approval", auto ? "auto" : "defer_to_native");
+        response.put("lightMode", bleManager.getCachedStatus().getLightMode());
+        return response;
+    }
+
+    private Map<String, Object> buildStatusResponse(DeviceStatus status) {
+        return buildApprovalResponse(status != null && bleManager.refreshAutoApproval());
+    }
+
+    private void sendResponse(PrintWriter writer, Map<String, Object> data) {
+        try {
+            writer.println(mapper.writeValueAsString(data));
+            writer.flush();
+        } catch (Exception e) {
+            e.printStackTrace();
+        }
+    }
+
+    private void scheduleStateReset(byte resetValue, int delayMs) {
+        scheduler.schedule(() -> {
+            bleManager.updateState(resetValue);
+        }, delayMs, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS);
+    }
+
+    public void updateStatus(DeviceStatus status) {
+        this.cachedSwitchState = status.getSwitchState();
+        this.cachedLightMode = status.getLightMode();
+    }
+
+    public void stop() throws IOException {
+        executorService.shutdown();
+        scheduler.shutdown();
+        serverSocket.close();
+    }
 }

+    private Region lightSeg3;

+    public void initialize() {
+        if (lightBarLabel != null) {
+            lightBarLabel.setText(LanguageManager.getInstance().getString("studio-part.light-bar"));
+        }
+    }
+    
+    public void setStudioState(StudioState studioState) {
+        this.studioState = studioState;
+        bindEvents();
+        refreshPreview();
+        setStableLightPreview();
+        startLightAnimation();
+        studioState.displayConfig().revision.addListener((o, a, b) -> refreshOledPreviewImage(studioState.getSelectedMode()));
+        oledCard.sceneProperty().addListener((o, a, b) -> {
+            if (b == null) stopAnimation(); else startLightAnimation();
+        });
+    }

+    public void setDeviceStatus(DeviceStatus deviceStatus) {
+        this.deviceStatus = deviceStatus;
+        bindDeviceStatus();
+    }
+    
+    private void bindDeviceStatus() {
+        if (toggleLabel != null && deviceStatus != null) {
+            toggleLabel.textProperty().bind(Bindings.createStringBinding(
+                deviceStatus::getSwitchTitle,
+                deviceStatus.switchStateProperty(), deviceStatus.savedBindingsProperty(), deviceStatus.isConnectedProperty()
+            ));
+            deviceStatus.switchStateProperty().addListener((obs, old, value) -> refreshToggleThumb());
+            deviceStatus.isConnectedProperty().addListener((obs, old, value) -> refreshToggleThumb());
+            refreshToggleThumb();
+        }
+    }
+    
+    private void bindEvents() {
+        oledCard.disableProperty().bind(studioState.displayConfig().busy);
+        lightBarCard.disableProperty().bind(studioState.displayConfig().busy);
+        key1Card.disableProperty().bind(studioState.uploadingOledProperty());
+        key2Card.disableProperty().bind(studioState.uploadingOledProperty());
+        key3Card.disableProperty().bind(studioState.uploadingOledProperty());
+        key4Card.disableProperty().bind(studioState.uploadingOledProperty());
+        toggleCard.disableProperty().bind(studioState.uploadingOledProperty());
+        lightBarCard.setOnMouseClicked(e -> studioState.setSelectedPart(StudioPart.LIGHT_BAR));
+        oledCard.setOnMouseClicked(e -> studioState.setSelectedPart(StudioPart.OLED));
+        key1Card.setOnMouseClicked(e -> studioState.setSelectedPart(StudioPart.KEY1));
+        key2Card.setOnMouseClicked(e -> studioState.setSelectedPart(StudioPart.KEY2));
+        key3Card.setOnMouseClicked(e -> studioState.setSelectedPart(StudioPart.KEY3));
+        key4Card.setOnMouseClicked(e -> studioState.setSelectedPart(StudioPart.KEY4));
+        toggleCard.setOnMouseClicked(e -> studioState.setSelectedPart(StudioPart.TOGGLE_SWITCH));
+        
+        studioState.selectedPartProperty().addListener((obs, old, newPart) -> refreshHotspots());
+        studioState.selectedModeProperty().addListener((obs, old, newMode) -> refreshPreview());
+        studioState.dirtyCountProperty().addListener((obs, old, newVal) -> refreshHotspots());
+        studioState.revisionProperty().addListener((obs, old, newVal) -> refreshPreview());
+        studioState.lightBarPreviewProperty().addListener((obs, old, newVal) -> {
+            refreshPreview();
+            animationFrame = 0;
+            setStableLightPreview();
+        });
+    }
+    
+    public void refreshPreview() {
+        ModeSlot mode = studioState.getSelectedMode();
+        if (oledTitle != null) {
+            oledTitle.setText(studioState.getOledSummary());
+        }
+        if (oledCaption != null) {
+            oledCaption.setText(studioState.getOledCaption());
+        }
+        refreshOledPreviewImage(mode);
+        if (modeIcon != null) {
+            modeIcon.setText(String.valueOf(mode.getIndex() + 1));
+        }
+        refreshKeyCaptions(mode);
+        refreshHotspots();
+    }
+
+    private void refreshKeyCaptions(ModeSlot mode) {
+        if (key1Caption != null) key1Caption.setText(studioState.getKeyConfig(mode, StudioPart.KEY1).getDescription());
+        if (key2Caption != null) key2Caption.setText(studioState.getKeyConfig(mode, StudioPart.KEY2).getDescription());
+        if (key3Caption != null) key3Caption.setText(studioState.getKeyConfig(mode, StudioPart.KEY3).getDescription());
+        if (key4Caption != null) key4Caption.setText(studioState.getKeyConfig(mode, StudioPart.KEY4).getDescription());
+    }
+
+    private com.example.ahakey.model.OledResourceState.Asset displayedAsset;
+    private final java.util.List<javafx.scene.image.Image> oledFrames = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
+    private int oledFrame;
+
+    private void refreshOledPreviewImage(ModeSlot mode) {
+        if (oledPreviewImage == null) return;
+        var resource = studioState.displayConfig().current();
+        if (resource.asset() != displayedAsset) {
+            displayedAsset = resource.asset();
+            oledFrames.clear();
+            oledFrame = 0;
+            if (displayedAsset != null) {
+                byte[] bytes = displayedAsset.bytes();
+                for (int i = 0; i < displayedAsset.frames(); i++) {
+                    var decoded = com.example.ahakey.util.OLEDFrameEncoder.decodeFrame(bytes, i * 28672);
+                    var image = new javafx.scene.image.WritableImage(160, 80);
+                    for (int y = 0; y < 80; y++) for (int x = 0; x < 160; x++)
+                        image.getPixelWriter().setArgb(x, y, 0xff000000 | decoded.getRGB(x, y));
+                    oledFrames.add(image);
+                }
+            }
+        }
+        oledPreviewImage.setImage(oledFrames.isEmpty() ? null : oledFrames.get(oledFrame % oledFrames.size()));
+        oledPreviewImage.setVisible(!oledFrames.isEmpty());
+        oledTitle.setText(resource.deviceKnown() && resource.device().valid() ? "设备已有" : "");
+        oledTitle.setVisible(oledFrames.isEmpty());
+        oledCaption.setVisible(false);
+        oledDraftBadge.setVisible(resource.localStatus() == com.example.ahakey.model.OledResourceState.LocalStatus.DRAFT);
+    }
+
+    private void refreshToggleThumb() {
+        if (toggleThumb == null || deviceStatus == null) {
+            return;
+        }
+        toggleThumb.setTranslateY(!deviceStatus.isConnected() ? 0 : deviceStatus.getSwitchState() == 0 ? -13 : deviceStatus.getSwitchState() == 1 ? 13 : 0);
+    }
+
+    private void setStableLightPreview() {
+        if (lightSeg1 != null) renderLight(new int[8]);
+    }
+    
+    private void refreshHotspots() {
+        refreshHotspot(lightBarCard, StudioPart.LIGHT_BAR);
+        refreshHotspot(oledCard, StudioPart.OLED);
+        refreshHotspot(key1Card, StudioPart.KEY1);
+        refreshHotspot(key2Card, StudioPart.KEY2);
+        refreshHotspot(key3Card, StudioPart.KEY3);
+        refreshHotspot(key4Card, StudioPart.KEY4);
+        refreshHotspot(toggleCard, StudioPart.TOGGLE_SWITCH);
+    }
+    
+    private void refreshHotspot(StackPane hotspot, StudioPart part) {
+        hotspot.getStyleClass().removeAll("selected-hotspot", "dirty-hotspot");
+        if (part == studioState.getSelectedPart()) {
+            hotspot.getStyleClass().add("selected-hotspot");
+        }
+        if (studioState.isDirty(part)) {
+            hotspot.getStyleClass().add("dirty-hotspot");
+        }
+    }
+    
+    private final com.example.ahakey.service.FirmwareLightSimulator lightSimulator =
+            new com.example.ahakey.service.FirmwareLightSimulator();
+
+    private void startLightAnimation() {
+        if (lightAnimation != null) lightAnimation.stop();
+        lightAnimation = new Timeline(new KeyFrame(Duration.millis(50), event -> {
+            var display = studioState.displayConfig();
+            if (display.devicePreview.get() && System.nanoTime() >= display.previewUntilNanos.get()) {
+                display.endPreview();
+                display.message.set("设备预览已结束。");
+            }
+            int effect = display.simulatedEffect.get();
+            renderLight(effect < 0 ? new int[8] : lightSimulator.step(effect, display.simulatedBrightness.get()));
+            if (++animationFrame % 2 == 0 && !oledFrames.isEmpty()) {
+                oledFrame = (oledFrame + 1) % oledFrames.size();
+                oledPreviewImage.setImage(oledFrames.get(oledFrame));
+            }
+        }));
+        lightAnimation.setCycleCount(Timeline.INDEFINITE);
+        lightAnimation.play();
+    }
+
+    private void renderLight(int[] colors) {
+        Region[] segments = {lightSeg1, lightSeg2, lightSeg3, lightSeg4, lightSeg5, lightSeg6, lightSeg7, lightSeg8};
+        for (int i = 0; i < segments.length; i++)
+            if (segments[i] != null) segments[i].setStyle(String.format("-fx-background-color: #%06x; -fx-opacity: 1;", colors[i]));
+    }
+    
+    public void stopAnimation() {
+        if (lightAnimation != null) {
+            lightAnimation.stop();
+        }
+    }
