+                wire.ackRelease.countDown();poll.get(2,TimeUnit.SECONDS);await(()->wire.state(0)==0,"latest invalidated EMPTY drains after ACK");
+                runtime.pollCursorWaiting();db.generation("a","next");runtime.pollCursorWaiting();hookGeneration(runtime,"a",IDEState.PRE_TOOL_USE,"next");
+                var lockField=BleManager.class.getDeclaredField("commandTransactionLock");lockField.setAccessible(true);Object transaction=lockField.get(wire);
+                CountDownLatch held=new CountDownLatch(1),release=new CountDownLatch(1);
+                Future<?> owner=pool.submit(()->{synchronized(transaction){held.countDown();try{release.await(3,TimeUnit.SECONDS);}catch(InterruptedException e){Thread.currentThread().interrupt();}}});
+                check(held.await(1,TimeUnit.SECONDS),"fixture owns actual device transaction lock");
+                long before=wire.snapshots();db.put("a",false);runtime.pollCursorWaiting();db.put("a",true);
+                AtomicReference<Thread> sender=new AtomicReference<>();
+                Future<?> queued=pool.submit(()->{sender.set(Thread.currentThread());runtime.pollCursorWaiting();});
+                await(()->sender.get()!=null&&sender.get().getState()==Thread.State.BLOCKED,"snapshot queued before actual device send");
+                runtime.displayModeProperty().set(AiRuntimeDisplayMode.SINGLE);release.countDown();owner.get(2,TimeUnit.SECONDS);queued.get(2,TimeUnit.SECONDS);
+                check(wire.snapshots()==before,"mode cancellation inside device lock suppresses queued old frame");
+            } finally {wire.ackRelease.countDown();server.stop();runtime.close();pool.shutdownNow();wire.shutdownTransport();}
+        }
+    }
+    static void unavailableNativeKeepsHookChecks()throws Exception {
+        for(String version:List.of("3.14.7","unknown-version","3.27.22")) {
+            try(var db=new Database()) {
+                // No readable native identity is not evidence that ordinary Hook delivery stopped.
+                db.raw("a","{}");Source source=new Source();source.process=new CursorSessionDiscoveryService.CursorProcess("fallback-process",version);
+                CaptureWire wire=new CaptureWire();wire.memoryConnect();wire.readFirmwareCatalogKey();
+                var runtime=new AiRuntimeDisplayService(wire,source);
+                try {
+                    runtime.setCursorDataDir(db.root.toString());runtime.displayModeProperty().set(AiRuntimeDisplayMode.MULTI);
+                    runtime.bindSlot(0,session("a"));runtime.markDraftApplied(false,true);runtime.pollCursorWaiting();
+                    check(hookGeneration(runtime,"a",IDEState.PRE_TOOL_USE,null)==AiRuntimeDisplayService.Delivery.SENT && wire.state(0)==1,
+                        version+" unreadable native preserves ordinary missing-generation RUN");
+                    runtime.pollCursorWaiting();
+                    check(hookGeneration(runtime,"a",IDEState.STOP,null)==AiRuntimeDisplayService.Delivery.SENT && wire.state(0)==3,
+                        version+" unreadable native preserves ordinary missing-generation STOP");
+                    check(hookGeneration(runtime,"a",IDEState.PRE_TOOL_USE,"fallback-1")==AiRuntimeDisplayService.Delivery.SENT && wire.state(0)==1,
+                        version+" unreadable native preserves identified RUN");
+                    runtime.pollCursorWaiting();
+                    check(hookGeneration(runtime,"a",IDEState.STOP,"unrelated-old")==AiRuntimeDisplayService.Delivery.IGNORED && wire.state(0)==1,
+                        version+" unrelated old identified STOP cannot clear current RUN");
+                    check(hookGeneration(runtime,"a",IDEState.STOP,"fallback-1")==AiRuntimeDisplayService.Delivery.SENT && wire.state(0)==3,
+                        version+" matching identified STOP completes current RUN");
+                    check(hookGeneration(runtime,"a",IDEState.PRE_TOOL_USE,"fallback-2")==AiRuntimeDisplayService.Delivery.SENT && wire.state(0)==1,
+                        version+" next identified RUN remains usable");
+                    check(hookGeneration(runtime,"a",IDEState.STOP,"fallback-1")==AiRuntimeDisplayService.Delivery.IGNORED && wire.state(0)==1,
+                        version+" retired identified STOP cannot clear next RUN");
+                    runtime.pollCursorWaiting();check(wire.state(0)==1,version+" UNKNOWN metadata does not manufacture WAITING or DONE");
+                } finally {runtime.close();wire.shutdownTransport();}
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    public static void main(String[] args)throws Exception {
+        System.setProperty("user.home",Files.createTempDirectory("wd009-cursor-home-").toString());
+        unavailableNativeKeepsHookChecks();databaseChecks();runtimeChecks();identityAndGenerationChecks();legacyBoundaryChecks();ackAndCancellationChecks();System.out.println("PASS "+checks+" Cursor SQLite/WAL + actual runtime/transport checks; synthetic native facts, no real Cursor or hardware PASS");
+    }

+package com.example.ahakey.service;
+
+import com.example.ahakey.model.DeviceStatus;
+import com.example.ahakey.protocol.AhaKeyProtocol;
+import java.io.*;
+import java.lang.reflect.*;
+import java.net.*;
+import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
+import java.util.Arrays;
+
+/** Actual Kimi adapter + BleManager parser/requests; USB and BLE wire endpoints are memory only. */
+public final class KimiConsumerFixture {
+    static final BleManager.BleCallback CALLBACK = new BleManager.BleCallback() {
+        public void onConnected() {} public void onDisconnected() {} public void onStatusReceived(DeviceStatus s) {} public void onError(String s) {}
+    };
+    static void field(Object object, String name, Object value) throws Exception {
+        Field f=BleManager.class.getDeclaredField(name);f.setAccessible(true);f.set(object,value);
+    }
+    static final class Wire extends BleManager {
+        volatile boolean usb=true, unknown;
+        volatile int binding, delayMillis;
+        int reads;
+        Wire() throws Exception {
+            super(CALLBACK);
+            field(this,"usbTransport",new UsbHidTransport() {
+                public boolean isOpen(){return usb;}
+                public void open(java.util.function.Consumer<byte[]> c){throw new AssertionError("No real USB");}
+                public void sendCommand(byte[] c){respond(c);}
+                public void sendData(byte[] c){throw new AssertionError("No upload");}
+                public void close(){}
+            });
+            field(this,"outputStream",new ByteArrayOutputStream(){
+                public synchronized void write(byte[] b,int off,int len){respond(Arrays.copyOfRange(b,off+3,off+len));}
+            });
+            activate(true,0,false,0);
+        }
+        protected boolean isUsbDevicePresent(){return false;}
+        public void connect(){throw new AssertionError("No real connect");}
+        void activate(boolean usb,int binding,boolean unknown,int delay) throws Exception {
+            this.usb=usb;this.binding=binding;this.unknown=unknown;this.delayMillis=0;
+            field(this,"connectionGeneration",connectionGeneration()+1);
+            field(this,"isConnected",true);getCachedStatus().setConnected(true);getCachedStatus().clearFirmwareIdentity();
+            readFirmwareCatalogKey();this.delayMillis=delay;
+        }
+        void respond(byte[] q) {
+            long generation=connectionGeneration();int cmd=q[2]&255;byte[] data;
+            if(cmd==0x9F)data=("\0x1-c582-hw1-p1-1.0.1-r001").getBytes(StandardCharsets.US_ASCII);
+            else if(cmd==0)data=new byte[]{100,0,1,1,0,0,0,35};
+            else if(cmd==0x97){reads++;data=unknown?new byte[]{0,0}:new byte[]{0,0,2,(byte)binding,0,1,0};}
+            else throw new AssertionError("Unexpected write "+cmd);
+            try {
+                if(delayMillis>0)Thread.sleep(delayMillis);
+                Method m=BleManager.class.getDeclaredMethod("onSessionNotify",long.class,byte[].class);m.setAccessible(true);
+                m.invoke(this,generation,AhaKeyProtocol.buildFrame((byte)cmd,data));
+            }catch(Exception e){throw new AssertionError(e);}
+        }
+    }
+    static int port(KimiAhaKeyBridge bridge) throws Exception {
+        Field f=KimiAhaKeyBridge.class.getDeclaredField("session");f.setAccessible(true);Object session=f.get(bridge);
+        if(session==null)return 0;
+        f=session.getClass().getDeclaredField("listener");f.setAccessible(true);return ((ServerSocket)f.get(session)).getLocalPort();
+    }
+    public static void main(String[] args)throws Exception {
+        Wire wire=new Wire();KimiAhaKeyBridge bridge=new KimiAhaKeyBridge(wire,0);
+        try(BufferedReader input=new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in))){
+            String line;
+            while((line=input.readLine())!=null&&!line.equals("quit")){
+                if(line.endsWith("disconnected")){field(wire,"isConnected",false);wire.getCachedStatus().setConnected(false);}
+                else if(line.equals("prepare")){bridge.prepareForConnection();}
+                else if(line.equals("maintenance")){wire.maintenance().requestExit(null);}
+                else {
+                    boolean usb=line.startsWith("usb");int binding=line.contains("manual")?1:line.contains("custom")?3:0;
+                    wire.activate(usb,binding,line.contains("unknown"),line.contains("slow")?220:line.contains("delayed")?50:0);
+                }
+                bridge.connectionChanged();
+                System.out.println("FIXTURE_READY "+line+" "+port(bridge));System.out.flush();
+            }
+        }finally{bridge.close();}
+    }

+package com.example.ahakey.wd009;

+import com.example.ahakey.model.KeyConfig;
+import com.example.ahakey.service.KeySimulationService;

+/** No native input, application launch, device I/O or user files. */
+public final class Wd009UiChecks {
+    private static int checks;
+    private static void check(String message, boolean result) {
+        if (!result) throw new AssertionError(message);
+        checks++; System.out.println("PASS " + message);
+    }
+    private static List<String> run(KeySimulationService.Plan plan) throws Exception {
+        List<String> events = new ArrayList<>();
+        KeySimulationService.execute(plan, (hid, up) -> events.add((up ? "up:" : "down:") + hid),
+                ms -> events.add("delay:" + ms));
+        return events;
+    }
+    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
+        KeyConfig key = new KeyConfig(0x200 | 0x06, "Ctrl+C");
+        var shortcut = KeySimulationService.snapshot(key);
+        check("shortcut preserves Ctrl+C and release order", run(shortcut).equals(List.of("down:224", "down:6", "up:6", "up:224")));
+        key.addMacroStep("DOWN_KEY", 0x04);
+        key.addMacroStep("DELAY", 7);
+        key.addMacroStep("UP_KEY", 0x04);
+        var macro = KeySimulationService.snapshot(key);
+        check("macro supersedes previous shortcut and preserves delay ticks", run(macro).equals(List.of("down:4", "delay:21", "up:4")));
+        key.updateMacroStep(0, "DOWN_KEY", 0x05);
+        check("snapshot cannot be changed by subsequent editor edits", run(macro).get(0).equals("down:4"));
+        check("next click snapshots new draft", run(KeySimulationService.snapshot(key)).get(0).equals("down:5"));
+        check("old shortcut plan is also immutable", run(shortcut).get(1).equals("down:6"));
+        while (key.getMacroStepCount() > 0) key.removeMacroStep(0);
+        check("deleting last macro step uses same shortcut mode as editor rebuild", !key.usesMacro()
+                && run(KeySimulationService.snapshot(key)).equals(run(shortcut)));
+        key = new KeyConfig(0xF000 | 0x6D, "right modifiers and F18");
+        check("all right modifiers retained", run(KeySimulationService.snapshot(key)).equals(List.of("down:229", "down:228", "down:230", "down:231", "down:109", "up:109", "up:231", "up:230", "up:228", "up:229")));
+        key = new KeyConfig(0x300, "modifiers only");
+        check("modifier-only shortcut supported", run(KeySimulationService.snapshot(key)).equals(List.of("down:225", "down:224", "up:224", "up:225")));
+        key = new KeyConfig(); key.addMacroStep("DOWN_KEY", 0xE0); key.addMacroStep("DOWN_KEY", 0x04);
+        check("unbalanced macro releases all keys in finally", run(KeySimulationService.snapshot(key)).equals(List.of("down:224", "down:4", "up:4", "up:224")));
+        List<String> failure = new ArrayList<>();
+        try {
+            KeySimulationService.execute(KeySimulationService.snapshot(key), (hid, up) -> {
+                failure.add((up ? "up:" : "down:") + hid);
+                if (!up && hid == 4) throw new IllegalStateException("injected");
+            }, ms -> {});
+            throw new AssertionError("expected failure");
+        } catch (IllegalStateException expected) { check("input failure is surfaced", expected.getMessage().equals("injected")); }
+        check("input failure releases even potentially partially sent key", failure.equals(List.of("down:224", "down:4", "up:4", "up:224")));
+        key.addMacroStep("DELAY", 1);
+        List<String> cancelled = new ArrayList<>();
+        try {
+            KeySimulationService.execute(KeySimulationService.snapshot(key), (hid, up) -> cancelled.add((up ? "up:" : "down:") + hid),
+                    ms -> { throw new InterruptedException("cancel"); });
+            throw new AssertionError("expected cancellation");
+        } catch (InterruptedException expected) { check("cancellation is surfaced", true); }
+        check("cancellation releases held keys", cancelled.equals(List.of("down:224", "down:4", "up:4", "up:224")));
+        List<Integer> releaseAttempts = new ArrayList<>();
+        try {
+            KeySimulationService.execute(KeySimulationService.snapshot(key), (hid, up) -> {
+                if (up) { releaseAttempts.add(hid); if (hid == 4) throw new IllegalStateException("release"); }
+            }, ms -> {});
+            throw new AssertionError("expected release failure");
+        } catch (IllegalStateException expected) { check("release failure reported", true); }
+        check("one failed release does not skip other held keys", releaseAttempts.equals(List.of(4, 224)));
+        for (int code : new int[]{0, 0xFF}) {
+            try { KeySimulationService.snapshot(new KeyConfig(code, "")); throw new AssertionError("invalid key accepted"); }
+            catch (IllegalArgumentException expected) { check("invalid/empty snapshot rejected " + code, true); }
+        }
+        check("F18 maps to VK_F18, not F24", KeySimulationService.virtualKey(0x6D) == 0x81);
+        check("right Ctrl uses extended flag", KeySimulationService.extendedKey(0xE4));
+        check("keypad Enter uses extended flag", KeySimulationService.extendedKey(0x58));
+        check("regular Enter has no extended flag", !KeySimulationService.extendedKey(0x28));
+        var installed = new InstalledAppIdentity("1.0.18", "local-model", "x64", InstalledAppIdentity.PRODUCT, InstalledAppIdentity.UPGRADE_CODE, "test", true);
+        check("version is from same install identity as updater", TopBar.displayApplicationVersion(installed).equals("1.0.18"));
+        var missing = new InstalledAppIdentity("0.0.0", "development", "unknown", InstalledAppIdentity.PRODUCT, "", "invalid-metadata", false);
+        check("missing metadata shown unknown", TopBar.displayApplicationVersion(missing).startsWith("未知"));
+        check("null metadata shown unknown", TopBar.displayApplicationVersion(null).startsWith("未知"));
+
+        java.util.List<String> released = java.util.Collections.synchronizedList(new java.util.ArrayList<>());
+        var down = new java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch(1);
+        Thread worker = new Thread(() -> {
+            try {
+                KeySimulationService.execute(new KeySimulationService.Plan(java.util.List.of(
+                    new KeySimulationService.Step("DOWN_KEY", 6), new KeySimulationService.Step("DELAY", 255))),
+                    (hid, up) -> { released.add(hid + ":" + up); if (!up) down.countDown(); }, ms -> Thread.sleep(30000));
+            } catch (InterruptedException expected) { }
+            catch (Exception unexpected) { throw new AssertionError(unexpected); }
+        });
+        worker.start();
+        check("exit fixture reached held key", down.await(2, java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit.SECONDS));
+        check("menu exit bounded cancellation waits for key release", KeySimulationService.cancelAndAwait(worker, 1000)
+                && released.equals(java.util.List.of("6:false", "6:true")));
+
+        // Wiring checks supplement execution tests; they are not rendered UI acceptance.
+        Path sourceRoot = Path.of(System.getProperty("ahakey.test.sourceRoot", "."));
+        String inspector = Files.readString(sourceRoot.resolve("src/main/java/com/example/ahakey/view/InspectorPane.java")).replace("\r\n", "\n");
+        String top = Files.readString(sourceRoot.resolve("src/main/java/com/example/ahakey/view/TopBar.java")).replace("\r\n", "\n");
+        check("shortcut selector uses shared F18 promotion", inspector.contains("configureLocalVoiceKeyLabel(keySelector)"));
+        check("macro step selector uses shared F18 promotion", inspector.contains("configureLocalVoiceKeyLabel(keyCombo)"));
+        check("shared promotion is before model-only labeling", inspector.indexOf("selector.getItems().add(0, f18)") < inspector.indexOf("if (!com.example.ahakey.config.ModelConfig"));
+        check("non-K1 keys expose current-draft simulation", inspector.contains("} else if (part.isKey()) {\n            body.getChildren().add(createKeyBindingGroup(part));\n            body.getChildren().add(createSimulateKeyGroup(part));"));
+        check("simulate no longer calls stale HID-only voice helper", !inspector.contains("simulateKeyByHid"));
+        check("snapshot is created inside click handler", inspector.indexOf("simulate.setOnAction") < inspector.indexOf("KeySimulationService.snapshot(studioState.getKeyConfig(part))"));
+        check("simulation is off FX thread and cancellable", inspector.contains("simulationThread.start()") && inspector.contains("simulationThread.interrupt()"));
+        check("reconnect and clear OLED menu entries removed", !top.contains("\"menu.reconnect\"") && !top.contains("\"menu.clear-oled\""));
+        String menu = top.substring(top.indexOf("if (modelEnabled) {", top.indexOf("Menu moreMenu")), top.indexOf("MenuItem updateCenter"));
+        check("cloud entries retain model guard and precede main menu", menu.indexOf("cloudAccount") < menu.indexOf("restoreDefaults") && menu.contains("} else {"));
+        check("language and exit remain final pair in both variants", menu.split("languageMenuItem,\\s*exitApp", -1).length == 3);
+        check("app version has no guessed fallback", !top.contains("version = \"1.0.0\""));
+        check("unsaved switch marker reads dirty state", inspector.contains("studioState.isDirty(StudioPart.TOGGLE_SWITCH)"));
+        check("legacy switch view does not equate non-auto with manual", !inspector.contains("() -> !deviceStatus.isAutoApproval()"));
+        check("switch editor position uses live status, not draft position", inspector.contains("sideSwitchPhysicalLabel(deviceStatus.getSwitchState())") && !inspector.contains("sideSwitchPhysicalLabel(config.physicalPosition())"));
+        check("pending editable delay is committed before snapshot", inspector.indexOf("commitSimulationEditors(body)") < inspector.indexOf("KeySimulationService.snapshot(studioState.getKeyConfig(part))"));
+        check("macro deletion rebuilds editor type and visible content", inspector.contains("key.removeMacroStep(index);\n            studioState.markDirty(part);\n            rebuild();"));
+        System.out.println("WD009 UI checks passed: " + checks + " (native input and device I/O not executed)");
+    }

+"""Run the locally installed consumer function unchanged against the memory Java fixture."""
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import socket
+import struct
+import subprocess
+import time
+import threading
+import queue
+
+parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+parser.add_argument("--root", required=True)
+parser.add_argument("--consumer", required=True)
+parser.add_argument("--output", required=True)
+args = parser.parse_args()
+root = Path(args.root).resolve()
+out = root / "target/wd009-implementation"
+source = Path(args.consumer)
+text = source.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+function = text[text.index("def _load_ahakey_override_uncached()"):
+                text.index("\nclass ApprovalResult:")]
+namespace = {"socket": socket, "struct": struct,
+             "_AHAKEY_BRIDGE_HOST": "127.0.0.1", "_AHAKEY_BRIDGE_PORT": 0,
+             "time": time, "_AHAKEY_APPROVAL_CACHE_TTL_S": 0.35, "_ahakey_cache_at": 0.0, "_ahakey_cache_value": None}
+exec(compile(function, str(source) + ":actual-function", "exec"), namespace)
+classpath = ";".join(str(root / p) for p in [
+    "target/wd009-implementation/classes", "target/wd009-implementation/test-classes",
+    "target/WD008-Preview-R6-LocalModel-1.0.17/image/AhaKeyStudio/app/lib/*", "src/main/resources"])
+process = subprocess.Popen([
+    "D:/jdk-17.0.19.10-hotspot/bin/java.exe", "-Dfile.encoding=UTF-8",
+    "-Duser.home=" + str(out / "home"), "-cp", classpath,
+    "com.example.ahakey.service.KimiConsumerFixture"], cwd=out,
+    stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
+    text=True, encoding="utf-8", creationflags=0x08000000)
+logs, results = [], []
+ready = queue.Queue()
+def drain():
+    for line in process.stdout:
+        logs.append(line)
+        if line.startswith("FIXTURE_READY "):
+            ready.put(line)
+    ready.put(None)
+reader = threading.Thread(target=drain, daemon=True)
+reader.start()
+try:
+    for state in [t + "-" + s for t in ["usb", "ble"] for s in ["auto", "manual", "custom", "unknown", "auto", "disconnected", "delayed-auto", "slow-auto", "manual", "auto"]] + ["prepare", "ble-auto", "maintenance"]:
+        process.stdin.write(state + "\n")
+        process.stdin.flush()
+        line = ready.get(timeout=30)
+        if line is None:
+            raise RuntimeError("Fixture exited before ready")
+        namespace["_AHAKEY_BRIDGE_PORT"] = int(line.split()[-1])
+        started = time.monotonic()
+        actual = namespace["get_ahakey_approval_override"](force_refresh=True)
+        elapsed = time.monotonic() - started
+        passed = actual is not None and actual["is_auto"] is True if state.endswith("auto") and "slow" not in state else actual is None
+        results.append({"state": state, "actual_consumer_result": actual, "elapsed_seconds": elapsed, "pass": passed})
+        if "slow" in state: time.sleep(0.6)  # let the isolated timed-out request finish, never reuse its AUTO
+    process.stdin.write("quit\n")
+    process.stdin.flush()
+    process.wait(timeout=10)
+    reader.join(timeout=5)
+finally:
+    if process.poll() is None:
+        process.terminate()  # Only this fixture child, never an application or bridge process.
+        process.wait(timeout=5)
+report = {"consumer_path": str(source), "consumer_sha256": hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
+          "function_sha256": hashlib.sha256(function.encode()).hexdigest(), "fixture_exit": process.returncode,
+          "transport": "actual consumer force_refresh -> loopback Java Kimi bridge -> actual BleManager status/97/parser via memory USB or framed BLE wire; C# radio/hardware not exercised",
+          "results": results}
+destination = Path(args.output)
+destination.write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
+destination.with_suffix(".log").write_text("".join(logs), encoding="utf-8")
+print(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
+assert process.returncode == 0 and all(r["pass"] for r in results)
